title: Juhi Mui
summary: Juhi Mui is an Indian Hindi-language television legal drama series that premiered on 29 June 2026 on Colors TV and streames digitally on JioHotstar. Produced by Goldie Behl under Rose Audio Visuals Pvt. Ltd, the series stars Eisha Singh and Vijayendra Kumeria. The series  is a loose inspired from the South Korean drama Extraordinary Attorney Woo.
plot:
Juhi Suri, a young woman with an exceptional memory and a strong understanding of legal concepts. Despite her abilities, she faces challenges as people around her struggle to understand her condition and often judge her for being different.
Juhi grows up in a family of lawyers and develops an interest in the legal profession while observing her father, Rajendra Suri, who runs his own law practice. Her ability to remember legal sections and notice details helps her navigate cases and situations around her.

title: Jerax
summary: Jerax is a 2026 Indian Kannada-language fantasy comedy-thriller television miniseries written and directed by Srinidhi Bengaluru. Produced by Dhananjaya under the Daali Pictures banner, the series stars Nagabhushana NS in the lead role. It is scheduled to premiere on ZEE5 on 24 April 2026.
plot: The series follows Prakasha, a modest xerox shop employee in the town of Malavalli. His life takes a supernatural turn when his photocopying machine gains the ability to create living duplicates, human clones that possess the memories and traits of the originals. The narrative explores the social and personal chaos that ensues as multiple versions of the town's residents begin to coexist.
reception:
The series received mixed reviews from critics, who praised the performances and concept but criticized the execution and pacing.
Vivek M.V. of The Hindu gave the series a positive review, describing it as "a witty fantasy drama propelled by fine performances." Anandu Suresh, writing for The Indian Express, noted that the lead actors "Nagabhushana [and] Payal Chengappa lead a simple fantasy comedy series that fumbles along the way."
Other reviewers were more critical of the show's pacing. India Today rated the series 2 out of 5 stars, stating that while the show features an "innovative concept", it ultimately represents a "wasted opportunity." Similarly, Susmita Sameera of The Times of India also awarded the series 2 out of 5 stars, concluding that it is "a unique concept that struggles to sustain engagement."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series marks the directorial debut in the digital space for Srinidhi Bengaluru, who previously directed the critically acclaimed science-fiction film Blink (2024). Actor Dhananjaya produced the series under his home banner, Daali Pictures, marking his first venture into OTT production.

title: Jazz City
summary:
Jazz City is an Indian Bengali language Historical spy thriller television series created and directed by Soumik Sen. The series star Arifin Shuvoo, Sauraseni Maitra and Shataf Figar.
the series premiered  on SonyLIV on 19 March 2026.
plot: Set in 1971 Calcutta, a jazz club becomes the stage for a revolutionary awakening, where music intertwines with language, identity, and the struggle that culminates in the birth of Bangladesh during a defining historical moment.
reception:
Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India observed that it is "All decked up with nowhere to go." Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express gave 1.5 stars out of 5 and said that "There was potential here, but it is let down by the length and laxity, a rare misfire for SonyLIV, which has mastered the art of creating and presenting solid period drama."
Deepa Gahlot of Rediff.com rated it 2.5/5 satrs and said that "Jazz City could have been enjoyable had it not been so densely over-plotted and unevenly executed." Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in observed that "Sen’s adda approach to the plotting results in a rambling, muddled and repetitive series that takes 10 episodes for what could have been explored in half the duration."
Vinamra Mathur of Firstpost gave 2.5 stars out of 5 and said that "Jazz City tries to tick too many boxes at once. It wants to be a political thriller, it wants to be a commentary on politicians and the people in power. It also wants to be a swanky web-series brimming with style and sass." Santanu Das of Hindustan Times gave 2 stars out of 5 and said, "Jazz City means well, but how long can it survive just on the basis of that? It is a show that sinks under its own weight and is never fully able to commit to the danger, restlessness, and anxiety of a troubled socio-political climate. It is too neat, too calculated, and sadly, too eager to reach a resolution."
Abhishek Srivastava of The Times of India rated it 3/5 stars and said that "‘Jazz City' is refined, patient storytelling elevated by strong performances and a rich musical canvas. Worth watching if you’re drawn to layered, culturally rooted historical dramas." Troy Ribeiro of Free Press Journal writes that "Jazz City is ambitious, atmospheric, and intermittently engaging, but ultimately uneven. It captures the mood of a turbulent time without fully harnessing its dramatic potential. For all its visual finesse and thematic richness, it remains curiously distant, more observed than felt. Overall, the series hums with promise but rarely soars." Jannatul Naym Pieal of The Daily Star criticize it by calling it "The Bangladesh Liberation War is one such event. More than five decades on, it keeps showing up in Indian films and series -- as a narrative real estate reshaped, reframed, and almost always centred on India."

episodesList.title: The Dispensable
episodesList.summary: In the vibrant yet volatile streets of 1969 Calcutta, a sharp-tongued jazz club owner battles corrupt officials, political unrest, and haunted memories while trying to keep his sanctuary alive amidst the impending storm of a nation's fracture.

episodesList.title: 21st February
episodesList.summary: As the Bengali language movement intensifies and refugees flood Calcutta, Jimmy must confront his own prejudices and navigate political unrest to protect his sanctuary and those seeking refuge - while shadowy forces conspire to crush the rising tide of revolution.

episodesList.title: A Night In Park Street
episodesList.summary: Beneath the smoky lights of a jazz club, a fundraiser masks a dangerous game where whispers of revolution echo, shadows watch every move, and a secret message could ignite a fire that no one can control.

episodesList.title: The Post Mortem
episodesList.summary: In the shadows of a city teetering on the brink of chaos, Jimmy is forced into a deadly race against time to save a community from a lethal epidemic - while unseen enemies close in, threatening not only his life but the fragile hope of a revolution on the edge of explosion.

episodesList.title: The Homecoming
episodesList.summary: Jimmy journeys into the fractured heart of a nation torn by war and disease, risking everything to save lives while confronting the ghosts of a shattered past, amid the rising storm of revolution and betrayal.

episodesList.title: Storm of the Century
episodesList.summary: Tensions and heartbreak reach a boiling point amid East Pakistan's independence movement. Student activists face brutal repression as they demand justice, while secret agents tighten their grip, tracking every move.

episodesList.title: The Election
episodesList.summary: Amidst covert political maneuvering, Pakistani leaders celebrate their strategic moves, while in Dhaka, Mujib  inspires hope despite growing violence. Jimmy grapples with escalating surveillance striving to sustain his network as communication lines falter. The episode depicts the onset of South Asia's most brutal genocide on Bengali students and civilians, Sheela and allies face personal peril and heartbreak. As the struggle intensifies, liberation fighters prepare for decisive revolt.

episodesList.summary: Amidst covert political maneuvering, Pakistani leaders celebrate their strategic moves, while in Dhaka, Mujib  inspires hope despite growing violence. Jimmy grapples with escalating surveillance striving to sustain his network as communication lines falter. The episode depicts the onset of South Asia's most brutal genocide on Bengali students and civilians, Sheela and allies face personal peril and heartbreak. episodesList.title: Escape To Calcutta
episodesList.summary: As Sheela grapples with the loss of allies and escalating danger a mysterious ally, Michael, joins Jimmy in a daring escape through forested tunnels to rescue Sheela, battling Pakistani forces in violent confrontations. The episode closes on Jimmy's painful realization of the cost of resistance.

episodesList.title: Morning Show
episodesList.summary: Jimmy unbroken, races against time to expose the brutal atrocities committed by the Pakistani army, using rare film footage that captures the harrowing truth of the genocide. The finale culminates in a high-stakes standoff inside a cinema where truth and danger collide.

title: Jagadhatri
summary: Jagadhatri is an Indian Hindi-language action thriller television series that premiered on 10 November 2025 on Zee TV. Produced by Rahul Kumar Tewary under Rolling Tales Production, it stars Sonakshi Batra and Farman Haider. It is an official remake of the Bengali television series Jagaddhatri of Zee Bangla.
plot: The narrative follows Jagadhatri "JD" Naik Deshmukh, a seemingly timid and submissive young woman within her family but a brave and highly skilled undercover agent outside her home. While navigating everyday taunts and mistreatment from her step-mother and relatives, she balances family obligations with her secret mission to fight crime and uncover the truth behind her deceased mother's mysterious past. Her loyal partner and confidant in this journey is Shivaay Deshmukh, an IPS officer who supports her in dangerous missions.
reception:
Throughout June 2026, the show maintained a steady rating of 1.4 TVR, making its way to top ten shows.
Ahead of the wedding of protagonists Shivaay and Jagadhatri, Fans hosted traditional Kelvan for lead actress Sonakshi Batra. The wedding was styled in a Maharashtrian culture.

articleSections.text: Sonakshi Batra as Jagadhatri "JD" Naik Deshmukh: Undercover IPS officer; Aparna and Jagdish's daughter; Rekha's step daughter; Tapasya and Anjali's half sister; Shivaay's wife and boss in crime missions (2025–present) ** Aaradhya Patel as child Jagadhatri (2025; 2026) (flashback appearance) * Farman Haider as Shivaay Singh Deshmukh: Undercover IPS officer; Mahesh and Urmila's son; Aarti's step son; Rudra and Aarna's half brother; Jagadhatri's husband and ally in crime missions(2025–present) ** Saarth Kumar as child Shivaay (2026)(flashback appearance)

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: In September 2025, Zee TV announced a new series titled Jagadhatri, Sonakshi Batra and Farman Haider as the main lead.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Sonakshi Batra was confirmed to play female lead, Jagadhatri. Farman Haider was selected to portray the male lead, Shivay. Geeta Tyagi joined the show as Rekha. Sayantani Ghosh was cast as Maya. Esteemed actor Suhita Tatte joined the cast as Aaji, Jagadhatri's grandmother. In July 2026, Mishmee Das joined the show to essay SSP Jahnvee.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The undercover duality agent drama features multiple action sequences including risky Holi fire scene with child actor Bhanushali and Batra overcoming the fear of heights.

episodesList.title: A Calm but Fiercely Brave Jagadhatri
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri, a calm and composed undercover agent, balances family taunts and her duties while staying determined to prove her late mother’s innocence.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri and Her Team Save Gunjan
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri and her team rescue Maya’s daughter Gunjan from gangster Musa’s clutches and fight his goons. Later, Jagadhatri's stepsister Tapasya fails to stop her from performing puja.

episodesList.title: The Police Catch Rudra Deshmukh Gambling
episodesList.summary: Maya’s husband, Sharad, visits her home and apologises to Gunjan. Jagadhatri grows desolate, missing her mother. Meanwhile, the police catch Maya’s cousin, Rudra, gambling and bring him back home.

episodesList.title: Maya Chooses Tapasya as a Match for Rudra
episodesList.summary: Maya resolves that Rudra must marry, and a pundit carries his proposal to Rekha’s home. Rekha offers Tapasya’s match in place of Jagadhatri, and soon Maya consents to it.

episodesList.title: Rekha Comes to Finalise Tapasya’s Alliance
episodesList.summary: Rekha lies at home and takes Tapasya to meet Rudra’s family. Club owner Vineet troubles Rudra for money. Once Rekha’s scheming is exposed, Dadi arrives at the hotel with Jagadhatri.

episodesList.title: Dadi's Stern Resolution
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri stops Dadi from causing a scene at the hotel. Rudra and Tapasya’s alliance is confirmed. When Rekha returns home, Dadi lashes out and vows to fast to seek justice for Jagadhatri.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Vents Her Anger on Shivay
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri joins Shivay on a mission, but troubled by her family's remarks, she vents her anger on him. At the same time, Rekha promises Jagdish to arrange Jagadhatri’s marriage into a good family.

episodesList.title: A Suitor Arrives to See Jagadhatri
episodesList.summary: Rekha behaves lovingly towards Jagadhatri and says a suitor is coming to see her. Seeing the age of the suitor for Jagadhatri, Dadi and Jagdish get angry at Rekha. Shivay feels sad seeing this.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Gets Permission to Reopen Aparna's Case
episodesList.summary: Rekha curses Jagadhatri and speaks ill of Aparna, while Sonali and Amol's return pleases Maya's family. Later, Jagadhatri's team receives permission to reopen Aparna's case.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Learns Aparna’s Killer’s Name
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri learns Musa is behind Aparna’s death. Later, Rudra plots escape and calls Tapasya, while Rekha decides to keep Jagadhatri away from Tapasya’s wedding.

episodesList.title: Rekha Secures a Vow From Jagadhatri
episodesList.summary: Rekha secures a vow from Jagadhatri, while Shivay reveals Aparna’s forensic report. Jagadhatri learns Musa’s whereabouts, and Tapasya sets off with Rudra for an outing.

episodesList.title: Will Jagadhatri’s Family Discover Her Secret?
episodesList.summary: Rudra takes Tapasya to a club where he crosses paths with Musa’s goon. Soon, Jagadhatri and Shivay arrive to capture him, and following them, Sampada and Rekha also reach the club.

episodesList.title: Sampada Sees Jagadhatri’s True Form
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri trails Musa’s man but is spotted by Sampada. Due to a misunderstanding, Tapasya takes a parcel home believing it to be Rudra’s gift. When Jagadhatri returns, Sampada confronts her.

episodesList.title: Sampada’s Claim About Jagadhatri
episodesList.summary: Sampada makes a striking claim on Jagadhatri. Meanwhile, Minister Patil arrives at Maya’s home with his son, offering apologies. Jagadhatri suspects Tapasya of hiding a mysterious box.

episodesList.title: Tapasya Has Jagadhatri's Lost Parcel
episodesList.summary: Rudra sneaks into Tapasya’s room, swaps the parcel and hides. Jagadhatri finds perfume inside, while Rudra questions Tapasya after hearing her voice. Later, Musa learns the truth about Jagadhatri.

episodesList.title: Sampada Sees Jagadhatri’s Gun
episodesList.summary: Rekha and Sampada harass Jagadhatri, pressing her to give Tapasya the necklace. Searching her wardrobe, Sampada discovers a gun, sparking uproar and chaos in the household.

episodesList.title: Shivay Gets Emotional Reminiscing About His Mother
episodesList.summary: Shivay replaces Jagadhatri’s gun with a bottle gourd, and everyone laughs at Sampada. Maya and Sharad fight over Gunjan. Shivay gets emotional when Jagadhatri asks him about his mother’s picture.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Tries to Trace Shivay’s Father
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri finds a torn photo of Shivay’s parents. She and Shivay then rescue children from traffickers. Later, Jagadhatri begins tracing Shivay’s father using the torn photograph.

episodesList.title: Rudra Visits Tapasya’s House With His Family
episodesList.summary: Sonali questions Maya for not inviting Sharad to Rudra’s wedding. Rudra visits Tapasya with his family and takes her out. Jagadhatri gently comforts a dejected Shivay.

episodesList.title: Rudra Tricks Tapasya Into Drug Trafficking
episodesList.summary: Shivay and Jagadhatri meet a photographer in search of Shivay’s father. Meanwhile, Rudra manipulates Tapasya into drug trafficking, as Jagadhatri and her team race to track down the smuggler!

episodesList.title: The Photos in Shivay’s Lab Shock Jagadhatri
episodesList.summary: Rekha and Jagdish worry over the Deshmukh family’s demands. Jagadhatri is stunned to see her photos in Shivay’s lab, while Sampada and Rekha uncover a property document in her room!

episodesList.title: Rekha and Sampada Plot to Steal Jagadhatri’s Land
episodesList.summary: While some Deshmukhs defy Maya’s decisions, Rudra’s secret call is exposed to Sadhu’s team. Meanwhile, Rekha and Sampada stage a cunning deception to usurp Jagadhatri’s land.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Mortgages Her Land
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri mortgages her land for Tapasya’s wedding, but thugs flee with the cash. While Sadhu gains crucial intel against Rudra, Jagadhatri fights the goons until the money is returned.

episodesList.title: Sadhu Comes to Meet Maya Regarding Rudra
episodesList.summary: Maya’s rival, Sakshi, has an article published against her. As Rudra and Tapasya’s engagement nears, Rekha and Sampada torment Jagadhatri, while Sadhu arrives to meet Maya about Rudra.

episodesList.title: Sharda Puts on an Act to Escape Arrest
episodesList.summary: Raghav’s family accuses Reet of murder, urging police to arrest her. After Reet revives Viren with water, Sharda pretends to be mentally unstable to evade arrest.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Calls Maya Regarding Rudra
episodesList.summary: Before the engagement, Shivay clicks the guests' photos but senses his father’s presence. Rekha is shocked to see the pundit, while Jagadhatri calls Maya, urging Rudra’s arrival for questioning.

episodesList.title: Rekha's Lie Exposed in Front of the Deshmukhs
episodesList.summary: Despite Rekha’s plea, the priest reveals to the Deshmukhs that Jagadhatri is the Naiks’ eldest daughter. To protect Tapasya’s engagement, Rekha lies that Jagadhatri is already engaged to Shivay.

episodesList.title: Rekha Lies That Jagadhatri and Shivay Are Lovers
episodesList.summary: Rekha cooks up a fake tale about Jagadhatri and Shivay, and everyone believes her. Mahesh persuades Aarti for Rudra and Tapasya’s engagement. Jagadish urges Rekha to tell the Deshmukhs the truth.

episodesList.title: Aarti and Mahesh Get Into an Argument
episodesList.summary: Jagdish scolds Rekha for her behaviour. Aarti and Mahesh quarrel over Rudra and Tapasya’s relationship. Later, everyone waits for Rudra for the engagement, and Jagadhatri sends a message to Maya.

episodesList.title: Rudra Is Stunned to Hear Jagadhatri's Voice
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri and Shivay share a dance, while Rudra sets a condition for finalising the drug-trafficking deal. Later, Rudra is stunned to hear Jagadhatri's voice. Soon, Jagadhatri warns Maya over a call.

episodesList.title: Rudra and Tapasya Get Engaged
episodesList.summary: Rudra and Tapasya get engaged, and Jagadhatri comes to perform their ‘aarti’. However, Maya arrives and takes Rudra away. Later, Maya asks Aarna to keep a watch on Rudra, but he manages to escape.

episodesList.title: Rudra's Truth Stuns Shivay
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri's team arrests Rudra. Shivay sees him and gets shocked on realising that he is the same guy who is engaged to Tapasya. Later, he tries to reveal Rudra's truth to Jagadhatri.

episodesList.title: Shivay Conceals Rudra’s Truth From Jagadhatri.
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri’s team questions Rudra and releases him, unaware that a mole within aids his escape. On an ascetic's counsel, Shivay conceals Rudra’s truth from Jagadhatri.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Delighted to Find Her Mother’s Photograph
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri trusts Shivay as a loyal friend and he is weighed down by guilt. Jagadhatri is delighted to find a photograph of her mother. Maya’s business rival, Sakshi, invites her to an event.

episodesList.title: Sampada Accuses Aparna of Murder
episodesList.summary: Aparna’s photo with Jagadhatri ignites Sampada’s fury. Sampada unveils a buried past, accuses Aparna of Milind’s murder, and hints at ties with Musa’s gang.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri’s Persistence and Sampada’s Fury
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri refuses to burn her mother’s photo, angering Sampada, who leaves her outside in the rain. Maya begs Sharad not to print her memoir, while Shivay rushes Jagadhatri to the hospital.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri and Shivay Come to Anjali's Rescue
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri shares a past incident about her mother with Shivay, who vows to support her mission. Later, Anjali is abducted by a few goons, but Jagadhatri and Shivay arrive to save her.

episodesList.title: Jagdish Scolds Sampada
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri and Shivay save Anjali and Jagdish, bringing everyone home. Jagdish scolds Sampada and entrusts Jagadhatri with Tapasya’s wedding arrangements. Rudra slips back into gambling.

episodesList.title: Shivay Follows Rudra
episodesList.summary: At Tapasya’s insistence, Jagadhatri takes her to buy a lehenga, while Maya orders jewellery that appears fake. In parallel, Shivay shadows Rudra during his delivery with sharp intent.

episodesList.title: Rudra Comes to Meet Tapasya With a Gift
episodesList.summary: Maya learns that the family members are behind the tampering with the jewellery. Rudra comes to meet Tapasya with a gift, and when he arrives, Shivay tries to stop Jagadhatri from seeing Rudra.

episodesList.title: Maya Sees a Bag Full of Money With Rudra
episodesList.summary: Shivay stops Jagadhatri from facing Rudra. Maya spots a money‑filled bag with Rudra and questions. Jagadhatri consoles a grieving Dadi and later demands Shivay’s case report.

episodesList.title: An Intruder Opens Fire on Shivay
episodesList.summary: Tapasya’s Haldi begins, but Jagadhatri is gripped by dread for Shivay's safety. At the office, Shivay faces a gunman’s fire. Meanwhile, Rudra is stunned to spot Jagadhatri at the ceremony.

episodesList.title: The Theft Takes Place at Jagadhatri’s House
episodesList.summary: At the haldi, Maya and Jagadhatri dance as Maya praises her. Jagadhatri grows troubled learning the truth about the shot at Shivay. Soon, a shocking theft hits her home, and Rekha lashes out at her.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Tries to Find Tapasya’s Stolen Jewellery
episodesList.summary: Rekha and Sampada accuse Jagadhatri of stealing Tapasya’s jewellery. Determined, she vows to return it before the wedding procession, but as she goes to find it with Shivay, a few goons surround them.

episodesList.title: Sadhu’s Plan to Catch Hold of Musa
episodesList.summary: Before Tapasya’s wedding procession, Jagadhatri arrives with her stolen jewellery to confront Aarav. Meanwhile, Sadhu reveals his plan to capture Musa and assigns Shivay a vital responsibility.

episodesList.title: Rudra’s Wedding Procession Reaches Tapasya’s Home
episodesList.summary: Rudra arrives with the wedding procession to marry Tapasya. Jagadhatri and Shivay are shocked to see Sadhu at the ceremony. Shivay stops Jagadhatri during the aarti and tries to express his feelings.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Is Taken Aback on Seeing Rudra
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri is shaken on seeing Rudra’s face, triggering a buried memory from the past. She questions Shivay over concealing Rudra’s truth and resolves to halt the wedding at any cost.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Attempts to Expose Rudra's Truth
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri disrupts Rudra and Tapasya’s wedding, bringing Rudra’s true nature and misdeeds to light in front of everyone. Rudra first denies her claims, but ultimately admits that he knows her.

episodesList.title: Vasudha and Jagadhatri Expose Rudra
episodesList.summary: Rudra spreads lies against Jagadhatri, claiming she desired him since college. Soon, Vasudha brings along the girls victimised by his schemes, exposing Rudra’s misdeeds.

episodesList.title: Tapasya Decides to Spend Her Life With Rudra
episodesList.summary: Jagdish breaks up Rudra and Tapasya’s wedding. Rudra pleads for forgiveness and a chance to change, and despite her family’s refusal, Tapasya chooses to spend her life with him.

episodesList.title: Shivay Discovers a Major Secret
episodesList.summary: Tapasya defies all to wed Rudra, while Shivay learns Mahesh is his father. The news of Musa's presence at the wedding forces Sadhu and his team to retreat.

episodesList.title: Tapasya Asks Jagadhatri to Apologise to Rudra
episodesList.summary: Yash tries to stop Musa from reaching the wedding, while Tapasya halts her marriage, urging Jagadhatri to apologise to Rudra. Seeing her folded hands before Rudra leaves Maya deeply unsettled.

episodesList.title: Rudra and Tapasya Tie the Knot
episodesList.summary: Rudra and Tapasya get married. Musa arrives to meet Rudra, but Sadhu’s team fails to hold him captive. Later, during Tapasya’s farewell, Rudra mocks Jagadhatri over her defeat.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Learns the Truth of Shivay’s Father
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri warns Rudra on the pretext of the ear-pulling ritual, while Sadhu’s team interrogates traitor Yash. Anusha delivers shocking news, and the truth about Shivay’s father comes to light.

episodesList.title: Maya Takes a Promise From Tapasya
episodesList.summary: Rudra and Tapasya’s Griha Pravesh begins as Maya demands a promise before entry. Jagadhatri saves Shivay from a beating, and Tapasya later fumes at Maya’s interference.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Brings Shivay to Meet Mahesh
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri stands by Shivay, giving him the strength to face the truth. Maya fumes as Tapasya oversleeps, but Aarti defends Tapasya. Later, Jagadhatri takes Shivay to Mahesh’s office.

episodesList.title: Mahesh’s Behaviour Hurts Shivay
episodesList.summary: Shivay shows Mahesh a photo of his mother Urmila and reveals he is their son. However, Mahesh insults him and throws him out of the office. Later, both Shivay and Mahesh break down in tears.

episodesList.title: Maya Explains the Household Rules to Tapasya
episodesList.summary: Maya sees Mahesh crying and questions him. Jagadhatri discovers Sadhu’s life is in danger and sets out with Shivay to save him. Disappointed with Tapasya, Maya explains to her the house rules.

episodesList.title: Musa Has Sadhu Shot
episodesList.summary: Sadhu obtains an important file, but Musa has him shot and takes the file away. Shivay and Jagaddhatri rush Sadhu to the hospital. During the puja, Tapasya’s actions disturb Maya.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Makes a Big Decision
episodesList.summary: Tapasya insults the ancestral necklace, and Maya snatches it away. Later, Tapasya seeks Maya’s forgiveness. Jagadhatri makes a bold decision to leave the home and meets Shivay at the Goddess’s temple.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Seeks Shivay’s Support in Her Mission
episodesList.summary: During a ritual, Tapasya humiliates Rudra, sparking his anger, while Maya offers advice. Jagadhatri seeks Shivay’s support for her mission and reveals the way into Deshmukh Mansion.

episodesList.title: Shivay and Jagadhatri Visit the Deshmukh Mansion
episodesList.summary: At the temple, Jagadhatri applies vermilion to herself. Tapasya’s behaviour troubles Maya and Mahesh. When Jagadhatri and Shivay visit Maya’s home, Maya is shocked as Shivay calls Mahesh ‘father’.

episodesList.title: Maya Decides to Keep Jagadhatri and Shivay at Home
episodesList.summary: Mahesh refuses to accept Shivay as his son. Scared by Jagadhatri’s threat, Maya agrees to keep him and Shivay at home but on a condition. Meanwhile, Rekha and Sampada plan to visit Tapasya’s in‑laws.

episodesList.title: Maya’s Decision Angers Rudra and Tapasya
episodesList.summary: Maya announces her decision to keep Jagadhatri and Shivay at home, sparking Rudra and Tapasya’s drama. Rekha slaps Jagadhatri, while an angry Dadi refuses to let her stay in the house!

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri’s Marriage News Shocks Jagdish
episodesList.summary: Jagdish is stunned by the news of Jagadhatri and Shivay’s marriage. Meanwhile, the couple plan their next move as Sonali and Tapasya grow suspicious of Maya’s decision.

episodesList.title: Tapasya Is Infuriated With Jagadhatri
episodesList.summary: Tapasya spots the room decorated for Jagadhatri’s wedding night and lashes out. Maya tries to reconcile them, but later, Rudra and Tapasya plot revenge against Maya and Jagadhatri.

episodesList.title: Jagaddhatri and Shivay Feel Uneasy With Their Play
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri and Shivay feel uncomfortable pretending to celebrate their wedding night. Tapasya finds Rudra’s behaviour strange. Shivay imagines a beautiful scene, but Jagadhatri shatters his illusion.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Performs Arti at the Deshmukh House
episodesList.summary: Due to excessive drinking, Rudra falls asleep before the wedding night. The next morning, Jagadhatri performs arti, gathering the entire Deshmukh family and explains a Makar Sankranti ritual to them.

episodesList.title: Shivay’s Presence Makes Mahesh Feel Uneasy
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri prepares breakfast for the Deshmukh family, while Mahesh hesitates to join Shivay. Later, Tapasya asks Maya to cook for her, and Maya’s unforeseen response leaves everyone stunned.

episodesList.title: Maya Asks Tapasya to Cut the Jackfruit
episodesList.summary: Maya asks Tapasya to cut the jackfruit, leaving her nervous. Jagadhatri helps but hides when Maya arrives, and later, Maya urges Tapasya to continue the work by starting the next task.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Helps Tapasya in Cooking
episodesList.summary: Shivay keeps Maya distracted while Jagadhatri helps Tapasya cook. During dinner, Maya realises Jagadhatri made the dish and rewards her with a gift, leaving Tapasya fuming.

episodesList.title: Rudra Rages at Tapasya’s Misbehaviour
episodesList.summary: In fury, Tapasya grows fierce, but Jagadhatri shields her from Maya’s wrath. Rekha urges Jagadhatri to help, and later Rudra brings food for Tapasya but flares up at her misconduct.

episodesList.title: Tapasya’s Shocking Advice to Rudra
episodesList.summary: Rudra goes to meet Musa’s man at the location he mentioned. Tapasya also accompanies Rudra, while Jagadhatri’s team keeps an eye on them. Later, Tapasya advises Rudra to separate his business.

episodesList.title: Rudra and Shivay Lock Horns in a Fierce Clash
episodesList.summary: Over the partition chaos, Jagadhatri slaps Tapasya and demands she apologise to Maya. Rudra misbehaves with Jagadhatri for Tapasya and when Shivay intervenes, the two end up in a fierce scuffle.

episodesList.title: Aarti and Tapasya Unite Against Maya
episodesList.summary: Mahesh sternly steps in to stop Rudra and Shivay’s clash. Jagadhatri tries talking to an upset Tapasya. Later, Aarti and Tapasya unite against Maya, with Aarti offering her advice.

episodesList.title: Tapasya Provokes Sharad Against Maya
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri calls Mahesh to send Rudra to the police station for questioning. Tapasya fakes an apology to Maya, and later phones Sharad claiming Maya neglects Gunjan.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Takes Charge of the Team
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri’s team interrogates Rudra, who demands a lawyer. The high command entrusts her with leadership, and later her team rescues children from traffickers.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Grows Emotional on Meeting Jagdish
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri detains the traffickers, but Musa threatens her over a call, and the captives escape after a shootout. Later, an emotional encounter occurs in the market when Jagadhatri runs into Jagdish.

episodesList.title: Sharad Visits Deshmukh Mansion to Take Gunjan
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri hides the truth from Jagdish, leaving him hurt. Meanwhile, a drunken Rudra argues with Shivay, who warns him. Later, Sharad arrives at Deshmukh Mansion to take Gunjan back.

episodesList.title: Sharad and Maya Fight Over Gunjan
episodesList.summary: Maya stops Sharad from taking Gunjan, and their fight frightens her until Jagadhatri intervenes. Later, Sharad resolves to seek custody in court, with Sakshi stepping in to support him.

episodesList.title: Maya's Accusation Against Jagaddhatri
episodesList.summary: Sharad thanks Jagaddhatri for taking care of Gunjan. Maya believes that Jagaddhatri informed Sharad about Gunjan's injury. But Jagaddhatri denies the accusation and advises Maya.

episodesList.title: Moosa Cautions Rudra
episodesList.summary: Moosa warns Rudra that a mole is hiding within his house, prompting Rudra to investigate. Maya senses Mahesh’s distress and Jagaddhatri attempts to bridge the distance between Shivay and Mahesh.

episodesList.title: Rudra Aims a Gun at Shivay
episodesList.summary: Mahesh lashes out at Shivay, refusing to accept him as son. Shocked, Rudra points a gun at Shivay, demanding truth, while Jagadhatri tries to console a shattered Shivay.

episodesList.title: Maya Gives Shivay a Bag Full of Money
episodesList.summary: Maya calms an infuriated Rudra, promising to end Shivay’s matter soon. She hands Jagadhatri and Shivay a bag full of money, while Tapasya and Sonali secretly overhear.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Turns Down Maya’s Monetary Help
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri rejects Maya’s money and demands Shivay’s rights. Meanwhile, Tapasya suspects Maya’s hidden motive in bringing Jagadhatri home and questions Rudra after seeing his anger.

episodesList.title: Uma’s Question and Mahesh’s Past
episodesList.summary: Maya’s mother Uma questions Mahesh about his past with Urmila and Shivay, stirring old memories. Shivay arrives with Jagadhatri to meet his uncle Suri, who is delighted to see him.

episodesList.title: Suri Reveals the Truth to Shivay and Jagadhatri
episodesList.summary: Mahesh questions Uma, but she lies. Meanwhile, Suri confirms that Mahesh is Shivay’s father, and Jagadhatri calls Maya to say that a key witness has been found.

episodesList.title: Suri Arrives to Reveal the Truth About Shivay
episodesList.summary: Uma searches Jagadhatri’s room and finds an envelope addressed to Suri. Jagadhatri and Shivay reach Maya’s office, where Mahesh arrives too. Soon, Suri turns up to expose Shivay’s truth.

episodesList.title: Shivay Is Devastated by Suri’s Death
episodesList.summary: Suri dies in a road accident, shattering Shivay and burying the truth about his relationship with Mahesh. As Mahesh questions Uma, a letter surfaces, followed by a clash between Maya and Jagadhatri.

episodesList.title: Shivay’s Vow
episodesList.summary: Maya warns Jagadhatri of dire consequences if Shivay’s truth is not proven within three weeks. Determined, Shivay vows to tell the Deshmukhs the truth, and Sharad later wishes Gunjan on her birthday.

episodesList.title: Maya Suspects Shivay and Jagadhatri
episodesList.summary: When Jagadhatri and Maya celebrate Gunjan’s birthday, Maya spots Shivay asleep on the sofa. Rudra and Tapasya take the responsibility of the party, as Jagadhatri seeks Maya’s advice.

episodesList.title: Rudra’s Plan to Let Musa’s Goons Into the House
episodesList.summary: Tapasya tries to humiliate Jagadhatri in public. Rudra plots to sneak Musa’s men into the house on Gunjan’s birthday, while Jagadhatri decides to search Mahesh’s room.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Searches Mahesh’s Room
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri searches Mahesh’s room and uncovers a hidden locker. Mahesh snaps when Maya questions him. Jagadhatri later persuades Sharad to meet Gunjan, while Tapasya lashes out at her.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Suspects the Clowns
episodesList.summary: Rudra, disguised as a clown, briefs Musa’s men on the house layout. At Gunjan’s birthday, Rekha taunts Jagadhatri, who grows increasingly suspicious of the clowns around her.

episodesList.title: Shivay and Jagadhatri Fight the Goons at the Party
episodesList.summary: At the party, Jagadhatri grows suspicious of the clowns in disguise and joins Shivaay to confront them. Soon after, one clown threatens Gunjan at gunpoint, and Jagadhatri steps in to save her.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Introduces Sharad to Gunjan
episodesList.summary: Sharad comes to Gunjan's birthday party, and Jagadhatri takes him to meet Gunjan. Tapasya spots this and brings Maya and the others there. Later, Jagadhatri stops the police from arresting Sharad.

episodesList.title: Maya Saves Sharad From Being Arrested
episodesList.summary: At Jagadhatri’s request, Maya saves Sharad from arrest and lets him celebrate his birthday with Gunjan. Meanwhile, Rekha summons Jagadhatri and Shivay for the 'pagphera' ritual as part of her plan.

episodesList.title: Rekha Humiliates Shivay When He Comes Home
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri arrives at her parents’ home with Shivay, only for Rekha to insult him, while Jagadish’s anger targets her as well. Later, Rekha twists the truth, provoking Jagadish against Jagadhatri.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri and Shivay Face Insult at Her Home
episodesList.summary: When Rudra arrives with Tapasya at her home, he joins the others in humiliating Jagadhatri and Shivay. Rekha forces Jagadhatri to do the chores, while Shivay puts Rudra in his place for his behaviour.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Feels Deeply Hurt by Jagdish’s Anger
episodesList.summary: With Shivay by her side, Jagadhatri cooks for everyone. But Jagdish refuses her food, leaving her hurt by his anger. Later, Shivay tries to lift her mood and bring back her smile.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Stays at Her Maternal Home for Pagphera
episodesList.summary: Despite being insulted, Jagadhatri stays at her maternal home for Pagphera, while Rudra remains there due to Tapasya’s insistence. Later, on Valentine’s Day, Jagadhatri dresses up in Aparna’s saree.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Ends Up Intoxicated Because of Tapasya
episodesList.summary: Tapasya tricks Jagadhatri into drinking alcohol, leaving her completely intoxicated. Later, Tapasya celebrates Valentine’s Day with Rudra at home, while Shivay supports a dazed, dancing Jagadhatri.

episodesList.title: Jagdish Lets Go Off His Anger Towards Jagadhatri
episodesList.summary: A drunk Jagadhatri comes close to Shivay. The next morning, Shivay teases her and gives Jagdish some advice. Rekha is shocked to learn that Jagdish is no longer upset with Jagadhatri.

episodesList.title: Maya Receives a Legal Notice
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri grows suspicious of Rudra. Maya receives a custody notice for Gunjan from Sharad and blames Jagadhatri and Shivay. Meanwhile, Musa orders Rudra to find the attacker who targeted his men.

episodesList.title: Arna Becomes the Target of Rudra’s Enemy
episodesList.summary: Sakshi and Tapasya secretly plot their next move. Meanwhile, an old enemy strikes back by targeting Rudra’s sister Arna. Elsewhere, Anusha gives Jagadhatri a crucial clue about Suri’s accident.

episodesList.title: Aarna Lands in Big Trouble
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri calls Sharad to discuss Maya’s legal notice, while Sakshi presents a new proposal to Rudra. Meanwhile, Shivay drops Aarna at Gaurav’s party, where she soon lands in serious trouble.

episodesList.title: Shivay Hides Aarna’s Crime
episodesList.summary: A terrified Aarna admits to Shivay that she caused Gaurav’s death. Shivay erases all evidence and reassures her with a promise. The next day, the police visit Deshmukh Mansion with a warrant.

episodesList.title: The Police Take Aarna Into Custody
episodesList.summary: The police accuse Aarna of Gaurav’s murder, leaving the Deshmukhs in disbelief. She is taken into custody for interrogation, with Jagadhatri by her side, while Tapasya breaks the news to Sakshi.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Investigates as Shivay Burns the Evidence
episodesList.summary: Growing suspicious of Shivay, Jagadhatri questions him. Later, her crime‑scene inspection reveals shocking clues, while Shivay secretly burns all evidence that could expose Aarna.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Suspends Shivay
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri confronts Shivay for covering-up Aarna's crime and suspends him. Meanwhile, Minister Patil sends Sakshi a scandalous video, and Aarna returns home on bail.

episodesList.title: Will Maya Bend to Minister Patil’s Condition?
episodesList.summary: As Aarna’s crime video goes viral, the Deshmukhs are thrown into worry. Minister Patil arrives with his son and, in return for protecting Arna, puts a demanding condition before Maya.

episodesList.title: Gaurav's Murderer Is Exposed
episodesList.summary: The real murderer of Gaurav is exposed. Aarna thanks Shivay and takes a promise from him. Maya reveals the truth to the media. Rudra suspects Jagadhatri and goes to find evidence in her room.

episodesList.title: Rudra’s Struggle to Find the Secret Agent
episodesList.summary: Shivay’s move blocks Rudra from uncovering Jagadhatri's secret. The tea made by Tapasya turns bad and, in anger, she spills it on Jagadhatri's hand. This complicates Rudra’s hunt for the secret agent.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri's Harsh Decision Leaves Shivay Hurt
episodesList.summary: Shivay hopes to mend things with Jagadhatri, but she takes a harsh decision that leaves him hurt. Meanwhile, Rudra searches for a ring, unaware it has fallen into Maya’s hands.

episodesList.title: Rudra's Shocking Discovery
episodesList.summary: Shivay’s endless apologies fail to melt Jagadhatri’s anger. Rudra is shocked when the ring he is looking for is spotted with two different people in the house. Jagadhatri makes a decision for Gunjan.

episodesList.title: Maya Makes a Bold Demand to Sakshi
episodesList.summary: Rudra gets baffled as strange clues about the ring keep reaching him, each more confusing than the previous. Tapasya eyes Maya's chair. Maya stuns Sakshi by demanding a public apology to her family.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri's Gift Upsets Tapasya
episodesList.summary: Rudra faces a chilling ultimatum as he struggles for a solution, only to later taunt Shivay. Holika Dahan brings joy to the family, but Jagadhatri’s gift leaves Tapasya green with envy.

episodesList.title: Maya Foils Tapasya's Plan
episodesList.summary: Irked by the praise Jagadhatri receives from Aarna, Tapasya plots to stop her from attending the Holi puja. However, Maya ensures Jagadhatri attends, leaving Tapasya furious.

episodesList.title: Tapasya's Jealousy Turns Dangerous
episodesList.summary: Tapasya burns with jealousy as Jagadhatri is praised and called to lead the Holi ritual. She plots against Jagadhatri, but the situation spirals out of control when Gunjan gets trapped instead.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri and Shivay Save Gunjan's Life
episodesList.summary: Panic spreads as Gunjan gets caught in a deadly fire. Jagadhatri bravely runs into the flames to save her while Shivay struggles to control the fire. Maya then thanks them for saving Gunjan.

episodesList.title: Rudra to Get Shivay Killed
episodesList.summary: Consumed by jealousy, Rudra asks Moosa to kill Shivay on Holi. As the Deshmukhs happily celebrate the festival, Jagadhatri is surprised to see Rudra warmly wishing Shivay, unaware of the danger ahead.

episodesList.title: Rudra’s Sinister Plan
episodesList.summary: The Deshmukhs celebrate Holi with colours and thandai, but behind the festivities, Rudra secretly executes his deadly plan against Shivay. Later, the ladies entertain everyone with a lively dance.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Captures Rudra's Shooter
episodesList.summary: As Rudra’s sniper targets Shivay, Jagadhatri uncovers the plot and grills the shooter about his mastermind. Meanwhile, Sharad enjoys Holi with Maya and Gunjan but Tapasya informs Sakshi about it.

episodesList.title: Rudra's Dark Move
episodesList.summary: Shivay is delighted as Jagadhatri forgives him, but the moment collapses when Rudra secretly shoots him. Shock grips the family, and soon the police and Jagadhatri's team arrive to investigate.

episodesList.title: Shivay’s Condition Devastates Jagadhatri
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri vows to destroy the one who dared to shoot Shivay, while Rudra trembles at the fear of being exposed. Shivay’s condition devastates Jagadhatri, and the doctor’s diagnosis leaves her numb.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Performs a Painful Ritual for Shivay
episodesList.summary: The revelation that Shivay is alive sends Rudra into a storm of fury, pushing him towards the hospital to finish him. At the temple, Jagadhatri endures a punishing ritual, pleading for Shivay’s life.

episodesList.title: Mahesh Comes to Shivay’s Rescue
episodesList.summary: Rudra severs Shivay’s blood supply and flees, leaving him on the brink. Soon, Mahesh rushes in to donate blood as Jagadhatri endures a harsh penance at the temple to save him.

episodesList.title: Shivay’s Condition Stabilises
episodesList.summary: Shivay’s condition stabilises after Mahesh donates blood to him. While Rudra decides to hide the gun he used to attack Shivay, Jagadhatri and her team plot to find the attacker and his motive.

episodesList.title: Uma Grows Suspicious of Jagadhatri
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri overhears Rudra’s call and grows suspicious. Doubtful of Jagadhatri's identity, Uma searches her room and finds her mother’s photo. Soon, Aditi reveals the Holi photo goof up to Jagadhatri.

episodesList.title: Rudra Barges Into the Hospital to Kill Shivay
episodesList.summary: Uma is confounded by the hidden tie between Jagadhatri and Aparna. Enraged after speaking to Mahesh about Shivay, he barges into the hospital with his men to kill Shivay, leaving Jagadhatri scared.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Protects Shivay but Gets Shot
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri shields Shivay when Rudra and his men come to attack him. She then covers her face and repels the goons but is later shot. Meanwhile, the family worries about Rudra’s absence.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Vows to Find Shivay's Attacker
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri and Shivay face Rudra’s deadly attack, but their team saves them in time. Maya decides to take Shivay home for safety. As Rudra plans his next move, Jagadhatri vows to find the attacker.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Closes in on Shivay's Attacker
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri races against time to find Shivay’s attacker. Tapasya is shaken by Rudra’s true nature. Jagadhatri finds a clue in the Holi photos that reveals the attacker is someone very close to Shivay.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Suspects Rudra Behind the Attack
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri suspects that Rudra is the mastermind behind the attack on Shivay. Maya shifts Shivay home from the hospital. Rudra's fear grows after a nightmare, but Aarti boosts his confidence.

episodesList.title: Agent JD's Order to Maya
episodesList.summary: Agent JD orders Maya to send Rudra for interrogation. Maya then questions Rudra about his whereabouts last night. In a shocking twist, someone else arrives for interrogation in Rudra’s place.

episodesList.title: Maya's Challenge to Agent JD
episodesList.summary: Maya faces Agent JD’s interrogation and defends Rudra. She challenges Agent JD, but the latter gives her a fitting reply. While Mahesh voices his feelings to an unconscious Shivay, Musa backs Rudra.

episodesList.title: A Family Lie Shields Rudra
episodesList.summary: Maya returns home and confronts Rudra about the hospital shootout. Tapasya claims he was home, and Aarti supports the lie. The family joins in, easing Maya’s doubts but fuelling Jagadhatri’s anger.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri’s Heart Changes Her Path
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri reconsiders leaving with Shivay after an emotional moment. Sakshi calls Maya to provoke her for headlines. The next day, Sampada and Rekha arrive with Jagdish, feigning concern for Shivay.

episodesList.title: Rudra Is Cornered by a Furious Jagadhatri
episodesList.summary: Rekha insists on taking Shivay and Jagadhatri away, but Jagadhatri thrashes Rudra to force a confession. Later, Tapasya finds the room locked and calls the family.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Reveals Shivay’s Truth
episodesList.summary: After Rudra is rescued from Jagadhatri, Rekha lashes out and Aarti slaps her and orders a bedridden Shivay thrown out. Maya returns shocked, and Jagadhatri is forced to reveal Shivay is Mahesh’s son.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Exposes Shivay's Truth
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri exposes Shivay as Mahesh’s son and declares herself the daughter-in-law. Chaos unfolds as Rudra lashes out, Tapasya threatens self-immolation and accusations tear the family apart.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Suggests Shivay's DNA Test
episodesList.summary: Sampada levels accusations against Jagadhatri and calls her claims baseless. Jagadhatri states that a DNA test will prove if Shivay is Mahesh’s son or not. Later, Jagadhatri suspects Rudra.

episodesList.title: DNA Report Puts Shivay’s Fate at Risk
episodesList.summary: Sakshi makes Jagadhatri’s video on Shivay’s identity go viral, unsettling the Deshmukh family. As Jagadhatri waits for the DNA report, Rudra arrives at hospital with Musa’s backing to foil her plan.

episodesList.title: The Deshmukhs Await Crucial DNA Result
episodesList.summary: At Musa’s urging, Rudra drops his plan to attack Jagadhatri at the hospital. With the DNA report delayed by a day, she asks Rishabh and the police to guard the place as the Deshmukhs await the result.

episodesList.title: Mahesh and Shivay’s Truth Sparks Rudra’s Fury
episodesList.summary: The truth about Mahesh and Shivay’s relationship stuns the family. When Mahesh accepts Shivay as his son, Shivay and Jagadhatri feel happy, until Rudra, consumed by rage, turns the gun on himself.

episodesList.title: Shivay’s Shocking DNA Reports
episodesList.summary: Maya reveals Shivay’s DNA reports, leaving Jagadhatri stunned. While Jagadhatri suspects foul play, Maya sides with the family and asks her to leave. Meanwhile, Rishabh tries to find the truth.

episodesList.title: Mahesh's Decision About Jagadhatri and Shivay
episodesList.summary: Mahesh recalls the favors Jagadhatri and Shivay did for his family and lets them stay in the house. He confronts Aarti, saying he knows about her and Rudra’s deeds. Jagadhatri’s question stuns Mahesh.

episodesList.title: Shivay Regains Consciousness
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri forces Mahesh to reveal Shivay's truth, and he recalls his painful past before her. As Shivay regains consciousness, Aarti and Rudra panic, fearing he will expose the name of his shooter.

episodesList.title: Shivay Aims a Gun at Rudra
episodesList.summary: Pointing out Rudra’s biggest mistake, Aarti orders him to shoot Shivay again and hands him a gun. However, the moment turns tense when Shivay walks in, recalls Rudra’s past sin and aims a gun at him.

episodesList.title: Shivay and Rudra Hold Each Other at Gunpoint
episodesList.summary: Shivay and Rudra hold each other at gunpoint until Aarti and Mahesh stop the clash. As Shivay stays silent about the attacker, Jagadhatri suspects Rudra as the mastermind and orders his arrest.

episodesList.title: Shivay's Shocking Testimony
episodesList.summary: As Rudra escapes from home, Jagadhatri’s team gets him arrested. At the police station, she confidently vows to prove his crime, until Shivay’s statement gives the case a shocking twist.

episodesList.title: Shivay's Surprise for Jagadhatri
episodesList.summary: Shivay’s false statement clears Rudra of all charges. Maya asks Mahesh to send Jagadhatri and Shivay away, but he refuses. Jagadhatri confronts Aarti, and later, Shivay gives her a surprise.

episodesList.title: Aarti to Make Jagadhatri Do the Housework
episodesList.summary: Shivay cooks food for Jagadhatri, who questions him about the attacker’s identity. Elsewhere, Musa alerts Rudra about her. Aarti fires the staff, forcing Jagadhatri and Tapasya to do the housework.

episodesList.title: Jagdhatri Takes on Aarti’s Challenge
episodesList.summary: Jagdhatri accepts Aarti’s challenge and handles all the chores while Tapasya complains to Sampada over a call. Mahesh bonds with Shivay as Rudra asks Maya for INR 5 crore for a supposed startup.

episodesList.title: Is Jagadhatri at Risk?
episodesList.summary: Shivay reveals his childhood struggles to Mahesh. Back home, Jagadhatri and Tapasya get help from Aarna and Sona in the chores, until a dangerous slip in the kitchen leaves one of them unconscious.

episodesList.title: Aarna Gets Injured in a Cooker Blast
episodesList.summary: As Aarna gets injured in a cooker blast, Aarti blames Jagadhatri and gives her a task. Mahesh refuses to give Rudra money for his business. Jagadhatri surprises everyone by preparing dinner outdoors.

episodesList.title: Maya Asks Jagadhatri to Leave the House
episodesList.summary: A drunk Rudra grazes Jagadhatri and Tapasya with his car, so Mahesh slaps him. Jagadhatri treats Tapasya’s wound and Maya asks her to leave the house with Shivay, but Jagadhatri refuses.

episodesList.title: Maya Funds Rudra but With Conditions
episodesList.summary: Maya secretly hands Rudra the first part of the INR 5 crore for his startup, with conditions. At the same time, Shivay and Jagadhatri draw closer, though Jagadhatri keeps her focus on the mission.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatari’s Team Is All Set to Nab Musa
episodesList.summary: Rudra apologises to Tapasya, who then questions him about having a girlfriend. Sona urges an upset Tapasya to follow Rudra to learn the truth. Shivay and Jagadhatari’s team go to nab Musa.

episodesList.title: Tapasya Secretly Follows Rudra Into a Club
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri’s team tries to catch Musa and Rudra. Tapasya secretly follows Rudra into a club, where she is shocked to see him enjoying with girls. Rudra shares his plan to start a business with Musa.

episodesList.title: Tapasya Joins Rudra in the Gambling Game
episodesList.summary: Rudra strikes a deal with Nick, a businessman brought by Musa. Tapasya causes a scene at the club but Musa gets her to join Rudra in gambling. Jagadhatri and team enter the club to find Musa.

episodesList.title: Rudra Loses INR 1 Crore to Musa
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri reaches home and serves everyone lunch, but Maya questions her about Tapasya. Rudra and Tapasya lose INR 2 crore to Musa. Soon, Musa's goons follow Shivay’s team and discover their hideout.

episodesList.title: Musa's Order to His Goon
episodesList.summary: Hiding his identity, Musa’s goon rushes Anusha to the hospital, where she safely delivers her baby. Grateful for his help, Shivay thanks him. Later, Musa gives his goon an order regarding Jagadhatri.

episodesList.title: Tapasya Lies to Jagadhatri About Rudra
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri catches Musa’s man and challenges Musa to face her instead of hiding like a coward. Later, Rudra mistreats Tapasya again, but she lies to Jagadhatri and Maya about the marks on her face.

episodesList.title: Tapasya's Appalling Revelation Shocks Jagadhatri
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri and her team uncover Rudra’s links to dangerous crime rings. As Maya probes Tapasya about the truth, Jagadhatri listens through a hidden recorder, and Tapasya’s reply shocks them both.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri - April 26, 2026
episodesList.summary: A daughter’s fight for dignity and an intelligence officer’s war for truth, Jagadhatri’s dual life embodies strength, sacrifice and the relentless pursuit of justice.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri Fails to Catch Musa Again
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri captures Musa’s men, but Musa slips away after stealing her ID card. At home, Maya plots to expose Jagadhatri. Terrified by the ID card he stole, Musa shuts all his illegal operations.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri and Shivay Uncover Rudra’s Ploy
episodesList.summary: Rudra and Tapasya try to emotionally manipulate Maya into giving INR 4 Crore, while Jagadhatri and Shivay overhear them. Maya then insists on seeing Rudra’s business report before releasing the money.

episodesList.title: Mahesh Confronts Rudra About Taking Maya's Money
episodesList.summary: Aarti praises Aarna’s cooking but insults Jagadhatri. Musa shifts his illegal business to Rudra’s name. Mahesh scolds Rudra for taking money from Maya and questions whether he lost it in gambling.

episodesList.title: Shivay Tries to Expose Rudra's Fake Business Plan
episodesList.summary: Mahesh confronts Rudra over gambling losses. A fake start‑up plan buys him time, but Shivay’s audit threatens to expose him, pushing Rudra into panic.

episodesList.title: Sharda’s Desperate Plot to Get Rid of Kishore
episodesList.summary: Kishore’s repeated demands for hush money push Sharda to plot his downfall. Later, she urges Unnati to keep her child, but Reet and Raghav take her to hospital to confirm if an abortion is possible.

episodesList.title: Rudra’s Cover Begins to Crumble
episodesList.summary: Shivay urges Mahesh, Maya and Jagan to connect with Rudra’s importer, but Rudra cleverly misleads them. Later, Rudra calls Musa for a meeting, and Jagadhatri’s team spots a link between the two.

episodesList.title: Aarti Gives Tapasya a Task
episodesList.summary: After tapping Rudra’s call, Jagadhatri's team gets ready to catch Musa at night. Aarti gives Tapasya the cooking duties, and Tapasya puts on an act before Jagadhatri, which Maya sees through the CCTV.

episodesList.title: Jagadhatri and Shivay's Next Move to Catch Musa
episodesList.summary: Maya gets puzzled about Jagadhatri while watching her on CCTV. Jagadhatri and Shivay set to follow Rudra to Musa's illegal hideout, but they stop after seeing a drunk Sharad and plan another move.

episodesList.title: Will Shivay Propose to Jagadhatri?
episodesList.summary: Jagadhatri and Shivay sneak into Tapasya’s fisheries. Shivay dreams of proposing to Jagadhatri but snaps back in shock when she unexpectedly walks into the cabin where he has prepared the proposal.

plotHtml: The narrative follows Jagadhatri "JD" Naik Deshmukh, a seemingly timid and submissive young woman within her family but a brave and highly skilled undercover agent outside her home. While navigating everyday taunts and mistreatment from her step-mother and relatives, she balances family obligations with her secret mission to fight crime and uncover the truth behind her deceased mother's mysterious past. Her loyal partner and confidant in this journey is Shivaay Deshmukh, an IPS officer who supports her in dangerous missions.
tagline: The narrative follows Jagadhatri "JD" Naik Deshmukh, a seemingly timid and submissive young woman within her family but a brave and highly skilled undercover agent outside her home.

title: Jaadu Teri Nazar – Daayan Ka Mausam
wikiTitle: Jaadu Teri Nazar – Daayan Ka Mausam
summary: Jaadu Teri Nazar – Daayan Ka Mausam is an Indian supernatural thriller series produced by Gul Khan under 4 Lions Films. It premiered on StarPlus from 18 February 2025 to 4 August 2025. It streams digitally on JioHotstar. It stars Khushi Dubey, Zayn Ibad Khan and Monalisa in lead roles.
plot:
A Daayan named Kaamini gives birth to a child fathered by Ravikant Pratap Singh and proclaims him as "Daavansh", the one who holds the key to her immortality. Meanwhile, a girl is born as a "Reevavanshi", the chosen one destined to destroy the Daavansh and the entire Daayan community. A wise woman (Prathamvanshi) from "Prathamvansh" prophesies that this girl will bring about their downfall.
Fearing for her daughter's safety, the girl's mother names her Gauri, strips her of her powers, and buries them, knowing they will return to her when the time is right. To protect Gauri from the Daayans, she entrusts her to the river, believing that divine forces will safeguard her. Enraged, Kaamini kills Gauri's parents.
Meanwhile, Ravikant invites Kaamini to meet their son, Vihaan, but his wife, Veena Pratap Singh, seizes the baby and escapes using magical crystals given by the Reevavanshis. In revenge, Kaamini kills Ravikant. However, Veena manages to trap Kaamini, turning her into a statue using the magical crystals. Before being petrified, Kaamini warns that her son, Vihaan, will inherit her powers and one day resurrect her. Veena raises Vihaan as her own, determined to protect him from his dark destiny.
Gauri, on the other hand, is found and adopted by a poor man whose wife, Rekha, refuses to accept her. Gauri grows up unaware of her powers and becomes the breadwinner of the family as a taxi driver. Rekha, who works as a dancer at wedding halls, pressures Gauri to follow in her footsteps, but Gauri dreams of independence and wants her intelligent foster sister, Charu, to study at a prestigious college.
Vihaan, aware of his powers but unable to control them, wears a bangle infused with magical crystals to suppress them. He longs to uncover the truth about his abilities, but Veena is determined to keep him in the dark.
On the night of Kaal Sapt Grahan, Vihaan senses that his powers will surge and leaves home. However, one of the Tridayans— three powerful Daayans tied to the Kaal Vriksha— attacks him. Vihaan narrowly escapes and crosses paths with Gauri. Overwhelmed by his uncontrolled powers, he accidentally harms her. As soon as the Kaal Sapt Grahan ends, he erases her memory and disappears. But his bangle is left with Gauri. Later when she goes to Vihaan's house to return it, she is insulted by Veena about her job.

But failed in her attempt. At a time, Vihaan enslaved her and Gauri unknown of her powers kills Sunehri. Vihaan and family think that Vihaan killed the dayan and he erases Gauri's memory again.
Subsequently Gauri falls in love with Vihaan and not able to confess it. Gauri's Rakshini (Siya) and Bhavishyta (Charu) are introduced. The Maha Dayan Kaamini's arrival brings fear and shock within the Singhs'. Kamini subdued Vihaan and tries to convert him into Davansh. She tries her best but failed by Gauri. Gauri is revealed as Rishwa and by the help of Rish Dhanush, she kills Kaamini.
Gauri is in coma. Vihaan is given an appearance by Lord Shiva and he is not Davansh any more. He prays for Gauri and she is out of coma. Gauri is welcomed by the family. Later on, Kaamini's spirit reveals the death of her parents. Gauri with the help off magical ring sees that Veena was the one who told the way to her parents to Kaamini. Gauri questions Veena but she denies. Infuriated Vihaan throws Gauri out of his house. In parallel scenes, a Vihaan's parallel self is shown as evil minded and a dayan with fire as a magic revealed as Gauri's twin sister named Kesar is shown. She does not have control of her powers. Her life resides in a woodpecker enslaved by her evil guardians.
Vihaan stays with Gauri at her tenement after she refuses to go to his house. Later, a sinister force sent by Daavansh Vihaan draws Gauri into Pratham Tantra. Maha Daayan Mohana awakens, seeking revenge for Kamini's death and posing a threat to Vihaan's family. Later, Gauri uses her powers to protect Vihaan from Mohana's attack. Daavansh constantly follows Kesar and eventually saves her from the villagers by marrying her. But in reality it was his trap for her to become more powerful, the more powerful he becomes the more weak Vihaan would feel. Gauri along with Arjun tries to find Davaansh and succeeds. Daavansh along with Kesar completes his marriage rituals under the Prathamvriksh to expand his powers. Gauri tries to kill him and sends Arjun to prevent Kesar from offering flowers to the well.
Mohana sends Betalini to kill Vihaan but she failed. Kesar is shown to know the truth of Daavansh and tries to kill him. But using the dark thread Daavansh reunites with Vihaan as himself as dominant one. Gauri to save Vihaan and her family sacrifices her Rishwa powers in form of Rishwa mani to Mohana. Kesar is killed by Mohana, and she took all her fire powers to kill her elder sister Rishwa. Betalini who is in love with Harsh helps him to know the dark plans of Mohana. He alerted the whole family and Gauri about it. Prathamvanshi alerted Gauri that on the 25th birthday of Vihaan on completing the death rituals of his family and then Rishwa he would completely be converted to Daavansh. Gauri tries to find her powers. Eventually, Daavansh started the rituals. Gauri with the help of Prathamvanshis delay the rituals and prevent the earth from destruction. Later on, Harsh, Siya and Arjun found that the ring of Kesar given by her to Harsh while dying that belonged to her sister would itself find the new owner. Gauri while fighting with Mohana gets injured and gets owned by the ring. In her dream she was explained everything by Kesar. Gauri gets new powers of Rishwa mani and kills Mohana. On the other side, Vihaan killed the other family members and was on the way to kill Gauri. Gauri and Siya were heartbroken when they saw the dead bodies of family members. Gauri decided to fight against the Daavansh using her powers. Later Gauri surrenders herself to Daavansh and Daavansh hurts her using Agnishastra. Gauri during her exile to death brings back the Vihaan and Daavansh disappears. Siya brings back the life of every family member using the ring of Reevavanshies. Then they found that Gauri was going to die. She creates a shield so that nobody could halt her from dying. Then Gauri falls off from the cliff and presumed to be died by everyone.
Three years later, on the birthday of Vihaan, family decides to organise a party but saddened Vihaan destroys it and recalls the memory of Gauri. Gauri is still alive living in a hut far away from Vihaan. She has a toddler of her and Vihaan who has all Daavansh powers. Mohana and other Daayans are in search of him, but he fools all of them.

title: Jamai No. 1
summary: Jamai No. 1 (transl. Son in-law Number 1) is an Indian television series which aired from 9 December 2024 to 31 August 2025 on Zee TV. It was produced by Studio LSD Private Limited and it starred Simaran Kaur and Abhishek Malik in the lead roles.

title: Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile
summary: Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile (transl. We Met Knowingly or Unknowingly) is an Indian Hindi-language television family drama series that premiered on 11 November 2024 to 16 August 2026 on Zee TV and streams digitally on Zee 5. Produced by Sonnal A. Kakar and Goldie Behl under Rose Audio Visuals Pvt. Ltd, the series starres Ayushi Khurana, Bharat Ahlawat and Jayati Bhatia.
plot: Reet, a fiercely independent reporter, and Raghav, a temperamental man, wed under the traditional 'Aata Sata' custom as they are bound by love for their siblings.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Ayushi Khurana as Reet Suryavanshi (née Chaudhary) — A reporter; Anuradha's daughter; Dhruv's sister; Raghav's wife (2024–2026) * Bharat Ahlawat as Raghav Suryavanshi — A businessman; Unnati's brother; Reet's husband (2024–2026) * Jayati Bhatia as Sharda Suryavanshi — Raghav and Unnati's aunt; Viren and Pratik's mother; Poonam and Divya'smother-in-law (2024–2026)

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: Screenwriter Sonnal Kakar developed the central plot of Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile based on Aata Saata (brides exchange) tradition, a cultural practice involving the reciprocal marriage of siblings.

articleSections.title: Premiere
articleSections.text: The series premiered on 11 November 2024, replacing Kundali Bhagya in its 9.30 p.m. slot.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The promo featuring Reet, an investigative journalist and Raghav, a volatile man - child released on October 2024.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Ayushi Khurana and Bharat Ahlawwat were confirmed to play Reet and Raghav. Jayati Bhatia was signed to play Sharda. In April 2025, Aasim Khan was reportedly confirmed to play Rohit. In May 2025, Bharat Narang joined the show as Sanju.

title: Jai Mahendran
summary: Jai Mahendran is an Indian Malayalam-language drama streaming television series directed by Srikanth Mohan and written by Rahul Riji Nair. Produced under First Print Studios, starring Saiju Kurup and  Miya George in lead roles. as Priya Mahendran. It premiered on SonyLIV on 11 October 2024.
reception: Latha Srinivasan of Hindustan Times and Anandu Suresh of The Indian Express reviewed the series. Akhila Menon of OTTPlay gave the series 3/5 stars.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series was announced on SonyLIV. The principal photography of the series commenced in April 2023. The filming was wrapped in June 2023. The trailer of the series was released on 28 September 2024.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The series was initially scheduled to release on 9 February 2024, but was later moved to 11 October 2024.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: Latha Srinivasan of Hindustan Times and Anandu Suresh of The Indian Express reviewed the series. Akhila Menon of OTTPlay gave the series 3/5 stars.

episodesList.title: Episode 1
episodesList.summary: Mahendran, the deputy tehsildar, agrees to help Joseph, a man facing legal issues due a name mismatch in his mother's documents, upon learning that he is a close friend of a Member of Parliament. Meanwhile, the impending monsoon leads to concerns with the public over a dam that may breach due to heavy rainfall.

episodesList.title: Episode 2
episodesList.summary: Mahendran asks Biju to create a certificate that would help the old lady but not be used as a political weapon against him. Meanwhile, the office employees bid farewell to Tehsildar Shibu, who is replaced by Tehsildar Shobha, who has a different way of running things.

episodesList.title: Episode 3
episodesList.summary: Mahendran is displeased with Shobha's posting, as Prajas approaches him pledging to forget his political affiliation and join Mahendran's union if he is relieved from control room duty. Meanwhile, Shobha notices that Mahendran is not in office and marks a half-day against his attendance, infuriating him.

episodesList.title: Episode 4
episodesList.summary: The news of Mahendran and Shobha's suspension creates headlines in the media. While Shobha is devastated, Mahendran looks for support from his political party. However, the leaders wash their hands off the scandal and tell him there's nothing they can do for him.

episodesList.title: Episode 5
episodesList.summary: Biju agrees to help Mahendran when he realises that the only way to trap those responsible for the scandal is to investigate the land document records. When news of the corruption in the land distributed to the 48 families breaks, Aravindan is pressured to find out how the files were leaked. Meanwhile, Unni tells Shobha that it would be easier to pay the bribe than expect a fair investigation.

episodesList.title: Episode 6
episodesList.summary: After joining hands with Shobha to clear both their names, Mahendran meets with the leader of the opposite faction of the ruling party. Later, at a protest, Harichandran is attacked by goons who disguised themselves as the minister's supporters.

title: Jagriti: Ek Nayi Subah
summary: Jagriti: Ek Nayi Subah is an Indian Hindi-language television drama series that aired from 16 September 2024 to 11 January 2026 on Zee TV. It was produced by Gurodev Bhalla under Gurodev Bhalla Productions, it starred Rachana Mistry and Vijayendra Kumeria in lead roles.
plot:
The show explores themes of social injustice, discrimination, courage, and the pursuit of a better future, revolving around the life of Jagriti, a young girl from the marginalized "Chitta" community in the fictional town of Mokshgarh, Jharkhand. The Chitta community is unjustly branded as 'criminal' from birth by the oppressive and powerful landlord Kalikant Thakur. The community is denied basic rights, including education, and is forced into a life of crime and labor.
The story begins with seven-year-old Jagriti, who bravely questions the injustices faced by her people. She refuses to accept the societal branding and the tyrannical rule of Kalikant Thakur. Her relentless quest for dignity and rights for her community often puts her in conflict with the landlord and his authority.
After a traumatic childhood, Jagriti has been adopted into a wealthy family and has forgotten her past. She has now dedicated herself to becoming an IPS Officer, aspiring to fight for justice and make a difference in society.
In college, Jagriti clashes frequently with Suraj Thakur, the arrogant elder son of powerful landlord Kalikant Thakur. Despite their ongoing rivalry, there's an underlying tension between them. Jagriti, however, falls in love with Akash Thakur, Suraj’s younger brother, and they are set to marry. On the day of the wedding, Sapna, who has loved Akash since childhood, switches places with Jagriti. As a result, Sapna marries Akash, and Jagriti unknowingly marries Suraj.
Shortly after, Akash, enraged by the switch, attempts to force himself on Jagriti, but Suraj intervenes and saves her. This marks a turning point in Jagriti’s perception of Suraj. In the aftermath, as she begins to unravel buried memories, Jagriti gradually rediscovers her true identity and her roots in the Chitta community.
Determined to fight the injustice she was born into, she sets her sights on becoming an IPS officer. Suraj undergoes a dramatic transformation, turning against his corrupt father and becoming Jagriti’s strongest supporter. With his help, she clears the UPSC exam and returns to Mokshgarh as a symbol of justice and reform. Upon her return, Jagriti arrests Kalikant Thakur and presents compelling evidence against him in court. During his transfer to another facility, Kalikant is shot by Akash and falls into a coma, intensifying the conflict.
Over time, the deep bond formed through shared struggle and trust blossoms into love. Jagriti and Suraj fall for each other only after she becomes an IPS officer. When Jagriti is targeted in a bomb attack, Suraj saves her life, cementing their emotional connection. They soon remarry, this time by choice and mutual love.
After their remarriage, Jagriti and Suraj’s relationship faces turmoil when Sapna claims she is pregnant with Suraj’s child. Unknown to others, Akash is the real father and is blackmailing Sapna, threatening to kill the unborn child if she reveals the truth. Jagriti and Suraj eventually uncovers the deception, exposes Akash, and confirms the child’s true paternity. The revelation strengthens their bond and further isolates Akash.
Meanwhile, a major twist unfolds when Kalikant Thakur, previously in a coma, regains consciousness. To regain control over his empire without drawing suspicion, he kills his twin brother, Shashikant, and assumes his identity. Operating from the shadows, Kalikant resumes his manipulation and schemes, further endangering Jagriti’s mission and reigniting conflict in Mokshgarh.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Rachana Mistry as IPS Jagriti "Jaggu" Thakur (née Bahl) — Geeta and Harish's daughter; Bhairav's adopted daughter; Sapna's half-sister; Rohan's adopted sister; Akash's childhood friend and ex-fiancée; Suraj's wife (2025–2026) **Asmi Deo as young Jagriti (2024–2025) *Vijayendra Kumeria as Suraj Thakur: Ganga and Kalikant's elder son; Kalindi's step-son; Akash's brother; Avni and Arjun's half-brother; Sapna's ex-fiancé; Jagriti's husband (2025–2026) **Aalok Shaw as young Suraj (2024–2025)

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Namish Taneja was first approached for the role of Suraj but was replaced by Vijayendra Kumeria. In February 2025, the show took a 17 years leap, Akash played by Sagar Parekh, and Suraj played by Vijayendra Kumeria. Aarya Babbar joined the cast, marking his television comeback after 8 year.

episodesList.title: Jagriti is Born to Change The Future Of Chitta Community
episodesList.summary: Kalikant rules the Chitta community of Mokshgarh. Harish's pregnant lover Geeta flees her home and comes to him. Fearing Kalikant, Harish takes her out of Mokshgarh and she gives birth to a baby girl.

episodesList.title: A Seven-year-old Jagriti Goes For Hunting
episodesList.summary: Harish separates from Geeta to save Jagriti. The police register Jagriti's name and Constable Pandey predicts her future. Seven years later, Jagriti goes for her first hunt and returns with an animal.

episodesList.title: Durjan Announces His Heir
episodesList.summary: Golu tells Durjan something and the latter forces Jagriti to take up weapons. However, instead of shooting the rabbit, Jagriti drives it away. Later, Durjan announces his heir, which shocks everyone.

episodesList.title: Jagriti and Akash Become Friends
episodesList.summary: Jagriti saves a rabbit's life from Golu. Kalikant's son, Akash, and Jagriti become friends. Jagriti gives the rabbit to Akash for its safety. Durjan puts a condition in front of Harish for liquor.

episodesList.title: Durjan's Condition For Harish's Treatment
episodesList.summary: Jagriti uses her wit to fulfil Durjan's condition. Nanda disallows Harish's treatment despite his deteriorating condition. Jagriti accepts Durjan's condition to earn INR 100 per day for the treatment.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Finds a Way to Earn Money
episodesList.summary: Jagriti refuses to sell her mother's anklets for money. Later, she finds a way to earn money. After hearing about Jagriti, Harish sets out to find her. Jagriti climbs a tree to remove a beehive.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Fails to Earn Money
episodesList.summary: Golu and his friends aim at the beehive and fall victim to the bees. The hive falls into the fire and gets destroyed. Harish comes there, but his condition deteriorates, and Jagriti brings him home.

episodesList.title: Harish Gives Up Alcohol For Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Jagriti agrees to become a Chitta. Nanda tries to feed Jagriti non-vegetarian food, but Harish stops her. He talks about earning money and quits alcohol. Harish and Jagriti spend time together.

episodesList.title: Harish Falls Into an Abyss Due to Ballu's Ploy
episodesList.summary: Solanki tells Kalikant that Geeta is returning to Mokshagarh with her husband and daughter. Ballu seeks Kalikant's help and plots to kill Harish at his behest. Later, Harish falls into an abyss.

episodesList.title: Kalikant's Wife Tells Jagriti The Importance Of Freedom
episodesList.summary: Harish's friend and Jagriti rescue Harish and bring him to Basti. Jagriti catches a bird and tries to sell it for Harish's treatment. Kalikant's wife explains the importance of freedom to Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Will Jagriti Accept Defeat?
episodesList.summary: Kalikant learns from Jagriti that Harish is alive. He gets angry at Durjan's actions and shares his concern with his mother. Jagriti decides to hunt to arrange money, and Akash calls her a liar.

episodesList.title: Akash Shows Jagriti a Way to Earn Money
episodesList.summary: Durjan tells Kalikant that he wants to make Jagriti the best Chitta. Meanwhile, Akash shows Jagriti a way to earn money. Geeta and her daughter Sapna arrive while Jagriti tries to sell fruits.
