episodesList.title: Jagriti Fulfils Durjan's Condition
episodesList.summary: Geeta buys all of Jagriti's fruits and pays her INR 100, and later, Jagriti gives the money to Durjan. Furthermore, Jagriti tells Harish how she earned the money and asks Bindi about her mother.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Frees The Birds, But Ends Up Caged Herself
episodesList.summary: Durjan is worried about Kalikant's anger and talks to Nanda about Jagriti. Jagriti lets the birds in the cage fly away. Angered by this, Nanda locks her in the cage.

episodesList.title: Jagriti's Promise to a Few Birds
episodesList.summary: Mangala stops Bindi from helping Jagriti. Kachori saves Jagriti from a snake. Jagriti cages the birds again and makes a promise to them. As per the condition, Nanda is forced to release Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Surya Tries to Stop Jagriti From Selling Fruits
episodesList.summary: Golu and his friends drive away Jagriti's customers. Akash saves Jagriti from Suraj's anger. Surya tries a trick to stop Jagriti from selling her fruits. However, a few school kids buy the fruits.

episodesList.title: Geeta Learns Jagriti is From The Chitta Community
episodesList.summary: Durjan hatches a plan against Jagriti. Jagriti returns Geeta's money and tells her that she belongs to the Chitta community. A cop talks about punishing Jagriti, but Geeta intervenes.

episodesList.title: Geeta Inspires Jagriti to Get Educated
episodesList.summary: Geeta saves Jagriti from the inspector and later inspires her to get educated. Jagriti tells everyone in her community the importance of education. Durjan feels perplexed after hearing this.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Decides to Introduce Harish to Geeta
episodesList.summary: Bindi worries about Jagriti and Harish asks her to forget her dream to study. Durjan burns Nanda's hand for her words. Jagriti makes a wheelchair for Harish to introduce him to Geeta.

episodesList.title: The Principal Sets a Condition For Jagriti's Admission
episodesList.summary: Durjan threatens Harish. Jagriti takes Harish to meet Geeta, but the latter does not arrive. The principal puts forth a condition when Harish requests him to admit Jagriti to the school.

episodesList.title: The News Of Jagriti's Admission Angers Kalikant
episodesList.summary: The principal tells Kalikant that Harish visited him for Jagriti's admission. Kalikant calls Durjan to the mansion and teaches him a lesson. Later, Kalikant tells Avadhesh that Geeta has met Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Will Jagriti's Dream Of Going to School Come True?
episodesList.summary: Durjan gives Jagriti a blank paper signed by Kalikant and tells Nanda about Kalikant's order. Later, Jagriti prepares to go to school. Suddenly, Kalikant comes to shantytown with his men.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Takes Jagriti Away
episodesList.summary: Kalikant and his men forcibly take Jagriti away. He is happy that he has an upper hand on Solanki. After seeing Geeta, Jagriti calls her for help. Harish decides to bring Jagriti back.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Gets Jagriti Locked In The Cowshed
episodesList.summary: Kalikant gets Jagriti locked in the cow shed. Harish remains headstrong about his decision to save Jagriti, and Raka supports him. Akash tries to help Jagriti, but Ganga stops him.

episodesList.title: Harish and Jagriti Try to Flee Mokshgarh
episodesList.summary: Geeta looks for Jagriti in the jungle. Soon, Harish also comes there. Raka rescues Jagriti from Kalikant's cowshed and tries to help Harish and Jagriti flee Mokshgarh, but they fall into his clutches.

episodesList.title: Will Amol Help Jagriti?
episodesList.summary: Kalikant tries to kill Harish. SP Amol arrives, and Jagriti seeks his help. Kalikant tries unsuccessfully to bribe Amol. Meanwhile, Avadhesh warns Geeta to stay away from Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Amol's Reality is Exposed
episodesList.summary: Amol and Kalikant strike a deal, and Jagriti is shocked to see them shaking hands. Geeta decides to focus on her work. Kalikant puts forth a condition to Jagriti for earning money.

episodesList.title: Akash Makes a Promise to Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Akash promises to help Jagriti get educated. Avadhesh visits Kalikant's mansion with his wife and Sapna. Geeta comes to the court as a judge and sentences Raka, who has arrived as an accused.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Reveals Jagriti's Truth to Avadhesh
episodesList.summary: Bindi and Ratna are shocked to see Geeta in court. Kalikant threatens Avadhesh and reveals about his relationship with Jagriti. Ratna forbids Bindi from telling Harish about Geeta's return.

episodesList.title: Sapna's False Accusations Against Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Nanda punishes Bindi and Ratna and later puts forth a condition for Bindi. Sapna falsely accuses and punishes Jagriti. Akash makes a promise to Jagriti, while Kalikant's mother assigns her a task.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Fulfils The Condition
episodesList.summary: Jagriti fulfils the condition by milking a cow and asks Kalikant for money. Kalikant's mother gives her a special coin instead. Jagriti takes it and leaves for her home, and Kalikant learns about it.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Returns to Her Settlement
episodesList.summary: Kalikant's mother explains her decision to him. Jagriti returns home and questions Bindi about breaking Harish's wheelchair. She gives Durjan the mansion coin and tells Harish that she will study.

episodesList.title: Kalikant's Mother Tortures Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Amol fights with Geeta. Bindi lies to Geeta that Jagriti is her daughter. Kalikant’s mother tortures Jagriti on the pretext of purification, and Ganga advises Akash to empower Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Arrives At Akash's School
episodesList.summary: Bindi tells Durjan about Geeta, and he questions Kalikant. Kalikant advises Durjan on how to keep Geeta away from Harish and Jagriti. Akash forgets his tiffin, and Jagriti takes it to school for him.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Gets Angry When Jagriti Goes to School
episodesList.summary: At school, Jagriti helps Akash. Nanda and Durjan discuss marriage with Bindi and Harish separately. Kalikant plans to punish Jagriti for going to school. Kalikant’s mother assigns Jagriti a task.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Learns About Harish and Bindi's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Akash scolds Jagriti when she seeks his help. Jagriti clears Kalikant and others' doubts about the school incident. Later, she learns about Harish and Bindi's wedding and rushes to stop it.

episodesList.title: Bindi and Harish's Haldi Ceremony Takes Place
episodesList.summary: Jagriti tells Kalikant’s mother that she has completed her task. She narrowly avoids being hit by Amol’s car, and he ogles at Bindi. Later, Bindi and Harish's haldi ceremony takes place.

episodesList.title: Akash Outsmarts Durjan
episodesList.summary: Ganga finds pillows in Akash's place on his bed. Kachori shows Jagriti what a stepmother can be like. Akash meets Jagriti, and she hides him from Durjan's sight. Akash cleverly escapes Durjan.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Burns Jagriti's Slate
episodesList.summary: Jagriti fixes Harish's wheelchair. Geeta and Kalikant have a confrontation. Jagriti sits to study with Akash and Suraj. When Kalikant gets angry, Ganga intervenes, but he has her burn Jagriti's slate.

episodesList.title: Amol's Plan to have Bindi
episodesList.summary: Jagriti tells Akash that she doesn't like to study secretly. Amol discovers that Bindi is unmarried and decides to have her with Jagriti's help. Meanwhile, Jagriti contemplates learning from Geeta.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Fires a Gun At Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Raka's wife Ratna gives birth to a son, and Durjan takes him to Kalikant. When Jagriti opposes Kalikant's ritual, he fires a gun at her. Akash gets angry due to Kalikant's actions.

episodesList.title: Will Jagriti be Able to Save The Chittas' Name?
episodesList.summary: Bindi promises Jagriti that she won't marry Harish until she accepts her as her mother. Jagriti and Akash enter the police station to steal the false documents against the Chitta community.

episodesList.title: Akash and Jagriti Escape The Police
episodesList.summary: Jagriti and Akash escape from the police station and realise that they got the wrong files. Kalikant gives his mother the actual files. Akash tries to get them and tells Jagriti about their contents.

episodesList.title: The Police Arrest Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Jagriti tries to burn the Chittas' file, but Kalikant arrives. Later, the police arrest Jagriti on false theft charges. Kalikant punishes Akash for supporting Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Geeta Helps Bindi
episodesList.summary: The inspector tells Bindi what she needs to do to free Jagriti. While Amol waits for Bindi, Geeta arrives there. Geeta gets Jagriti out of the lockup, and then faces Harish.

episodesList.title: Geeta Announces Her Decision In Jagriti's Case
episodesList.summary: Kalikant gets angry at Amol as Geeta decides to send Jagriti to a juvenile home and files an FIR against her. The juvenile home's vehicle meets with an accident, and Harish and Bindi get into a fight.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Asks Amol to Kill Jagriti
episodesList.summary: As advised by Sadhu, Jagriti treats a little goat. Geeta goes to the police station after learning about Jagriti. Amol lies to her about Jagriti's escape. Kalikant asks Amol to shoot Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Visits The Police to Help Jhunki Get Justice
episodesList.summary: Inspector Singh intimidates the slum dwellers. Bindi has a bad dream. Geeta, Bindi, and Harish look for Jagriti. At Sadhu's advice, Jagriti visits the police to seek justice for Jhunki, a goat's kid.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Arrives At The Juvenile Home
episodesList.summary: Jagriti arrives at the juvenile home, where a girl named Shivani harasses her. Harish and Bindi come in disguise to help Jagriti flee, but Jagriti decides to follow Geeta's advice and go to court.

episodesList.title: The Hearing For Jagriti's Case Begins
episodesList.summary: In the court, Ibaadat empowers Jagriti. Amol is shocked to see Geeta there. Harish has a scary dream. Jagriti defends herself, and upon hearing her argument, Kalikant's lawyer pretends to fall ill.

episodesList.title: Ballu Tries to Kill Jagriti At Kalikant's Orders
episodesList.summary: Harish runs into Geeta at the court. Kalikant asks Ballu to kill Jagriti and tells Harish to protect her. Geeta worries for Jagriti's safety due to her absence. Harish saves Jagriti from Ballu.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Gets to The Court With Akash's Help
episodesList.summary: Akash and a few Chittu community kids help Jagriti escape Ballu to get to the court. At Geeta's orders, Kalikant also comes to court. Geeta takes care of Jagriti’s injuries, and the hearing begins.

episodesList.title: Court's Decision In Jagriti's Case
episodesList.summary: Based on Jagriti's testimony, Geeta conducts a search operation at the mansion, but Akash lies on camera. Harish too testifies in Kalikant's favour, but Geeta gives the verdict in Jagriti's favour.

episodesList.title: Geeta Questions Harish After Hearing Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Jagriti introduces herself to Geeta. She tells Harish and Bindi she wants to become a judge like Geeta. Jagriti says something about her birth that makes Geeta ask Harish if Jagriti is their daughter.

episodesList.title: Harish Decides to Marry Bindi Soon
episodesList.summary: Jagriti thanks Akash and, upon returning to the shantytown, forgives Durjan as well. Geeta suspects that Jagriti is her daughter. Jagriti finds a phone. Harish decides to marry Bindi the next day.

episodesList.title: Akash Learns a Big Truth
episodesList.summary: Amol's words scare Geeta. Akash tells Jagriti that she has found Geeta's phone. When it turns on, Akash finds that Jagriti is Geeta's daughter, and Akash informs Ganga. Kalikant announces a decision.

episodesList.title: Akash Tells Jagriti The Truth
episodesList.summary: Harish and Bindi's wedding rituals begin. Kalikant provokes Amol with a video of Geeta and Harish. Akash tells Jagriti that she is Geeta's daughter, prompting Jagriti to run to stop the wedding.

episodesList.title: Will Geeta Lose Her Life While Saving Jagriti?
episodesList.summary: Harish and Bindi's wedding rituals take place. Jagriti arrives and reveals how she discovered the truth. Owing to Amol's conspiracy, Geeta falls prey to a bomb blast while trying to save Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Decides to Observe a Fast On Chhath
episodesList.summary: Harish arrives at the accident site and rushes Geeta to the hospital. Amol learns about this and takes Geeta home. A distressed Jagriti decides to observe a Chhath fast for Geeta's well-being.

episodesList.title: Amol's Reality is Revealed to Harish
episodesList.summary: Bindi tries to stop Jagriti from fasting, but Jagriti convinces her to let her fast. Amol attempts to kill Geeta, but nothing untoward happens. Harish witnesses everything in hiding.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Starves Due to Golu's Actions
episodesList.summary: Harish tricks Amol. After learning about Golu's misdeed, Jagriti ensures Kachauri doesn't have the spiked food. Durjan stops Ballu from disrupting the fast. Akash informs Ganga about Jagriti's fast.

episodesList.title: Ganga Explains The Chhath Puja Rituals to Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Ganga sends Gangajal to Jagriti through Akash, which Jagriti uses for the Nahay-Khay ritual. Avadhesh and Sujata come to see Jagriti. Later, Ganga explains the next rituals of Chhath Puja to Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Avadhesh Brings Jagriti to Geeta
episodesList.summary: Avadhesh learns that Jagriti has observed a Chhath fast for Geeta. He takes Jagriti to Geeta and gives her money to prepare for the fast. Amol returns home drunk and fights with Avadhesh and Sujata.

episodesList.title: Amol Threatens to Expose Geeta
episodesList.summary: Avadhesh slaps Amol for his actions. Ganga assists Jagruti over the phone. Amol threatens to expose Geeta’s past to the media, and Sapna pushes Jagriti as she comes to tie a thread to Geeta.

episodesList.title: Sujata's Request to Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Sujata requests Jagriti to go away from Geeta and keep the truth hidden. Jagriti ties the sacred thread to Geeta and leaves. Later, she imagines everyone cursing her, and Geeta coming to her rescue.

episodesList.title: Everyone Performs The Chhath Mata Puja
episodesList.summary: Jagriti and the villagers go to the ghats. Kalikant fails to stop them from performing puja due to Madan Chaddha. Jagriti stays in the water until Geeta arrives and Geeta regains consciousness.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Completes The Chhath Mata Fast
episodesList.summary: Geeta meets Jagriti at the ghat. Jagriti completes her fast but does not reveal the truth to Geeta. Harish asks Jagriti the reason behind it, while Akash urges Ganga to tell Geeta the truth.

episodesList.title: Geeta is Accused Of Bribery
episodesList.summary: Akash urges Jagriti to tell the truth to Geeta. Later, Geeta questions Jagriti's marital status on seeing Bindi, but Harish answers her. Geeta is accused of bribery, leading to a raid at her house.

episodesList.title: Bindi Makes a Deal With Amol
episodesList.summary: Geeta is suspended on charges of bribery. To stop Jagriti and Geeta from uniting, Bindi makes a deal with Amol. Kalikant orders the Chitta community to do illegal work in order to become a minister.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Sends Geeta Away
episodesList.summary: A problem arises with Jagriti's admission to school. To meet Kalikant's demand, Harish sets a condition before Durjan. Geeta comes to the chawl, but Jagriti, instigated by Bindi, asks her to leave.

episodesList.title: Bindi Asks Jagriti to Address Her As Mother
episodesList.summary: Geeta learns that Harish took her to the hospital and assigns a task to the constables. Bindi recalls Amol's words and asks Jagriti to address her as her mother, but Harish bluntly responds to Bindi.

episodesList.title: Will Kalikant's Ploy Get Foiled?
episodesList.summary: Jagriti addresses Bindi as her mother. Soon, the reason behind this is revealed. Due to Kalikant's ploy, Akash and other kids at school oppose Jagriti studying with them, but the tables begin to turn.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Accepts Kalikant's Decision
episodesList.summary: Bindi visits Geeta's house looking for Jagriti. Kalikant announces his decision. Geeta opposes it, but Jagriti accepts Kalikant's decision. Kalikant tells the school principal about the next plan.

episodesList.title: Harish Reveals Amol's Reality to Geeta
episodesList.summary: Geeta talks to Harish, and Kalikant sends their recorded video to Amol. At school, a teacher tests Jagriti. Harish warns Geeta that Amol poses a threat to her. Jagriti is locked in the classroom.

episodesList.title: Amol's Ploy Against Geeta
episodesList.summary: Sapna calls Geeta to the school. Using water, Jagriti frees herself. Amol tells Bindi a plan against Geeta. At school, Geeta looks for Sapna, and Harish looks for Jagriti. Sapna gets angry with Geeta.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Teaches Sapna a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Geeta gets injured because of Sapna, and Jagriti cannot tolerate it. At Amol's behest, Bindi takes Harish's phone to him. Jagriti teaches Sapna a lesson. Later, Harish sees his phone with Bindi.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Learns About Geeta Leaving Mokshgarh
episodesList.summary: Bindi has a nightmare. Jagriti refuses to wear the uniform bought with the hunting money. The principal asks Jagriti to arrange for her fees. Later, Jagriti learns that Geeta is leaving Mokshgarh.

episodesList.title: Geeta Comes to The Shantytown to Confront Harish
episodesList.summary: Akash saves Jagriti from a few people at the school. When Geeta's character is questioned, she goes to the shantytown to confront Harish. Harish's behaviour fuels her anger, leading to a revelation.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Sets Out to Uncover The Truth
episodesList.summary: Geeta tells Jagriti about Harish's actions. Jagriti confronts Harish, learns the truth, and promises to prove his innocence to stop Geeta. Later, Jagriti and Akash follow Bindi, who meets Amol.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Brings The Truth In Front Of Geeta
episodesList.summary: Geeta's senior advises her to not leave Mokshgarh. Jagriti and Akash overhear Amol and Bindi. She comes up with an idea to show Geeta the truth via a video call. Amol forces himself on Bindi.

episodesList.title: Bindi Reveals The Truth About The Past to Geeta
episodesList.summary: Geeta discovers the whole truth through a video call. Harish rescues Jagriti from Amol and leaves him injured. Geeta prevents Bindi from taking her life, and Bindi tells her about the past.

episodesList.title: Geeta Hides The Fact That She Knows The Truth
episodesList.summary: Geeta cuddles Jagriti but doesn't tell anyone she knows the truth. Jagriti defends Bindi in front of Harish. Geeta reaches out to Amol. Durjan informs Kalikant about Amol's misdeeds.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Goes to Meet Amol
episodesList.summary: Kalikant confronts Amol. Geeta records their conversation, and Jagriti also listens. Geeta reveals that she will not leave Mokshgarh and later visits Jagriti. Akash comes to live in the shantytown.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Brings Akash to The Mansion
episodesList.summary: Akash tells Jagriti why he left the mansion. Geeta panics when she finds her phone with Amol. Kalikant makes a promise to Jagriti after she brings Akash home. Durjan informs everyone about this.

episodesList.title: Kalikant and Amol's Plan
episodesList.summary: Kalikant and Amol ask Ballu to remove Durjan, Jagriti and Geeta from the way. Bindi protects Geeta from getting caught by Jagriti and talks to her. Amol argues with Geeta and Swapna gets angry at him.

episodesList.title: The Children At School Tease Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Harish takes Jagriti to school. Durjan catches Ballu with a bomb. Geeta and Bindi talk about exposing Amol and Kalikant. The children at school tease Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Discovers Harish's Lie
episodesList.summary: Jagriti visits the mansion to help Akash and Harish's lie is exposed. She then saves Akash from the teacher's punishment. Amol plots against Geeta. At school, the children throw ink at Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Geeta is Humiliated In The Name Of Purification
episodesList.summary: People point fingers at Geeta outside school and some forcibly purify her. Jagriti tries to save Geeta from them, and Harish beats them up. Amol and Kalikant celebrate Geeta's humiliation.

episodesList.title: Geeta Makes a Revelation to Amol
episodesList.summary: Akash overhears Amol and Kalikant and visits Jagriti. It is revealed that Geeta is aware of Amol's misdeeds and informs him of this. She goes to the shantytown and asks Bindi to testify against Amol.

episodesList.title: Geeta Arrives At Kalikant's Mansion With Her Team
episodesList.summary: Duryodhan explains the consequences of Bindi testifying against Amol. Amol informs Kalikant that Geeta knows the truth and hides Nagesh in the mansion. Geeta arrives at the mansion with her team.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Avenges Geeta's Insult
episodesList.summary: Jagriti finds out where Nagesh is hiding in the mansion. With Akash's help, she avenges Geeta's insult and gets Nagesh arrested. Enraged by Akash's actions, Kalikant makes a decision.

episodesList.title: Jagriti is Suspicious Of Kalindi's Intentions
episodesList.summary: Akash and Suraj argue over Ganga. Geeta gets the truth out of Nagesh. Kalikant brings Madan and Kalindi to the mansion, and Jagriti suspects Kalindi. Kalikant gets Kalindi to apologise to Ganga.

episodesList.title: Sapna Gets Angry With Geeta
episodesList.summary: Kalindi accidentally sits on Kalikant's throne. Due to Amol's plan, Sapna gets angry with Geeta and narrowly escapes an accident. Harish saves Jagriti from Amol and beats him up.

episodesList.title: Sapna Forces Geeta to Make a Promise to Her
episodesList.summary: Amol informs Kalikant of the next plan against Geeta. Akash records their conversation but doesn't get caught due to Kalindi's actions. Sapna points a gun at her head to make Geeta promise something.

episodesList.title: Geeta Fails to Go to Court Because Of Sapna
episodesList.summary: Akash reveals Kalikant and Amol's ploy to Jagriti. Kalindi sleeps in Kalikant's room. Amol and Sapna stop Geeta from going to court. A new problem arises for Jagriti, and Geeta comes to the mansion.

episodesList.title: Geeta's Announcement At Kalikant's Press Conference
episodesList.summary: Geeta announces an essay competition at Kalikant's press conference. Jagriti realises what topic she should write about. Kalindi brings Jagriti to the mansion and manages Kalikant's anger.

episodesList.title: Geeta's Attempt to Gather Evidence Against Amol
episodesList.summary: Kalindi goes to watch the festival. Geeta tries to gather evidence against Amol, but Amol finds her camera. Jagriti promises Akash that she will bring the glorious history of the Chittas to the fore.

episodesList.title: Geeta Faces a Life-threatening Danger
episodesList.summary: Kalindi asks Kalikant to drink water from the shantytown. Geeta comes there and asks Jagriti to hide her. Inspector Singh comes to kill Geeta after getting evidence from her, but Harish saves her.

episodesList.title: Akash Falls Prey to Kalikant's Wrath
episodesList.summary: Kalindi explains to Kalikant the reason behind her behaviour. Geeta prepares food for Jagriti, and the latter makes Geeta's bed. Akash stands up for Ganga and faces Kalikant's wrath.

episodesList.title: Jagriti and Akash Take a Risk For Geeta
episodesList.summary: At Kalindi's behest, Kalikant spares Akash but makes Ganga apologise to Kalindi. Jagriti and Akash take a big risk to help Geeta. Kalikant panics upon seeing Kalindi on his bed.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Saves Geeta
episodesList.summary: Inspector Singh beats Harish and points a gun at him, but Geeta comes in his way. Thanks to Jagriti, Geeta's senior arrives in time and makes a decision. Amol comes and shows something to Kalikant.

episodesList.title: Amol's Pretence In Front Of Geeta
episodesList.summary: Kalikant sees Geeta's interview and manhandles Amol, while Kalindi makes a suggestion. Akash gives Jagriti some news. Sapna gets angry with Geeta. Jagriti observes Amol's pretence in front of Geeta.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Hears Amol's Plan and Steals The Evidence
episodesList.summary: Upon hearing Amol's plan against Kalikant and Geeta, Jagriti steals the evidence and meets Akash. Inspector Singh switches sides. Kalindi prepares Kalikant for the competition, and Geeta comes there.

episodesList.title: Akash and Jagriti Hide The Evidence
episodesList.summary: Akash and Jagriti hide the evidence. Suraj gives Sapna a new essay to humiliate Geeta. Kalindi asks Inspector Singh to find the evidence. At her behest, Gayatri questions Akash about the evidence.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Abandons The Competition In Pursuit Of The Evidence
episodesList.summary: Sapna reads an essay on stepmother that Akash and Jagriti have changed. Inspector Singh looks for the evidence, but Kachori helps the calf flee. Jagriti leaves the competition to catch it with Harish.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Narrates The Chittas' Glorious Tales
episodesList.summary: Jagriti hides the evidence and Kalikant's goons take away the calf. Kalikant points a gun at Inspector Singh, who then exposes Amol's conspiracy. Later, Jagriti begins reciting her essay on stage.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Recites Her Essay
episodesList.summary: Jagriti recites her essay and the results are announced later. She requests her prize to be given to the Chittas' annual festival. After hearing Ballu, Kalikant realises that Harish has the proof.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Plans to Burn Down The Chittas' Settlement
episodesList.summary: Ballu steals the evidence bag from Harish's house. Durjan expresses his concern about the impending trouble. When the bag turns out to contain just trash, Kalikant decides to burn down the settlement.

episodesList.title: Kachori Discovers Ballu's Plan
episodesList.summary: Kalikanth arrives at the community festival with the Home Minister and Kalindi. Geeta also arrives there with Sapna and a secret plan. Kachori discovers Ballu's plan to set the community on fire.

episodesList.title: Geeta Jumps Into The Fire to Save Jagriti
episodesList.summary: As soon as the fire breaks out in the shantytown, Kalikant leaves. Amol is worried for Sapna. Jagriti risks her life to save her. Geeta jumps into the fire to save Jagriti and calls her her daughter.

episodesList.title: The Shantytown Residents Discover Ballu's Misdeeds
episodesList.summary: Kalikant beats Ballu, but Gayatri handles the matter. Kachori tells Durjan about Ballu's misdeeds. Amol calls Kalikant and tells him that he has the evidence. Kalikant brings Ballu to the shantytown.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Lies to The Shantytown Residents
episodesList.summary: Kalikant lies to the shantytown residents. Harish goes to take revenge on Amol, and Geeta reasons with him. Geeta visits Amol with a gun. Kalindi advises Kalikant, who pretends to punish Ballu.

episodesList.title: Amol Gets Shot While Fighting With Harish
episodesList.summary: Kalikant leaves Ballu at Kalindi's behest. Amol makes Geeta write an affidavit by threatening to kill Sapna. Harish saves Geeta from Amol and while the two get into a scuffle, Amol gets shot.

episodesList.title: Did Amol Fall Prey to Someone's Ploy?
episodesList.summary: Inspector Singh arrests Harish and someone gives evidence to Kalindi. Akash says that someone else must have killed Amol. Sapna goes to Kalikant seeking justice and does not go back with Geeta.

episodesList.title: Akash Suspects Kalikant
episodesList.summary: Bindu, upon learning about Harish, goes to meet him. After hearing Kalikant's words, Gayatri warns him. Geeta waits for Sapna outside the mansion. Akash shares his suspicion about Kalikant with Ganga.

episodesList.title: Harish's Case Hearing Begins
episodesList.summary: Jagriti arrives at Amol's funeral, and Sapna gets angry. Later, Jagriti tells her community members that Geeta will deliver justice. The hearing of Harish's case begins, and Jagriti and Akash testify.

episodesList.title: Harish is Sentenced to Rigorous Imprisonment
episodesList.summary: Harish confesses to his crime. Geeta sentences him to 20 years of imprisonment and later visits him in jail. Ballu celebrates this. Akash shares his suspicions about Kalikant and Kalindi with Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Jagriti's Plan Against Kalindi
episodesList.summary: Geeta comes to live in the mansion. Ganga and Gayatri team up to reform Kalikant. As per their plan, Bindi disguises as Vandevi to scare Kalindi. Jagriti intervenes and brings her to the mansion.

episodesList.title: Bindi Frightens Kalindi Again
episodesList.summary: Kalindi asks Kalikant to burn the forest. Bindi, Jagriti and Akash scare her again. Geeta asks Ganga to break her silence against wrongdoings. Kalindi sends Ganga out and stays with Kalikant.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Decides to Marry Kalindi
episodesList.summary: At Kalikant's request, Durjan invokes Vandevi, and a revelation occurs. Kalikant decides to marry Kalindi. Durjan tells Kalindi a way to do penance, which helps Jagriti get some time.

episodesList.title: Geeta and Jagriti Suspect Ballu
episodesList.summary: Gayatri opposes Kalikant's decision. As a result, Jagriti intervenes and carries out the plan. Geeta investigates Amol's case and reaches a conclusion. Jagriti also starts suspecting Ballu.

episodesList.title: Suraj and Sapna Instigate Kachori
episodesList.summary: Madan asks Kalindi to marry Kalikant. Jagriti makes Kalindi observe a waterless fast, and Ganga also observes the fast. Suraj and Sapna instigate Kachori, who soon finds Ballu's buried gun.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Gets Proof Of Harish's Innocence
episodesList.summary: Kalindi fails to fast due to Jagriti's trick. Jagriti is upset when she does not get proof of Harish's innocence and cautions Kachori and Ballu. Jagriti gets a gun from Ballu and rushes to court.

episodesList.title: Jhumpa's Accusations Against Geeta
episodesList.summary: Akash helps Jagriti get to court. Geeta treats Jagriti's wounds, and Sapna comes to vent her anger. Kalikant asks Inspector Singh to kill Ballu, and Jhumpa makes serious accusations against Geeta.

episodesList.title: Geeta Asks Ballu to Become a Government Witness
episodesList.summary: Geeta gives Jagriti a task in which she takes Akash's help. She talks out to Sapna, but Kalikant incites her. Inspector Singh goes to kill Ballu. Geeta asks Ballu to become a government witness.

episodesList.title: Ballu is Sentenced to Rigorous Imprisonment
episodesList.summary: Ballu confesses to the crime, but fearing Kalindi's threat, he doesn't testify against Kalikant. The court acquits Harish. When Ballu is sentenced to prison, Kachori ends her friendship with Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Nanda Lashes Out At Harish
episodesList.summary: Nanda scolds Harish and fights with Durjan. Jagriti organises a competition between Ganga and Kalindi and warns Sapna. Geeta explains the importance of the national flag to everyone.

episodesList.title: Akash Records Kalindi's Conversation
episodesList.summary: Harish consoles Sapna, but she spits on him. Kalindi provokes Sapna and Harish talks to a saddened Geeta. Ganga gives a sharp reply to Kalikant's words. Akash records Kalindi's conversation.

episodesList.title: Sapna Refuses to Live With Geeta
episodesList.summary: Akash comes to show Jagriti a video of Kalindi, but he can't find the video on his phone. Sapna refuses to live with Geeta and Jagriti. Later, Kalindi tricks Sapna with her words.

episodesList.title: Harish and Geeta Prepare to Get Married
episodesList.summary: Jagriti convinces Geeta to marry Harish and announces it in the locality. Akash’s attempt to expose Kalindi is foiled. Kalikant learns about Harish and Geeta's plan to get married.

episodesList.title: Will Akash Go to Boarding School?
episodesList.summary: Kalindi punishes Akash by sending him to boarding school. Sapna agrees to Harish and Geeta's wedding for a reason that uncovers soon. Akash seeks Jagriti's help to avoid going to boarding school.

episodesList.title: Will Kalikant Destroy Chittas' Settlement?
episodesList.summary: Jagriti feels sad upon hearing about Akash. Kalikant plans to stop Harish and Geeta's wedding. The wedding rituals in the locality begin, and Kalikant's men arrive disguised as guests.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Kills People Of The Chitta Community
episodesList.summary: Kalikant’s men attack on the shantytown. Furthermore, Kalikant kills Durjan and Harish, and somebody shoots an arrow at Geeta and kills her. Sapna and Jagriti fight and their lives are endangered.

episodesList.title: Jagriti's New Journey Begins
episodesList.summary: Jagriti, who has become the adopted daughter of a wealthy businessman, has forgotten her past. To become an IPS officer, Jagriti joins a university, where Suraj and Akash also study.

episodesList.title: The Clash Between Suraj and Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Jagriti teaches Suraj a lesson for flaunting his wealth. Sapna saves Suraj from a trouble. Akash mistakes a girl named Jagriti for his Jagriti. Suraj then arrives to seek revenge on Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Suraj Challenges Jagriti
episodesList.summary: After seeing Jagriti confronting Suraj and his friends, Akash mistakes her for his friend Jagriti. Soon, Jagriti introduces herself to Akash. Suraj challenges Jagriti, and she accepts it.

episodesList.title: What is Akash's Motive?
episodesList.summary: Jagriti defeats Suraj in the competition. Akash tells Bindi his motive behind becoming Kalikant's heir. Jagriti saves Sapna from falling off the stairs. Kalikant assigns Suraj a responsibility.

episodesList.title: Jagriti's Tricky Questions to Kalikant
episodesList.summary: Jagriti tells Bhairav about the event organised by Kalikant in college. Suraj and his friends do something wrong, and Jagriti takes revenge. She asks Kalikant some tricky questions during his speech.

episodesList.title: Suraj Tries to Placate Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Jagriti gets emotional about her mother in front of Akash. Sapna tries to get closer to Akash. Akash's sketchbook ends up with Jagriti. Meanwhile, Suraj keeps apologising to Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Suraj's Ploy is Foiled Because Of Akash
episodesList.summary: Suraj reveals his true intentions regarding Jagriti to Sapna. Jagriti forgives Suraj, but his plan is thwarted by Akash. Suraj fights with Akash, and Jagriti discovers that they are brothers.

episodesList.title: The Pundit Makes a Prophecy In Front Of Kalikant
episodesList.summary: Kalikant punishes Suraj. Saket and Manisha tell Jagriti about Akash and Suraj. Meanwhile, Suraj lashes out at the press. The pundit tells Kalikant that a Chitta girl will become his daughter-in-law.

episodesList.title: Suraj Rushes Jagriti to The Hospital
episodesList.summary: The pundit sticks to his word. When Jagriti's condition deteriorates, Suraj takes her to the hospital. Akash tells Suraj about Kalikant's warning. Jagriti helps a Chitta girl but the goons abduct her.

episodesList.title: Suraj Helps Akash, Jagriti and Kajri
episodesList.summary: Akash and Jagriti fight the goons to save the Chitta girl, Kajri, but they get trapped. Suraj comes to their rescue. Kalikant lashes out at his goons and learns about Akash and Suraj's actions.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Contests College Elections Against Suraj
episodesList.summary: Suraj tells Ghungroo about his plan to win Sapna's love. Instead of helping Suraj in the college elections, Jagriti contests against him. Kalikant questions Akash and Suraj about Kajri.

episodesList.title: Jagriti and Akash Begin to Fall For Each Other
episodesList.summary: Jagriti tells Akash why she fears fire. Suraj tries to spoil Jagriti's speech by scaring her with fire. Later, Jagriti realises she is in love with Akash. Akash comes to Jagriti's house to meet her.

episodesList.title: Suraj Dishonestly Wins The College Election
episodesList.summary: Suraj wins the college election dishonestly. Even after discovering the truth, Jagriti does not expose him. Akash asks Jagriti to be his dance partner at the Jalsa Night, and Suraj hatches a plan.

episodesList.title: Suraj Foils Sapna's Plan For His Benefit
episodesList.summary: Sapna executes her plan to stop Jagriti from dancing with Akash. Suraj helps Jagriti and brings her to the party to complete his plan. Akash and Jagriti dance together.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Decides to Kill Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Owing to Sapna's ploy, Jagriti and Suraj earn the titles of college Queen and King. Kalikant sees them dancing and mistakes that Jagriti is from the Chitta community. He then decides to kill her soon.

episodesList.title: Akash Plans to Introduce Jagriti to Kalikant
episodesList.summary: Akash and Suraj stop Kalikant from shooting Jagriti. Later, Jagriti and Akash grow closer. Akash tells Jagriti to come to Mokshgarh to meet Kalikant and discusses it with Kalikant too.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Sees Glimpses Of Her Past At Kalikant's House
episodesList.summary: Jagriti and Akash come to Kalikant’s house, where she sees glimpses of her past. Akash introduces Jagriti to Kalikant. On seeing Jagriti, Ganga remembers Jagriti, who belonged to Chitta community.

episodesList.title: Jagriti is Hurt By Akash's Betrayal
episodesList.summary: Akash gives Kalikant a special gift on his birthday. Jagriti is hurt by Akash's betrayal. Akash humiliates her and throws her out of his house. Later, Jagriti reaches a temple and faints.

episodesList.title: Kachori and Bindi Bring Jagriti to Their Settlement
episodesList.summary: Jagriti meets Kachori and Bindi, and they bring her to their settlement. Akash feels sad after insulting Jagriti and misses her. Later, Suraj comes to the settlement and asks about Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Will Jagriti Accept Suraj's Proposal?
episodesList.summary: Suraj leaves for Ranchi with Jagriti and puts forth a proposal for her. Jagriti helps Suraj change the car tyre. Akash tells Bindi the reason behind breaking Jagriti's heart.

episodesList.title: Jagriti does Not Forgive Akash
episodesList.summary: Jagriti does not accept Suraj's proposal and does not forgive Akash. Later, Bindi tells a saddened Akash to tell Jagriti the truth. Suraj tries to provoke Jagriti to take revenge on Akash.

episodesList.title: Akash Pretends to be In Love With Sapna
episodesList.summary: Akash pretends to be in love with Sapna to forget Jagriti. Later, Jagriti learns about the fire that occurred in the Chitta settlement 12 years ago. An elderly woman prays for Suraj to find true love.

episodesList.title: Akash is Falsely Accused Of Harassment
episodesList.summary: In college, Ishani accuses Akash of harassment and has him arrested. Akash tells Kalikant that Suraj is behind this, but he doesn't believe him. Jagriti comes up with a plan to free Akash.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Gets Akash Released From Jail
episodesList.summary: Suraj sets a condition for Kalikant in exchange for getting Akash released from jail, which angers Kalikant. When Jagriti gets him released, he asks a question. Kalindi gives Kalikant a suggestion.

episodesList.title: Akash Tells Jagriti About His Motive
episodesList.summary: An intoxicated Suraj visits Jagriti to talk to her. Akash breaks up with Sapna, leaving her heartbroken. Later, he tells Jagriti his intentions to seek forgiveness, but Jagriti doesn't believe him.

episodesList.title: Suraj Professes His Love to Sapna
episodesList.summary: Akash reveals his reality to Jagriti, and she is stunned. Both hide when Kalikant arrives at the Chitta settlement. Suraj professes his love to Sapna. Later, Akash and Kalikant get into an argument.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Professes Her Love to Akash
episodesList.summary: After hearing Akash's words, Kalikant throws him out of the house. Suraj frightens Jagriti with fire, but Akash helps her feel better and tells Suraj his decision. Jagriti professes her love to Akash.

episodesList.title: Akash's and Suraj's Weddings to Happen Together
episodesList.summary: Kalikant tells Akash and Jagriti to get married within seven days. Sapna convinces Suraj for an early wedding. Kalikant decides to hold Akash's and Suraj's weddings together. The engagement begins.

episodesList.title: Akash and Jagriti Go to The Chitta Settlement
episodesList.summary: Akash promises Jagriti that he will be with her. Sapna exchanges the engagement rings. Before the engagement, Akash and Jagruti secretly go to Chitta settlement, and Suraj suspects their action.

episodesList.title: Bhairav Recalls Kalikant Killing His Wife
episodesList.summary: Bhairav recalls how Kalikant killed his wife Malti. Kalikant informs the family about Bhairav’s conditions for the marriage. Suraj visits Jagriti’s house with the ‘shagun’ and reveals Sapna’s deeds.

episodesList.title: Suraj Discovers Jagriti's Truth
episodesList.summary: Suraj finds out that Jagriti is the old little Jagriti from the Chitta settlement. He tells this to Kalikant but fails to prove it. Later, he hatches a plan to prevent Jagriti's marriage to Akash.

episodesList.title: Sapna Makes Her Move Amidst Suraj's Plan
episodesList.summary: Despite Ganga's warning, Akash meets Jagruti before the auspicious time. Suraj gives Jagruti a spiked juice, and she falls into a deep sleep. Sapna overhears Suraj's plan and makes a big move.

episodesList.title: Bhairav has Jagriti Seated In The Mandap With Suraj
episodesList.summary: Sapna sits in the mandap with Akash instead of Jagriti, which makes Bhairav suspect. Bhairav has Jagriti seated with Suraj. During the wedding rituals, Jagriti is frightened to see the fire.

episodesList.title: The Switcheroo Of The Brides Shocks Everyone
episodesList.summary: The wedding ceremony concludes, but as soon as the veils are lifted, chaos ensues due to the bride swap. Sapna and Jagriti blame each other. Akash asks Jagriti to prove her innocence, but she refuses.

episodesList.title: Sapna Instigates Akash Against Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Jagriti breaks down when Akash does not support her. Sapna continues her pretence and instigates Akash against Jagriti. Kalindi calms down Kalikant. Jagriti accuses Suraj of the switch.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Tells The Family His Decision
episodesList.summary: Kalikant announces his decision to the family and takes the responsibility of bringing Jagriti back. Jagriti tells her family that she wants to divorce Suraj. Kalikant visits Jagriti with gunmen.

episodesList.title: Suraj Asks Trisha The Truth
episodesList.summary: Kalikant threatens Jagriti and brings her back to the mansion. Bindi and Kachori learn about Akash marrying Sapna. Suraj and Jagriti respond to the press' questions. He later asks Trisha the truth.

episodesList.title: Sapna's Betrayal Deeply Hurts Suraj
episodesList.summary: Suraj learns the truth from Trisha and questions Sapna. Jagriti tells Akash that she is innocent, but he refuses to trust her. Suraj feels hurt by Sapna's betrayal and suspects Bhairav's intentions.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Learns About Sapna's Misdeeds
episodesList.summary: Akash starts trusting Jagriti, but Manisha comes and tells him that Jagriti is in cahoots with Suraj. Jagriti brings a drunken Suraj home and learns that it was Sapna who switched the brides.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Learns About Suraj's Plan
episodesList.summary: Suraj stops Jagriti from telling Kalikant about Sapna's actions. After talking to Bindi, Akash decides to focus on his motive. Jagriti learns about Suraj's plan from Sapna and lashes out at Suraj.

episodesList.title: Akash Forces Himself On Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Bhairav denies to Suraj that he made Jagriti sit with him in the mandap. Sapna tries a trick to make Akash come close to her. Instigated by Kalikant, Akash misbehaves with Jagriti while drunk.

episodesList.title: Suraj Saves Jagriti From Akash
episodesList.summary: Suraj saves Jagriti from Akash and tells the family about his misdeed. Jagriti thanks Suraj. The next morning, Suraj warns Akash. Later, Akash apologises to Jagriti for his mistake while being drunk.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Slaps Akash Hard
episodesList.summary: Jagriti confronts the person following her, and later, Suraj tries to get the truth out of him. At Kalikant's orders, Jagriti slaps Akash. Kalikant makes an announcement at a press conference.

episodesList.title: The Detective Shares Big News With Jagriti and Suraj
episodesList.summary: The detective shares big news with Jagriti and Suraj. Later, Jagriti stops Ganga from suffering Kalindi's punishment. Kalindi comes ahead to slap Jagriti, but Suraj stops her.

episodesList.title: Jagriti and Suraj Go to Search For The Bomb
episodesList.summary: Jagriti and Suraj go to Chitta settlement to search for the bomb. During Holika Dahan, Jagriti has a seizure on seeing the fire. Kalikant asks the family to go to Chitta settlement to celebrate Holi.

episodesList.title: Jagriti and Suraj Find a Bomb In The Chitta Settlement
episodesList.summary: After playing Holi, Jagriti and Suraj discover a bomb in a hand pump of the Chitta settlement. Jagriti defuses it and saves everyone’s lives. Later, Suraj finds that the bomb was planted by Bhairav.

episodesList.title: Suraj Stops Bhairav From Telling Kalikant The Truth
episodesList.summary: Bhairav tells Suraj that he made Jagriti Kalikant's daughter-in-law out of revenge. Suraj stops him from telling Kalikant this. Kalindi overhears Suraj and Jagriti and comes up with a plan.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Saves Two Chitta Community Girls
episodesList.summary: Kalikant opposes Jagriti's preparations to become an IPS officer. Jagriti suspects Kalikant is involved in some illegal activities. Later, she rescues two Chitta community girls from a group of goons.

episodesList.title: Bhairav's Deadly Ploy Against Suraj
episodesList.summary: Jagriti speaks about becoming an IPS officer in front of the press and people. Kalikant thrashes Akash and Suraj, and Jagriti surrenders to Kalikant. Bhairav tampers with the brakes of Suraj's jeep.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Saves Suraj's Life
episodesList.summary: Jagriti saves Suraj's life and Bhairav learns about it. Suraj asks Jagriti a question. Jagriti opposes Kalikant's plan to build a hotel in place of a school. She takes Suraj to the municipal office.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Executes Her Plan
episodesList.summary: Kalikant is influenced by Suraj's suggestion. Jagriti sneaks into the municipal office to execute her plan. Kalindi asks Jagriti to cook food for IAS Officer Mahesh Jha.

episodesList.title: Suraj Helps Jagriti In Cooking
episodesList.summary: Jagriti tries to face her fears while Suraj helps her cook on the stove. Meanwhile, Sapna and Kalindi are also unable to do anything against Jagriti. Mahesh Jha's revelation shocks everyone.

episodesList.title: Kalikant's Plan to Know Jagriti's Secret
episodesList.summary: Kalikant learns that someone switched the hotel proposal with the school one. When Kalikant points a sword at Suraj, Jagriti reveals the truth. Kalikant plots to know Jagriti's secret.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Fails to Discover Jagriti's Truth
episodesList.summary: Jagriti saves herself and Suraj from a wild animal. Kalikant is convinced that Jagriti is not the same old Chitta girl. Bhairav invites the Thakur family to his house party with a specific motive.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Discovers The Truth
episodesList.summary: A journalist questions Kalikant, and Jagriti responds appropriately. Later, Jagriti saves Suraj from Bhairav's attack and tells Bhairav the truth when his true colours are revealed to her.

episodesList.title: Bhairav's Betrayal Shatters Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Bhairav's betrayal shatters Jagriti. Suraj stops her from committing self-immolation and convinces her not to tell Kalikant the truth. Bhairav attends Kalikant's party, but Jagriti remains upset.

episodesList.title: Suraj Promises to Protect Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Bhairav gets Jagriti to make a promise, and Suraj promises that he will always protect Jagriti. Suraj supports Jagriti, while Sapna and Kalindi plot against them. Suraj and Jagriti cook together.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Lashes Out At Kalikant
episodesList.summary: Jagriti thinks about meeting Akash, but Sapna keeps her away from him. Meanwhile, Ghunghroo advises Suraj. Jagriti gets angry when Kalikant talks about her and Suraj’s ‘Shuddhikaran’.

episodesList.title: Sapna's Attempt to Know Jagriti's Secret
episodesList.summary: A dream scares Suraj. Jagriti tells Kalikant a lie. She later goes to Chittas' settlement with Suraj, and Sapna follows them to uncover the secret. Bindi and Kachori discover Jagriti's reality.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Recalls Her Past
episodesList.summary: After knowing the truth, Sapna plots against Jagriti. Bindi tells Jagriti that she will help her regain her memory. Suraj tells Jagriti why he hid the truth. A mishap helps Jagriti regain her memory.

episodesList.title: Jagriti does Not Tell Akash The Truth
episodesList.summary: Jagriti decides to tell Akash the truth but stops after considering Sapna's future. Later, she saves a Chitta boy from Kalikant's tyranny. Kalikant strikes a smuggling deal with two foreigners.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Goes to The Chitta Settlement
episodesList.summary: Kalikant notices Suraj's wound but he lies to him. Jagriti visits the Chittas and makes a promise. Suraj stops Sapna from telling Kalikant the truth about Jagriti. Jagriti tends to Suraj's wound.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Suspects Kalikant Of Killing Harish
episodesList.summary: Jagriti suspects Kalikant of Harish's murder. She shares her plan to defeat Kalikant with the Chitta community. Later, she informs the SP about Kalikant's deal and steals Kalikant's gun.

episodesList.title: Suraj Tells Jagriti Not to Go to The Police Station
episodesList.summary: Jagriti tells Kalpana the deal date and later has Ganga seated with everyone for breakfast. Suraj advises Jagriti not to go to the police station. Sapna plots against Jagriti to avoid being exposed.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Receives The Chitta Basti Murder Case File
episodesList.summary: Jagriti slaps Sapna for her actions. Kalikant arrives while Kalpana is handing over the Chitta Basti case file to Jagriti. Suraj and Jagriti get into an argument. Jagriti traps Akash in her plan.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Learns The Timing Of Kalikant's Deal
episodesList.summary: Jagriti learns the timing of Kalikant's deal. Suraj attempts to keep Jagriti away from the deal. Sapna tears Akash and Jagriti's photo, and Akash arrives there.

episodesList.title: Will Jagriti's Plan Fail?
episodesList.summary: Jagriti plans to stop Kalikant's deal with the Chittas. To attend the puja, she places a condition in front of Suraj. However, Suraj locks Jagriti in a room and leaves with the goods for the deal.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Gets Kalikant's Smuggled Goods Seized
episodesList.summary: Jagriti gets Kalikant's smuggled goods seized, which Kalpana brings to the mansion. Later, Jagriti makes a promise to Ganga. The business loss angers Kalikant, and he ends up harming himself.

episodesList.title: Suraj is Suspicious Of Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Suraj is suspicious of Jagriti but finds no evidence. Akash interrogates people in the slum, and Kachori tells him a false story. Sapna searches Jagriti's room, and soon, Jagriti teaches her a lesson.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Confesses The Truth to Suraj
episodesList.summary: Jagriti admits to Suraj that she intercepted Kalikant's trucks, and he takes an oath. She makes another vow against Kalikant and also promises something to Ganga. Alex comes to recover his money.

episodesList.title: Will Jagriti be Able to Foil Suraj's Plan?
episodesList.summary: Jagriti discusses with Alex and decides where and how much money to deliver. She tries to know Suraj's plan, but he catches her red-handed. Suraj then devises a strategy against Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Executes Her Plan Against Kalikant
episodesList.summary: Jagriti executes her plan of looting Kalikant's money. However, Suraj locks her in Ghoongru's house and lies about her abduction at home. Akash learns about Sapna's actions through her friend.

episodesList.title: Suraj Brings The Exam Papers to Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Sapna makes a revelation when Akash strangles her. He gets suspicious when he spots Jagriti's exam papers in Suraj's hands and gets his location tracked. Meanwhile, Suraj brings the papers to Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Ghungroo Falls Prey to Kalikant's Anger
episodesList.summary: Kalikant reaches Jagriti, and Ghungroo falls prey to his anger. While Suraj saves Ghungroo, Jagriti lies to Kalikant. Akash confronts Suraj over the bride swap at their marriage.

episodesList.title: Akash Decides to Tell Kalikant The Truth
episodesList.summary: Akash tells Jagriti that he found out the truth, but she does not forgive him. Suraj overhears Akash, Bindi and Kachori. Akash goes to reveal the truth about the bride swap at the mandap to Kalikant.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Outwits Suraj
episodesList.summary: Suraj shows Akash a video to stop him from telling Kalikant the truth and keeps an eye on Jagriti. Using Kachori as a distraction, Jagriti deceives Suraj and leaves the mansion for an important task.

episodesList.title: Suraj Foils Jagriti's Plan
episodesList.summary: Alex eyes Kachori inappropriately and conspires with Kalikant. Suraj brings a pundit, who offers a remedy for the ‘dosh’ in Kalikant’s birth chart, ultimately thwarting Jagriti’s plan.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Helps Ganga Get Her Due
episodesList.summary: Kalindi insults Ganga, prompting Jagriti to respond. With a clever plan, Jagriti ensures Ganga sits with Kalikant for the ritual. Meanwhile, Alex’s goons abduct Kachori.

episodesList.title: Jagriti and Suraj Rush to Rescue The Chitta Girls
episodesList.summary: Kalikant's goons abduct the Chitta girls, prompting Bindi to alert Jagriti. At a press conference, Jagriti grows suspicious of Kalikant. She and Suraj then rush to the site of the girls' auction.

episodesList.title: Jagriti and Suraj Save Kachori
episodesList.summary: Jagriti and Suraj join forces to protect Kachori. As Kalikant sets out with his men to find her, Suraj tries to speak to Kalikant about Alex. Meanwhile, Jagriti brings Kachori back to the mansion.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Hides Kachori In The Mansion
episodesList.summary: Jagriti informs Bindi about hiding Kachori in the mansion. While Kalindi grows suspicious of a disguised Kachori, Akash recognises her and asks her a question.

episodesList.title: Akash Learns The Truth About Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Kachori reveals Jagriti’s truth to Akash, leaving him feeling betrayed. Jagriti explains why she hid the truth from him. Later, Ghunghroo witnesses Kalikant committing a watchman’s murder.

episodesList.title: Akash Causes a Major Accident
episodesList.summary: Sapna distracts Akash, leading him to hit a woman and her child with his car. Suraj confronts Kalikant for holding Ghunghroo captive. Meanwhile, Sapna informs Akash about the child's death.

episodesList.title: Suraj Sees Kalikant Killing Ghungroo
episodesList.summary: Kalikant decides to kill Ghungroo. While Ghungroo and Suraj celebrate her release, gunfire erupts suddenly. Kalikant shoots Ghungroo dead and Suraj witnesses this.

episodesList.title: Ghungroo's Death Shocks Suraj
episodesList.summary: Suraj, devastated by Ghungroo's death, tells Jagriti about cutting ties with Kalikant, who pretends to grieve at the hospital. Later, Sapna's remarks provoke Akash's anger.

episodesList.title: Suraj Decides to Avenge Ghungroo's Death
episodesList.summary: Jagriti supports a mourning Suraj, empowering him to fight for justice for Ghungroo. When Kalikant tries to shift blame onto another, Suraj takes action and files an FIR to avenge Ghungroo's death.

episodesList.title: Akash Fires a Shot At Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Jagriti allies with Suraj against Kalikant as they try to flee the mansion. At Kalikant's orders, Akash is compelled to shoot Jagriti, leaving Suraj to reluctantly obey Kalikant's demands as well.

episodesList.title: Akash and Suraj Get Into a Scuffle
episodesList.summary: Akash reveals Jagriti's truth to Sapna. A scuffle ensues between Suraj and Akash over Jagriti, but she intervenes to stop them and clears Suraj's misunderstanding about Akash.

episodesList.title: Suraj Looks After Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Sapna's ploy against Akash is exposed. Suraj looks after Jagriti, who calms his anger towards Ganga. Meanwhile, the school watchman and ice cream vendor find drugs hidden in Arjun's bag.

episodesList.title: Suraj, Jagriti and Akash Trick Kalikant
episodesList.summary: Ganga investigates the ice cream vendor after finding a packet in Arjun's room. Jagriti, Akash and Suraj outwit Kalikant and his men, rescuing a Chitta girl and setting out to save the others.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Grows Suspicious Of Akash
episodesList.summary: A man blackmails Ganga over the phone. Meanwhile, Akash confronts Sapna about her lies. Sapna then teams up with Jagriti against Kalikant and informs her that Kalikant has grown suspicious of Akash.

episodesList.title: Jagriti's Idea to Unite Akash and Suraj
episodesList.summary: With Kachori's help, Sapna and Jagriti figure out Kalikant's ploy. To bring Akash and Suraj on the same side, the duo lock them up in a room. Later, Kalikant announces his decision to the family.

episodesList.title: Kalikant's Ploy Against His Sons
episodesList.summary: Kalikant gives Akash poisoned gloves for his fight against Suraj. Akash detects the poison, and Jagriti provides Suraj with an antidote. Later, they enter the boxing ring.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Foils Kalikant's Plan
episodesList.summary: A parcel arrives for Ganga. Kalikant secretly gives Suraj poisoned gloves meant for Akash, but Jagriti and Sapna foil his plan. Later, Akash, Jagriti, Suraj and Sapna set off for a crucial task.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Burns Jagriti’s Books
episodesList.summary: After facing defeat from Kalikant, Suraj urges Jagriti to become an IPS officer. Kachori stops Kalindi from tearing Jagriti's admit card, but later, Kalikant burns Jagriti’s books.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Promises Kalikant Not to Take The Exam
episodesList.summary: Akash joins Jagriti to get books and outsmarts Kalikant to bring them home. At Suraj’s prompting, Jagriti tells Kalikant that she won’t take the IPS exam, revealing Suraj’s plan.

episodesList.title: Suraj Helps Jagriti With Her Studies
episodesList.summary: Suraj, Aakash, Jagriti and Sapna go away from home for Jagriti's studies. However, Sapna schemes to have them caught by Kalikant. As Jagriti focuses on her studies, Suraj looks after her.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Helps Ganga
episodesList.summary: Akash discovers Sapna’s conspiracy. Jagriti learns the truth from Ganga and exposes the real culprit to Kalikant, despite Kalindi’s outrage.

episodesList.title: Suraj and Akash Send Jagriti For Her Exam
episodesList.summary: Kalikant's plans are foiled when Akash and Suraj successfully send Jagriti for her exam. Later on, Akash brings up Suraj and Jagriti's divorce before Suraj.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Finds a Captive Bhairav
episodesList.summary: Kalikant still thinks that Jagriti failed to give her exam. Suraj's words leave Jagriti dispirited, and she reminisces their time together. Later, she finds a captive Bhairav and asks Akash for help.

episodesList.title: Suraj Refuses to Help Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Suraj refuses to aid Jagriti in rescuing Bhairav. When Kalikant gives Bhairav 24 hours, Jagriti again reaches out to Suraj. Later, Ganga suggests her to ask Akash for help.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Finds The Key to The Basement
episodesList.summary: Jagriti seeks Akash’s help to free Bhairav, while Sapna plots against them. Using a clever trick, Jagriti and Akash locate the basement key, and Akash then asks Jagriti a question.

episodesList.title: Suraj Helps Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Suraj helps Jagriti and Akash sneak into Kalikant’s office, but handles the situation when Kalikant unexpectedly returns. Grateful, Jagriti thanks Suraj and gets worried when he falls ill.

episodesList.title: Suraj's Plan Saves Bhairav's Life
episodesList.summary: Suraj shares his plan with Akash and Jagriti, giving Jagriti the cellar key. Fearing a bomb, Kalikant and the family flee the mansion, while Kachori rescues Bhairav and sends him to the settlement.

episodesList.title: Jagriti's Upsc Results are Out
episodesList.summary: Jagriti tells Bhairav how Suraj saved her life. Later, Ganga seeks a promise from Jagriti, while Suraj shares her exam results and plans her interview trip.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Gets High On Toddy
episodesList.summary: On their way to an interview, Suraj and Jagriti stop at a wedding as the car breaks down. Jagriti gets intoxicated after drinking toddy, and Suraj takes care of her. Jagriti arrives for the interview.

episodesList.title: Sapna's Conspiracy Against Jagriti and Suraj
episodesList.summary: Jagriti heads for an interview while Suraj waits outside. Meanwhile, Sapna’s scheme leads to chaos when Akash finds Suraj and Jagriti sleeping together, leaving them puzzled about how they were there.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Discovers Jagriti Belongs to The Chitta Community
episodesList.summary: Jagriti confronts Sapna with evidence, prompting her to confess. Fuelled by Akash's hatred, Sapna exposes Jagriti's truth to Kalikant. Meanwhile, Kachori rushes to inform Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Confronts Kalikant
episodesList.summary: Kalikant's men wreak havoc in Chitta Basti. Jagriti confronts him in Jagriti Basti and vows to bring him to justice. Later, Kalikant resolves to have her killed.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Disproves Jagriti's Accusation
episodesList.summary: Kalikant rushes to the mansion after Kalindi's call. Jagriti accuses him of trafficking women, but he he clears his name before the police and media, and files a defamation case against her.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Tries to Kill Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Kalikant tricks Suraj and Akash into leaving the house and traps Jagriti in a glass chamber to kill her. Realising the danger, Suraj rushes home to save her.

episodesList.title: Suraj Lashes Out At Kalikant
episodesList.summary: Kalikant’s plan to kill Jagriti fails. Suraj warns him in anger. While Akash shares good news with Jagriti, Kalikant sets a condition for withdrawing the FIR against her.

episodesList.title: Suraj and Jagriti Outwit Kalikant
episodesList.summary: After Kalikant withdraws the FIR, Suraj and Jagriti escape the pavilion, avoiding to reverse their marriage vows. Furious, Kalikant uncovers Suraj’s plan, only to be hit with shocking news.

episodesList.title: Suraj Stages Jagriti's Death
episodesList.summary: Jagriti's death devastates her loved ones, while Suraj spirals into intoxication and considers leaving home. Later, he goes to Jagriti, now in IPS training, and unveils his plan.

episodesList.title: Akash Learns About Suraj's Act
episodesList.summary: Suraj takes care of Jagriti's needs during her training. Back at home, Ganga asks Akash to begin anew with Sapna. While Suraj and Jagriti celebrate their anniversary, Akash learns about Suraj's act.

episodesList.title: Akash Accepts Sapna
episodesList.summary: Akash confesses to Sapna that Jagriti doesn't hold a place in his heart. He apologises to her, and they come closer. Kalikant imprisons all the pregnant Chitta women, and Suraj returns to the mansion.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Faces a Big Challenge
episodesList.summary: Suraj finds Akash's behaviour odd. He eventually finds Akash spying on him and tries to calm his anger. Jagriti's identity of being a Chitta creates an obstacle for her in becoming an IPS officer.

episodesList.title: Suraj and Akash Help Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Suraj and Akash put their plan into action to help Jagriti. In the mansion, Ganga aids a Chitta woman in labour, while Jagriti exposes Mokshgarh’s harmful tradition to the committee members.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Returns to The Mansion As an Ips Officer
episodesList.summary: Jagriti returns as an IPS officer and puts an end to Kalikant’s unlawful practices. However, Kalindi’s and his threats prevent a key witness from testifying.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Asks Kalindi to Leave The Mansion
episodesList.summary: Kalikant, enraged by his defeat, harms himself. Jagriti makes her next move against him, and he orders Kalindi to leave the mansion. Meanwhile, in the settlement, Suraj beats up a man.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Lands In Trouble Due to Suraj
episodesList.summary: Suraj’s violent actions anger Jagriti. She forces Kalindi to massage Ganga’s feet in exchange for staying at home. Later, Jagriti faces possible suspension due to Suraj’s behaviour.

episodesList.title: Akash Sparks a Fight Between Suraj and Jagriti
episodesList.summary: After seeing Suraj and Jagriti argue, Akash plots to fuel their fight and succeeds. Meanwhile, Kalikant presents a proposal to Suraj and Akash, who offer him advice.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Gets The Evidence Against Him Erased
episodesList.summary: Jagriti learns Harish's postmortem report is missing. She catches Jeevan smuggling Kalikant's illegal documents in animal hides, while Kalikant erases evidence against him.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Attempts to Humiliate Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Suraj comforts Jagriti, while Kalikant tries to humiliate her by hosting the police. Later, Akash notices Suraj's name tattooed on Jagriti's neck, sparking a conflict with Sapna.

episodesList.title: Akash’s Ploy Against Suraj and Jagriti
episodesList.summary: SP Subodh praises Jagriti. Suraj urges her to help Ghungroo get justice, but she asks him to wait for a while. Later, Akash provokes Suraj to file an FIR against Kalikant.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Traps Suraj
episodesList.summary: Akash warns Kalikant that Suraj has gone to file an FIR against him. In retaliation, he implicates Suraj in an illegal business case. Later, Suraj is taken for questioning while Jagriti watches.

episodesList.title: Jagriti's Plan to Help Suraj
episodesList.summary: In Kalikant's presence, Jagriti decides to hold Suraj in custody. Sapna reveals the role Akash played in the ploy to Jagriti. Lochan informs Jagriti about Alex, and she devises a plan to help Suraj.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Catches Alex With a Huge Amount Of Cash
episodesList.summary: Suraj shares a plan with Jagriti to catch Alex, while Akash has a dream about her. Ganga urges Suraj to confess his love to Jagriti. Later, Jagriti catches Alex with a huge amount of cash.

episodesList.title: Saving Suraj Puts Jagriti's Job At Risk
episodesList.summary: SP Subodh orders Jagriti to arrest Suraj, but Kalikant deceives her. Choosing to protect Suraj, Jagriti helps him escape, leading to her suspension.

episodesList.title: Suraj Returns and Surrenders to The Police
episodesList.summary: SP Subodh suspends Jagriti. Suraj returns and surrenders to the police, tearing up Kalikant’s FIR against Jagriti. A heartbroken Jagriti meets him in private.

episodesList.title: Can Kalikant Push Jagriti Out Of The Case?
episodesList.summary: Jagriti asks Akash to gather evidence of Suraj's innocence. Akash explains his next steps to Kalikant. While Jagriti brings food for Suraj, Kalikant asks SP Subodh to remove her from Suraj's case.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Gives a Fitting Reply to Kalikant
episodesList.summary: SP Subodh delays Jagriti’s transfer by a week. Elsewhere, Ganga reveals a key secret about Kalikant. Jagriti gives a fitting reply to Kalikant, but an unfazed Kalikant prepares his next deadly move.

episodesList.title: Will The Court Accept Jagriti’s Appeal?
episodesList.summary: Jagriti appeals to keep Suraj in custody for 15 days. Despite Kalikant's objection, she defends her case, prompting the judge’s verdict. Kalikant's words leave Jagriti anxious for Suraj’s safety.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Gives Akash a Sharp Reply
episodesList.summary: Jagriti fumes over Inspector Tejaswi’s actions. She and Ganga look for Kalikant’s secret hideout. When a drunk Akash slanders her and Suraj, Jagriti shuts him down with a sharp reply.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Plots Jagriti’s Suspension
episodesList.summary: Jagriti and Ganga sneak into Kalikant’s hideout to gather evidence but are caught. Kalikant then plots an attack on Suraj in jail, aiming to get Jagriti suspended from duty.

episodesList.title: Sapna Tells Jagriti Her Plan to Save Suraj
episodesList.summary: Jagriti thwarts Kalikant's plan, exposing Kalindi's betrayal. Akash grows furious with Jagriti, but Sapna shares a plan to save Suraj, and Jagriti puts it into action.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Gathers Evidence Against Kalikant
episodesList.summary: Jagriti strikes a deal with Kalindi and gathers evidence against Kalikant from the cowshed. Akash tries to stop her, but in the struggle, an accident occurs.

episodesList.title: Kalikant's True Colours Revealed In Court
episodesList.summary: Jagriti presents evidence of Suraj's innocence. Enraged, Kalikant loses his cool in court and threatens everyone, revealing his true colours. Soon, Jagriti swiftly regains control of the situation.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Gets Kalikant Arrested
episodesList.summary: In court, Jagriti proves Suraj's innocence with solid evidence and witnesses. The judge acquits him with honour and orders Kalikant's arrest.

episodesList.title: Kalikant is Humiliated At Chitta Settlement
episodesList.summary: The judge grants Kalikant’s request and assigns Jagriti to protect him. She brings him to Chitta settlement where he’s humiliated, and later moves him to a safe house.

episodesList.title: Suraj and Jagriti Share Tender Moments
episodesList.summary: Ganga slaps Kalindi for her misdeeds. On the other hand, Suraj and Jagriti share heartfelt moments as he attempts to profess his love. Later, at Chitta’s settlement, they uncover Kalikant’s misdeeds.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Lashes Out At Akash For His Actions
episodesList.summary: Jagriti brings the Chitta people to the police station to get their FIR filed. Sapna firmly declares to Kalindi that she won't leave Jagriti's side, while Jagriti lashes out at Akash for his actions.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Exposes Kalindi
episodesList.summary: Jagriti falls into Akash’s trap but later exposes Kalindi after overhearing her conversation with Verma. When Suraj tries to evict Kalindi from the mansion, Ganga stops him.

episodesList.title: A Life-threatening Attack On Kalikant
episodesList.summary: On his way to court, Kalikant is shot by an unknown assailant. As he’s rushed to the hospital, Akash delivers grim news to Jagriti, who then confronts Kalindi.

episodesList.title: Kalindi Gets Jagriti Suspended
episodesList.summary: Jagriti confronts Suraj about the attack on Kalikant but evades his questions. Meanwhile, Akash and Sapna suspect each other. Outside the police station, Kalindi stirs chaos and has Jagriti suspended.

episodesList.title: The Family Learms About Kalindi Becoming The Minister
episodesList.summary: Suraj tries to prevent Jagriti’s suspension following her sudden disappearance. The family sees the news of Kalindi likely to be appointed as a minister, while Akash speaks with Suraj.

episodesList.title: Malishka Teams Up With Kiran to Target Lakshmi
episodesList.summary: Malishka arm-twists Aayush when he tries to oust her. On the other hand, Rishi tells Lakshmi he wants to sever all ties with her. Later, Kiran and Malishka turn the inspector against Lakshmi.

episodesList.title: Suraj and Jagriti Fall In Love With Each Other
episodesList.summary: Suraj, hurt by Jagriti’s indifference, confesses his pain while drunk. Jagriti shares her feelings, but he falls asleep. Later, Suraj bares his heart before God.

episodesList.title: Jagriti - June 29, 2025
episodesList.summary: Jagriti, from the marginalised Chitta community, challenges age-old traditions to empower her people and locks horns with her leader who works for the mafia.

episodesList.title: Akash Sparks Doubt In Suraj’s Mind
episodesList.summary: Akash tells Suraj that Jagriti is framing him. Suraj overhears Jagriti, Kachori and Avinash, the son of Kalikant’s rival, talking. Meanwhile, Jagriti shares her concerns with Sapna.

episodesList.title: Akash’s Conspiracy is Exposed
episodesList.summary: Jagriti and Suraj clear their misunderstandings and apologise. Akash watches them through a hidden camera, exposing his entire conspiracy. Soon after, the police arrive at the mansion.

episodesList.title: Will Jagriti be Able to Arrest Akash?
episodesList.summary: SP Subodh takes Jagriti and Suraj in for interrogation, and their plan is exposed. Meanwhile, Akash threatens Trisha to falsely confess that Kalikant fired the gun, but Jagriti arrives just in time.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Catches Trisha In a Lie
episodesList.summary: In the lockup, Trisha lies to Jagriti, but she sees through her lie. Jagriti asks SP Subodh for more time to catch the real mastermind. Suspicious of Akash’s injury, she begins to doubt him.

episodesList.title: Jagriti No Longer Suspects Akash
episodesList.summary: Akash brings Kalikant home from the hospital, raising Jagriti’s suspicions. Trisha names Bagheera during questioning, and Akash meets him. Later, Jagriti tells Suraj he’s not the culprit.

episodesList.title: Akash Asks Suraj to Divorce Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Akash ends a tradition at Jagriti’s request and is then crowned. He later urges Suraj to keep his promise of divorcing Jagriti, explaining she’s staying with him out of obligation.

episodesList.title: Ganga Resolves Suraj’s Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Jagriti meets a gangster named Nanhe as Akash carries out his plan. Ganga clears Suraj's dilemma and asks Jagriti to profess her love to him on her birthday. Suraj dreams of a life with her.

episodesList.title: Suraj Decides to Part Ways With Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Jagriti plans a surprise party for Suraj’s birthday. Meanwhile, Bagheera threatens to leak Jagriti’s video and forces Suraj to divorce her. Devastated, Suraj decides to leave Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Suraj Hurts Jagriti Emotionally
episodesList.summary: Suraj, drunk and hurt, lashes out at Jagriti. Bagheera calls him the next day again, while Akash provokes Jagriti. Suraj stirs chaos in Chitta settlement, while Jagriti threatens to quit her job.

episodesList.title: Bagheera Blackmails Suraj Once Again
episodesList.summary: Sapna asks Suraj why he’s troubled. Bagheera blackmails Suraj again. Jagriti questions Suraj’s behaviour, but he hides the truth, while Akash celebrates his plan, and Kalindi arrives.

episodesList.title: Suraj Falls Into Akash's Trap
episodesList.summary: Jagriti tries to figure out the cause of Suraj's changed behaviour. In order to push Jagriti away, Suraj decides to adopt Akash's way and hurts her feelings. Later, Sapna questions a pleased Akash.

episodesList.title: Suraj Falsely Accuses Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Suraj decides not to divorce Jagriti and goes to meet Bagheera. At Akash's behest, Bagheera compels Suraj to agree with his demand. Upon returning home, Suraj makes a false accusation against Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Parts Ways With Suraj and Leaves His House
episodesList.summary: Suraj shows Akash and Jagriti's marriage certificate, prompting Jagriti to slap him. Later, Suraj declares his decision to divorce Jagriti, who decides to part ways with him and leaves his house.

episodesList.title: Sapna Overhears Suraj Talking to Bagheera
episodesList.summary: Suraj misses Jagriti and sleeps in a cowshed. Meanwhile, Akash talks about killing Sapna in front of an unconscious Kalikant. Sapna overhears Suraj talking to Bagheera and informs Jagriti about it.

episodesList.title: Jagriti and Suraj’s Lives In Danger
episodesList.summary: Jagriti goes to Bagheera's hideout, and Suraj follows her. Bagheera ties a bomb to Jagriti and holds her and Suraj captive. Meanwhile, Akash plots against Sapna, and Ganga informs him about Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Suraj Defuses The Bomb Strapped to Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Akash grows restless on learning Jagriti is in danger. Suraj defuses the bomb strapped to Jagruti’s body, and they hug. Ganga, holding a lit lamp for Jagruti’s safety, feels happy on seeing her.

episodesList.title: Suraj and Jagriti Get Remarried
episodesList.summary: Suraj saves Jagriti and professes his love, proposing marriage. Meanwhile, Akash kills someone for the first time. Amidst rising tensions, Suraj and Jagriti’s wedding rituals begin.

episodesList.title: Suraj and Jagriti Tie The Knot Once Again
episodesList.summary: Bindi performs the 'kanyadaan', and Suraj marries Jagriti. Ganga welcomes them home. Akash dreams of a special moment, while Suraj nervously carries Jagriti to their room on their wedding night.

episodesList.title: Suraj and Jagriti’s Wedding Night
episodesList.summary: Suraj and Jagriti celebrate their wedding night with love and a heartfelt gift from Suraj. But Akash, intent on keeping them apart, releases a snake into their room.

episodesList.title: Akash Kills Bagheera
episodesList.summary: Akash pretends to apologise to Sapna to get close to her. The next morning, Suraj announces his new company to the family. Later, Akash kills Bagheera, and Jagriti learns of Bagheera’s death.

episodesList.title: Whose Arrival Rattled The Household?
episodesList.summary: Jagriti discovers a detail regarding Bagheera's case that is in fact a part of Akash's trap. She offers help to a troubled Suraj. Later, a stranger’s entry into the mansion stuns everyone.

episodesList.title: Shashikant Returns to The Mansion With His Family
episodesList.summary: Shashikant, Kalikant’s lookalike, signs the mansion papers to help Suraj get a loan. Soon, Kalindi brings a fake will, but Shashikant's wife, Sudha, tears it.

episodesList.title: Kachori Falls Prey to Akash's Conspiracy
episodesList.summary: Suraj tells his family about receiving a loan and works hard to launch his business. Akash strikes a deal with Kalindi, and due to Akash's conspiracy, Kachori ends up in the hospital.

episodesList.title: A Sage’s Prophecy Frightens Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Jagriti sends Suraj and Sapna to Jamshedpur, but a sage’s prophecy scares her. Elsewhere, Sudha and Ganga discuss the past. On their way back, Suraj and Sapna’s car ends up with a flat tyre.

episodesList.title: An Intoxicated Sapna and Suraj
episodesList.summary: Villagers feed bhang-laced jalebis to Sapna and Suraj. Jagriti sees them intoxicated on a video call and asks them to stay the night. The next morning, Suraj finds himself in Sapna’s room.

episodesList.title: Akash Fakes Concern For Sapna
