episodesList.summary: Akash fakes concern for Sapna in front of everyone, but her reaction seems strange to Jagriti. She expresses trust in Suraj and asks him to forget the village issue. Later, Suraj shares good news.

episodesList.title: Alex Blackmails Jagriti and Suraj
episodesList.summary: Jagriti helps Shashikant solve a problem regarding Jojo. Alex threatens to frame Jagriti for bribery and demands money from Suraj. Later, Jagriti turns to Shashikant for help.

episodesList.title: Everybody Learns About Sapna's Pregnancy
episodesList.summary: Kalindi tries to get Kalikant's thumbprint on a blank paper. On Ganga's birthday, everybody is delighted with the news of Sapna's pregnancy. However, Jagriti gets worried on seeing an uneasy Sapna.

episodesList.title: Sapna’s Revelation Shocks The Family
episodesList.summary: Sapna attempts suicide and tells the family that she is pregnant with Suraj’s child, leaving them shocked. While Suraj denies the claim, Jagriti questions Sapna. Later, she speaks to Sapna in private.

episodesList.title: Akash's Shocking Revelation In Front Of His Family
episodesList.summary: Akash returns home to find Sapna pregnant with Suraj’s child, which he calls Suraj's planned conspiracy. When Jagriti questions him, he reveals a shocking truth through his medical report.

episodesList.title: A Rift In Suraj and Jagriti’s Relationship
episodesList.summary: Sapna swears on the Geeta that she’s carrying Suraj’s child, leaving Jagriti shattered. Suraj tries hard to convince Jagriti he hasn’t betrayed her but fails to do so.

episodesList.title: Sapna Decides to Undergo an Abortion
episodesList.summary: While Jagriti, Sapna, Suraj and Akash are shattered, Jagriti decides to support Sapna out of concern. Influenced by Kalindi, Sapna chooses to terminate her pregnancy, but Jagriti tries to stop her.

episodesList.title: Shashikant Asks Akash to Adopt Sapna’s Child
episodesList.summary: Jagriti stops Sapna from aborting the baby and makes a promise. Suraj visits the village to uncover the truth. Shashikant asks Akash to adopt the child, but also calls Sapna and Suraj deceitful.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Makes a Big Decision For Sapna’s Sake
episodesList.summary: Akash refuses to give his name to Sapna’s unborn child and tries to oust her from the mansion. However, Jagriti intervenes and takes a major decision after hearing Sapna’s side.

episodesList.title: Suraj Punishes Himself For Hurting Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Suraj lets boxers beat him up to punish himself and returns home to apologise to Jagriti. She asks Suraj to take care of Sapna. Later, a weakened Jagriti collapses and gets injured.

episodesList.title: Akash's Conspiracy Against Suraj
episodesList.summary: Suraj finds Jagriti injured, and though she refuses his blood, Sapna convinces her. Akash’s conspiracy against Suraj is exposed, in which Sapna is reluctantly involved.

episodesList.title: How did Kalindi and Akash Use Sapna As a Pawn?
episodesList.summary: Sapna recalls Akash's reaction when she told him about her pregnancy. It is later revealed how Kalindi and Akash forced Sapna to carry out their conspiracy.

episodesList.title: Sapna Tries to Tell Jagriti The Truth
episodesList.summary: Suraj and Jagriti take Sapna to the hospital. Sapna tries to tell Jagriti the truth. Later, Jagriti feels sad seeing Suraj caring for Sapna, and Akash provokes her.

episodesList.title: Jagriti's Saree Catches Fire
episodesList.summary: Jagriti decides to leave the mansion, but Ganga tries to stop her. Jagriti plans to have Akash's reports rechecked. Later, her saree catches fire, and Suraj saves her.

episodesList.title: The False Report Saves Akash
episodesList.summary: A group of eunuchs visit Sapna to bless her and the father of her unborn child. Suraj brings Akash to them, but a false report later claims Akash is sterile.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Decides to Divorce Suraj
episodesList.summary: Akash urges Jagriti to divorce Suraj to save Sapna's future. Suraj pleads with Jagriti to not push him away. Later, Jagriti informs the family about her decision to divorce Suraj.

episodesList.title: Jagriti's Decision Devastates Suraj
episodesList.summary: Upset with Jagriti's decision, Suraj tries to hurt himself. At Jojo's urging, Shashikant talks to Jagriti, while Akash tries to strangle Sapna. Eventually, Jagriti stops Suraj from hurting himself.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Leaves Her Fate In God's Hands
episodesList.summary: Ganga notices Kalikant briefly open his eyes. Holding her mangalsutra over the sacred fire with Suraj, Jagriti leaves the fate of her relationship to God, while Akash tries to drop the mangalsutra.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Shows Signs Of Movement
episodesList.summary: Kalikant shows signs of movement, prompting the family to hospitalise him. Meanwhile, Akash throws a party at home, where Kalindi tries to expose the truth about Sapna's pregnancy to the guests.

episodesList.title: A Comatose Kalikant Wakes Up
episodesList.summary: Akash arrives at the hospital to kill Kalikant, while the latter pretends to be comatose despite waking up. Later, at Akash's behest, the DIG gets Jagriti transferred for a week.

episodesList.title: Akash's Ploy to Keep Jagriti Away From Suraj
episodesList.summary: Jagriti is transferred to a village, and except for Akash, the rest of the family decides to move there with her. Akash’s ploy gets Jagriti caught up in work, while Suraj waits for her at home.

episodesList.title: Suraj Cooks Jagriti's Favourite Dish
episodesList.summary: Akash enters Sapna's room and threatens her. Elsewhere, Suraj cooks Jagriti’s favourite dish, and they talk. Later, they decide to investigate Jojo’s friends after finding him drunk.

episodesList.title: Suraj and Jagriti's Mission Jojo
episodesList.summary: Kalindi tells Sudha that Jagriti and Suraj are keeping an eye on Jojo, which makes her furious. Suraj and Jagriti go to a club to uncover the truth about Jojo's friends, and Akash also arrives there.

episodesList.title: Akash Locks Jagriti and Suraj In The Club
episodesList.summary: Jagriti and Suraj see Jojo at the club with her friends. However, Akash locks the duo in a room. When Jojo's friends try to force themselves on her, Jagriti and Suraj arrive just in time.

episodesList.title: Jojo's Surprising Transformation
episodesList.summary: Jagriti and Suraj save Jojo and seek answers from Dhanna. During Raksha Bandhan, the Thakur family gathers, and Jojo’s new look leaves Shashikant stunned.

episodesList.title: Sapna’s Plan to Bring Suraj and Jagriti Close
episodesList.summary: Kalikant kills the nurse who had learned that he's waking up from his coma. While Akash rejects Shashikant’s advice, Sapna plans to bring Suraj and Jagriti closer.

episodesList.title: Jagriti and Suraj Grow Closer
episodesList.summary: Suraj helps Jagriti wear her saree after she burns her hand, and they grow closer. Later, she sees Sapna crying before god and feels saddened on recalling her words.

episodesList.title: Jagriti is Hurt By Suraj and Sapna’s Photo
episodesList.summary: Kalikant is shaken by a disturbing dream. Due to Akash’s plot, Jagriti receives a photo of Suraj and Sapna, leaving her heartbroken. Unaware of this, Suraj prepares a surprise for her.

episodesList.title: Suraj’s Surprise Moves Jagriti
episodesList.summary: With everyone’s help, Suraj gives Jagriti a heartfelt birthday surprise that leaves her deeply moved. Soon after, Jagriti decides to uncover who sent her the photo of Suraj and Sapna.

episodesList.title: Bindi Hoists The Flag
episodesList.summary: Jagriti learns through a letter that Bindi has been abducted, but Bindi escapes and arrives at the mansion for the flag hoisting ceremony. Later, Jagriti makes a promise to Sapna regarding her child.

episodesList.title: Jagriti's Suspicion About Kalikant
episodesList.summary: Kalikant learns about Shashikant's return. Jagriti comes to the hospital and suspects Kalikant is out of coma. She then urges the doctor to examine him.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Gives Divorce Papers to Suraj
episodesList.summary: Akash rejoices as Jagriti hands divorce papers to Suraj. Sapna experiences stomach pain, and Suraj and Jagriti take her to the hospital. Akash panics on learning that Shyam is at the hospital as well.

episodesList.title: Sapna Tells Suraj and Jagriti The Truth
episodesList.summary: Jagriti helps Shyam's wife, and he reveals Akash's conspiracy to her and Suraj. Sapna then confesses that she's pregnant with Akash's child, and soon, Akash arrives at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Akash Tries to Kill Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Akash fires his gun at Sapna, but Suraj brings him back home. Later, Akash holds Jagriti at knifepoint and tries to burn both himself and Jagriti to death.

episodesList.title: Kalikant’s Plan to Kill Shashikant
episodesList.summary: Jagriti tears up the divorce papers and spends time with Suraj. Shashikant visits a hospitalised Kalikant, who attacks him so that he can enter the mansion posing as Shashikant once he is dealt with.

episodesList.title: Shashikant Gives The News Of Kalikant’s Death
episodesList.summary: Suraj and Jagriti seal the symbol of their love. Shashikant comes home and shares the news of Kalikant’s death. Suraj refuses to perform Kalikant’s last rites, and Jagriti doesn’t salute him either.

episodesList.title: A Big Revelation About Kalikant
episodesList.summary: On Suraj’s urging, Jagruti pays her respects to Kalikant’s mortal remains. It is revealed he killed Shashikant and took his place. The family returns to the mansion, where Kalikant acts as Shashikant.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Voices Her Doubt to Suraj
episodesList.summary: Jagriti senses a change in Shashikant’s behavior and she tells Suraj about it. Forced to massage Sudha’s feet, Kalikant uncovers Akash’s mischief. Soon after, fate leads him to a meeting with Kalindi.

episodesList.title: Akash Becomes The Sole Owner Of The Mansion
episodesList.summary: Akash arrives at Kalikant’s ritual with a gun and gets Ganga and Shashikant’s share of the property transferred to his name. Later, Jagriti is shocked when she smells alcohol from Shashikant’s room.

episodesList.title: Akash Tries to Kill Suraj and Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Kalindi urges Akash to take revenge on Jagriti. Meanwhile, Kalikant tries to stop Sudha and Jagriti from moving to Chitta Basti. Later, Akash attempts to kill Suraj and Jagriti with poisonous gas.

episodesList.title: The Thakur Family Moves to Chitta Basti
episodesList.summary: The Thakur family moves to Chitta Basti, where the locals are scared to see Shashikant. Sudha argues with Shashikant over his changed behaviour. Akash hatches a deadly plot against Suraj and Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Akash’s Ploy Against Jagriti Goes Awry
episodesList.summary: Jagriti helps the snake flee, and it ends up biting the snake charmer, saving Kalikant from being exposed. She then shares her suspicions with Suraj, while Akash learns that his plan has failed.

episodesList.title: Kalikant has Arjun Abducted
episodesList.summary: Kalikant visits Alex with a proposal. Later, he has Arjun abducted in front of Suraj and Jagriti. The police begin searching for Arjun, and Kalikant calls Kalindi to demand ransom.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Shares His Plan With Alex
episodesList.summary: Suraj and Kalindi arrange money together, and Suraj brings Arjun back. Jagriti arrives at Kalikant’s hideout and gets into trouble. Later, Kalikant shares his plan with Alex.

episodesList.title: Kalikant’s Plan to Return to The Mansion
episodesList.summary: Suraj revives Jagriti, who smells Kalikant’s liquor on her clothes. Her words in the settlement leave Kalikant rattled, prompting him to hatch a plan to return to the mansion.

episodesList.title: Akash Requests The Family to Return to The Mansion
episodesList.summary: Kalikant, posing as a ghost, scares Akash and urges him to bring the family back. Later, Akash visits the settlement, apologises, and pleads with them to return to the mansion.

episodesList.title: Akash Risks His Life
episodesList.summary: Akash risks his life to bring the family back to the mansion and insists on treatment only after earning their forgiveness. Later, Sudha confides in Jagriti that Shashikant doesn’t feel like himself.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Suspects Kalikant is Impersonating Shashikant
episodesList.summary: At the hospital, Jagriti suspects Shashikant is Kalikant. Alex urges Kalikant to open the hospital within a week, and Jagriti arrives there. Meanwhile, Shashikant informs his family of his decision.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Discovers Kalikant's Secret
episodesList.summary: An unexpected incident deepens Sudha’s suspicion about Kalikant. Jagriti digs deeper and discovers Kalikant is alive and behind Shashikant’s death. She reveals the truth to Suraj.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Exposes Kalikant’s True Identity
episodesList.summary: Jagriti stops Suraj from confronting Kalikant without proof. Akash apologises to Sapna, but she refuses to forgive him. Later, Jagriti exposes Kalikant’s truth in the Chitta settlement.

episodesList.title: Jagriti is Defeated By Kalikant
episodesList.summary: Jagriti fails to prove that Kalikant is impersonating Shashikant. As Kalikant celebrates his victory, she dons a disguise and sneaks into the hospital to gather evidence.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Confesses His Crime to Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Kalikant confesses to Jagriti that he killed Shashikant and threatens to destroy her. Later, Jagriti informs Suraj and sets a plan in motion to expose Kalikant.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Doesn’t Fall For Jagriti’s Trick
episodesList.summary: Kalikant avoids falling into Jagriti’s trap, while Akash manages to save Sapna from his bullet. Later, Kalikant attempts to threaten Jagriti, but she cleverly sets a trap to reach his accomplice.

episodesList.title: A Sudden Event Shakes Sudha to The Core
episodesList.summary: Bhawani executes her malicious plan, electrocuting Priya. As a result, Priya collapses unconscious, leaving the situation tense and uncertain as the consequences of the attack loom.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Kills Sudha
episodesList.summary: Sudha uncovers Kalikant’s truth just as he arrives. Before killing her, he records a few videos. He then lies to the family about her whereabouts, but Jagriti begins to get suspicious.

episodesList.title: Kalikant’s Plot Against Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Jagriti tells Suraj that Kalikant killed Sudha. Kalikant tries to turn the family against her by calling her mentally unstable, but Jagriti quietly starts plotting with Ganga and Sapna’s support.

episodesList.title: What does Akash Intend to Do?
episodesList.summary: Jagriti yet again fails to expose Kalikant and suspects someone is helping him. Meanwhile, Akash and Kalikant’s plan is revealed, but Akash has a different agenda.

episodesList.title: Jagriti's Ploy Against Kalikant
episodesList.summary: A piece of news sends Jagriti looking for Dr Mukhopadhyay, and she works on a plan against Kalikant. However, Kalikant manages to thwart her attempt to expose him with Akash's help.

episodesList.title: Jagriti's Plan to Expose Kalikant
episodesList.summary: An event leads Jagriti to come up with a way to expose Kalikant. She asks the family members to organise Sapna's 'Godh Bharai' and executes her plan. Later, Sapna's 'Godh Bharai' celebrations begin.

episodesList.title: Suraj Questions Jagriti About Her Plan
episodesList.summary: Everyone falls sick after eating the food made by Jagriti. Even after the doctor’s warning, Kalikant puts Kachori’s life in danger. Suraj questions Jagriti about her plan, and Kalikant is exposed.

episodesList.title: Jagriti's Cunning Plan to Expose Kalikant
episodesList.summary: Kalikant tells the family to send Jagriti to a mental hospital. Suraj agrees with them and sends her there. Later, Jagriti's plan to expose Kalikant is revealed.

episodesList.title: Will Jagriti Find Evidence Against Kalikant?
episodesList.summary: Sapna and Akash save Jojo’s life. Jagriti keeps an eye on everything in the house through cameras to expose Kalikant. When Kalikant is about to reveal his secret to Kalindi, he gets a message.

episodesList.title: Akash Forces Jagriti Into Marriage
episodesList.summary: Jojo and Suraj set out to meet Sudha. Akash meets Jagriti, and his true colours leave her shocked. He then forces Jagriti to marry him in exchange for sparing Jojo and Suraj’s lives.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Returns to The Mansion With Suraj
episodesList.summary: Jagriti ruins Akash’s plan, returns to the mansion with Suraj and pretends to apologise to Kalikant. Later, Suraj surprises her with a sweet gesture, while Sapna questions her intentions.

episodesList.title: Will Jagriti be Able to Save Lata From Akash?
episodesList.summary: Jagriti uncovers a key detail in Kalikant’s case and rushes to meet Lata at the hospital, where Akash tries to kill her. Meanwhile, Sapna reveals a plan to Suraj to save his truck driver.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Confronts Akash
episodesList.summary: Lata agrees to reveal the truth, and Jagriti records her statement. She confronts Akash with it and makes an offer. Meanwhile, Suraj frees Vinod from the robbers but ends up trapped himself.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Discovers Akash’s Betrayal
episodesList.summary: Akash agrees to support Jagriti, but Kalikant soon finds out. He later discovers that Akash was behind the plot to kill him. Meanwhile, Jagriti saves Suraj from Kalikant’s goons.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Gets Shot Trying to Save Akash
episodesList.summary: Kalikant fires at Akash, but Jagriti steps in and gets shot. Suraj, shaken by a nightmare, rushes to the hospital, only to be blocked by Kalikant. Later, Sapna makes a revelation to Suraj.

episodesList.title: Suraj Discovers Kalikant’s Reality
episodesList.summary: Suraj finds evidence against Kalikant and confronts him. Kalikant asks him for Jagriti’s hidden proof in exchange for sparing her life. Later, Suraj retrieves the evidence.

episodesList.title: Suraj Hands Over Evidence Against Kalikant
episodesList.summary: Suraj hands Kalikant the evidence but fails to alert Jagriti under his watch. Kalikant usurps the makhana business and ousts the Chittas. A shocking incident in the settlement leaves Suraj shaken.

episodesList.title: Suraj and Jagriti Get Evidence Against Kalikant
episodesList.summary: During Suraj’s meeting with Jagriti, it comes out that she already knows the truth. He shows her the medicine found in the makhana packet, and they then set their plan in motion to expose Kalikant.

episodesList.title: Will Jagriti be Able to Save The Chittas' Lives?
episodesList.summary: At the hospital, Kalikant locks Suraj in a room. Jagriti panics after discovering a deadly experiment underway, but despite her warnings, the Chittas arrive there seeking treatment.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Grows Suspicious Of Suraj
episodesList.summary: Suraj and Jagriti stage a fight in front of Kalikant, and later Suraj lies to him. Sensing something’s off, Kalikant calls his henchman. Jagriti offers to help Neeti, a victim of domestic abuse.

episodesList.title: Dr Verma Shares His Helplessness With Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Kalikant is happy with his black money. Jagriti urges Dr Verma to testify against him, but he reveals Kalikant is holding his daughter captive. Meanwhile, Suraj begins crafting a new plan.

episodesList.title: Suraj Gives Jagriti a Surprise
episodesList.summary: Suraj and Jagriti save Dr. Verma’s daughter from Kalikant’s goons and take her to a safe place. Suraj pretends to forget their anniversary in front of Jagriti and later gives her a surprise.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Falls Prey to Another Ploy
episodesList.summary: Jagriti and Suraj celebrate their anniversary. To protect Neeti from abuse, Jagriti shoots her husband, leading to his death and her arrest. Kalikant steps in to support Neeti financially.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Gets Jailed
episodesList.summary: Jagruti gets jailed, prompting Suraj to vow justice for her. While Ganga prays for Jagriti, Kalikant attempts to render her unconscious. Inside the cell, Jagriti encounters a mysterious woman.

episodesList.title: Suraj and Jagriti are Targeted In an Attack
episodesList.summary: In jail, a fellow inmate empowers Jagriti. Meanwhile, Kalikant warns her that his goons are out to eliminate Suraj. They attack Suraj, while a few female prisoners gang up on Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Geeta Saves Jagriti’s Life
episodesList.summary: Sapna saves Suraj, while Geeta rescues Jagriti. Suraj confesses he couldn’t save Dr Verma. Acting on Suraj's lead, Sapna sets out to get evidence against Kalikant and finds a letter.

episodesList.title: Suraj Picks Up The Gun Again For Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Jagriti protects Geeta from the other prisoners, and Geeta explains to her the reason for her prolonged absence. Suraj takes up the gun again to save Jagriti and forces Neeti to testify to the police.

episodesList.title: Neeti Testifies to Jagriti's Innocence
episodesList.summary: Under Suraj's threats, Neeti testifies to Jagriti's innocence at the police station. Kalikant kills Suraj's ally, prompting Suraj to vow revenge. Meanwhile, Jagriti takes Geeta to a safe house.

episodesList.title: Suraj's Plan to Kill Kalikant
episodesList.summary: Jagriti reaches the warehouse, foiling Suraj's plan to kill Kalikant. In a calculated move, Kalikant gets Kachori admitted to the hospital, where Suraj shows up and threatens him at gunpoint.

episodesList.title: Will Suraj and Jagriti Lose Their Lives?
episodesList.summary: Jagriti and Suraj inform the Chittas about Kalikant’s actions, and they burn down the hospital. Kalikant gets Suraj and Jagriti kidnapped and injects them with a drug to kill them.

episodesList.title: The Police Find Sudha's Corpse
episodesList.summary: Suraj administers an antidote to save Jagriti’s life. The police find Sudha’s corpse, but Kalikant’s man burns it to avoid a postmortem. Meanwhile, Kalikant plots against the Chittas's settlement.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Secures Kalikant's Confession
episodesList.summary: Jagriti saves the settlers from Kalikant’s deadly plot. Kalikant discovers that Geeta is alive. Jagriti secures a confession of his crimes, but Kalikant escapes her custody.

episodesList.title: Geeta Betrays Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Geeta gives Kalikant the evidence gathered against him. Suraj stops Jojo from taking her life. Promoted at work, Jagruti returns home and urges Suraj to abandon his plan to kill Kalikant.

episodesList.title: Geeta Spies On Suraj
episodesList.summary: Geeta comes to the haveli to spy on Suraj and informs Kalikant that Suraj has found his address. Meanwhile, Suraj reaches Kalikant's location and falls into his trap.

episodesList.title: Geeta's Next Move Against Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Jagriti arrives in time to save Suraj's life. Meanwhile, Geeta tries to have key documents stolen from Jagriti’s room. Later, an incident sparks Suraj’s suspicion towards Geeta.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Arrests Suraj
episodesList.summary: Suraj confides in Sapna about his doubts, prompting her to keep an eye on Geeta. Kalikant urges Geeta to create a rift between Suraj and Jagriti. Later, Jagriti arrests Suraj for possessing weapons.

episodesList.title: Suraj Learns About Geeta’s Ploy
episodesList.summary: Suraj learns about Geeta’s ploy. A woman promises Jojo to introduce him to his parents. Meanwhile, Geeta tries to steal important information from Jagriti’s laptop, and Suraj plays a clever trick.

episodesList.title: Suraj's Attempt to Expose Geeta
episodesList.summary: Geeta plots to steal the file, but Suraj discovers an army uniform in her suitcase and suspects she's hiding the truth about Amitabh’s death. On Jojo’s birthday, he exposes Geeta.

episodesList.title: Where did Jojo Vanish During Her Birthday Party?
episodesList.summary: Geeta lies to Suraj, sparking a heated argument with Jagriti. Meanwhile, Jojo mysteriously vanishes from her birthday party, leaving everyone worried. Suraj, Sapna and Jagriti then devise a plan.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Learns About Amitabh's Death
episodesList.summary: Jagriti and Suraj learn the truth about Amitabh’s death. Jojo steals from the house. Sapna finds papers in Geeta’s room, shows them to Jagriti, who begins to uncover Geeta’s real motive.

episodesList.title: Suraj Stops Jagriti From Arresting Geeta
episodesList.summary: Jagriti learns about Geeta’s link to Kalikant and decides to arrest her, but Suraj intervenes. Later, Jagriti devises a plan to stop Geeta from committing any further crimes.

episodesList.title: Geeta Reveals Her Mission to Suraj
episodesList.summary: Geeta fires at Jagriti and Suraj when they corner her. They later hold her captive and question her about her mission. Geeta reveals her mission to Suraj and admits to betraying Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Kalindi Betrays Jojo
episodesList.summary: Jagriti calls the police to arrest Geeta, but Suraj helps her flee. Meanwhile, Kalindi teams up with Tarini to deceive Jojo. Later, Jagriti, Suraj and Sapna find Jojo lying unconscious.

episodesList.title: Jojo Orchestrates a Theft In The House
episodesList.summary: Suraj, Jagriti and Sapna decide to celebrate Diwali for Jojo. During the aarti, Jojo orchestrates a theft in the house, which makes Jagriti suspicious. Later, Sapna tries to make Jojo confess.

episodesList.title: Geeta Holds Sapna Captive
episodesList.summary: Tarini and Kalindi quarrel, and Tarini turns Jojo against her. Suraj and Jagriti rescue Kalindi from Jojo. Later, Geeta captures Sapna, while Jagriti rushes to defuse a bomb.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Holds Suraj and Sapna Captive
episodesList.summary: Suraj brings the Defence Minister’s security plan documents to Geeta, but Kalikant holds both him and Sapna captive. To protect her child, Sapna is forced to join hands with Kalikant.

episodesList.title: Geeta Comes to Kill The Defence Minister
episodesList.summary: Sapna and Suraj escape Kalikant’s captivity and warn Jagriti about Geeta. Geeta arrives with bombs strapped to children, aiming to kill the Defence Minister. Jagriti tries desperately to stop her.

episodesList.title: Geeta is Killed By a Bullet Fired By Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Geeta ignores Jagriti’s pleas and tries to kill the Defence Minister. Jagriti shoots her, resulting in Geeta’s death. Later, Jagriti performs her last rites, fulfilling her duty as a daughter.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Decides to Perform Chhath Puja
episodesList.summary: Jagriti decides to perform Chhath Puja. Suraj and Sapna fail to lift her spirits. Akash visits Sapna to ask for another chance, while Jagriti’s senior officer pays her a visit.

episodesList.title: Jagriti is Honoured With The Gallantry Award
episodesList.summary: Akash offers Sapna medicine, but she declines. Jagriti is honored with a gallantry award, cheered on by Suraj. She later panics when Suraj suddenly collapses.

episodesList.title: The Doctor Declares Suraj's Condition Critical
episodesList.summary: The family admits Suraj to the hospital, and the doctor declares his condition critical. A disguised Akash helps Jagriti, who bravely secures blood for Suraj after confronting goons.

episodesList.title: Suraj Attacks Jagriti
episodesList.summary: After regaining consciousness, Suraj's memory regresses by two years. He grabs Jagriti by the throat, calling her a Chitta girl. Later, Kalindi tries to convince him that Jagriti is his wife.

episodesList.title: Jagriti's Tough Decision For Suraj's Sake
episodesList.summary: Suraj is shaken by Kalindi’s words. Jagriti then asks Sapna to temporarily pose as Suraj’s wife. Later, Suraj searches for Akash, while Jagriti also tries to track him down.

episodesList.title: Akash Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Suraj suspects Jagriti of hiding Akash and points a gun at her, but just then, Akash returns. Suraj begins searching for Kalikant and argues with Akash. Later, he decides to bring Kalikant home.

episodesList.title: Suraj Speaks With Kalikant Over The Phone
episodesList.summary: While searching for Kalikant, Suraj speaks to him on the phone, only to be left more shaken. Later, Akash resolves to win Jagriti back, while Sapna is unsettled when Suraj takes care of her.

episodesList.title: Jealousy Grips Jagriti As She Sees Suraj With Sapna
episodesList.summary: Jagriti tries to stop Suraj from inviting guests to Sapna’s birthday party. Jealous of their dance, she’s shaken when unexpected guests arrive, and a revelation follows.

episodesList.title: Suraj Unleashes Mayhem In The Chitta Settlement
episodesList.summary: Kalikant’s man tells Suraj that he’s been captured by the Chittas. Furious, Suraj tortures Jagriti and unleashes chaos in the Chitta settlement. Later, he confronts Sapna with a pointed question.

episodesList.title: Akash Knocks Suraj Unconscious
episodesList.summary: Suraj looks for Ghungroo and Jagriti messages him from Ghungroo’s number. Sapna grows suspicious of Akash, who in Jagriti’s room. Suraj sees the tattoo on his hand and Akash knocks him unconscious.

episodesList.title: Is Sapna Falling In Love With Suraj?
episodesList.summary: The family gets the tattoo of Jagruti’s name removed from Suraj’s hand. Suraj tries to get closer to Sapna, who starts feeling drawn to him. Aakash vows to erase Suraj’s presence from Jagruti’s life.

episodesList.title: Suraj Saves Jagriti From Goons
episodesList.summary: Kalindi tries to rekindle Sapna’s feelings for Suraj. When a few goons harass Jagriti, Suraj rushes to save her. Later, both arrive at a familiar roadside eatery.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Akash plays a trick to deliver news to Kalikant. Jagriti tries to remind Suraj of the past, but he storms off. Later, Kalikant’s men abduct Akash, and Kalikant finally returns home.

episodesList.title: Suraj Stops Kalikant’s Arrest
episodesList.summary: Jagriti attempts to arrest Kalikant, but Suraj intervenes and stops her. Together, they intimidate her. Later, Jagriti uses the threat of arrest to strike a deal with Kalikant.

episodesList.title: Suraj Sees Glimpses Of The Past
episodesList.summary: The police bring Akash home. Suraj sees flashes of the past and pushes Kalikant. Later, Kalikant reminds Akash of his purpose, while Suraj and Jagriti begin to grow closer.

episodesList.title: Sp Subodh Comes to Search The Mansion
episodesList.summary: Sapna grows uneasy seeing Suraj and Jagriti close and Jagriti questions her. Avni and Arjun are tasked with an essay on the Chitta community. Later, SP Subodh arrives to search the mansion.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Makes a Cunning Move
episodesList.summary: Kalindi plants Kalikant’s camera in Subodh’s shirt. Suraj insults the Chittas in their settlement, while Kalindi and Akash weave a conspiracy. Later, Kalikant overhears the police officials.

episodesList.title: Suraj and Jagriti Growing Closeness Unsettles Sapna
episodesList.summary: Suraj helps Jagriti make pots, leaving Sapna uneasy as they grow closer. At the mansion, Kalikant looks for evidence against himself, while Avni’s words leave Suraj stunned.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Saves The Villagers From Suraj’s Anger
episodesList.summary: Sapna stops Suraj from speaking to Jagriti. When the villagers burn Kalikant’s effigy, Suraj erupts until Kalikant calms him. Later, Jagriti spots Akash's injury and questions him.

episodesList.title: The Bracelet Given By Suraj Angers Sapna
episodesList.summary: Suraj promises Kalikant to bring the evidence from Jagriti. Bunty again pressures Akash for money. Later, Suraj gets Sapna a bracelet, but when she sees Jagriti’s name engraved, her fury erupts.

episodesList.title: Bunty Abducts Suraj
episodesList.summary: Kalindi notices Sapna’s love for Suraj and instigates her to claim him. Haunted by the past, Suraj drifts closer to Jagriti, until Bunty abducts him and calls Akash.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Rescues Suraj From Bunty's Captivity
episodesList.summary: Akash admits he once borrowed heavily from Bunty. Jagriti storms his den, pays him off, rescues Suraj, and sets her sights on gathering evidence to bring Bunty down.

episodesList.title: Suraj Comes to Help Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Jagriti sets out to gather evidence against Bunty, with Suraj by her side. Yet, her concern for Akash leaves Suraj disheartened, while Sapna’s growing feelings for Suraj unsettle Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Suraj Abducts The Judge’s Family
episodesList.summary: Posing as Ghungroo, Jagriti speaks with Suraj on the phone as he confesses his feelings. Provoked by Kalikant, Suraj abducts the judge’s wife and daughter, while Akash watches with delight.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Saves The Judge’s Family
episodesList.summary: Suraj seeks all the evidence against Kalikant to release the judge’s family. Jagriti rescues them, but Suraj orders an attack on her. What follows is a shocking turn of events.

episodesList.title: Suraj’s Behaviour Shocks Sapna
episodesList.summary: Suraj thrashes his men to bring Jagriti home. Hurt by this, Kalikant punishes himself. Akash seeks closeness with Jagriti, while Suraj’s behaviour leaves Sapna deeply shaken.

episodesList.title: Sapna Refuses to Take Akash’s Blood
episodesList.summary: Jagriti reveals to SP Subodh the truth about Suraj’s condition and his stay at Kalikant’s mansion. At the hospital, Sapna refuses Akash’s blood, while Jagriti struggles to control a drunken Suraj.

episodesList.title: Sapna and Suraj Plan Their Baby’s Room Decor
episodesList.summary: Akash’s concern for Sapna’s baby sparks Suraj’s anger. He urges Jagriti to be stern for Suraj’s good. Later, Sapna asks Suraj to decorate a room for their child.

episodesList.title: Suraj Proposes to Sapna For Marriage
episodesList.summary: Jagriti foils Kalikant's plan to obtain evidence. Suraj questions Kalikant about matters related to his marriage and, deciding to relive his wedding moments, proposes to Sapna.

episodesList.title: Sapna Agrees to Marry Suraj
episodesList.summary: Sapna agrees to marry Suraj, which breaks Jagriti’s heart. Suraj plans to get remarried to regain his memory. Later, Kalindi spikes Jagriti's drink.

episodesList.title: Aakash Turns The Tables On Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Kalindi and Jagriti’s juice glasses get swapped, ruining Kalikant’s plan. Jagriti hires fake priests for Suraj and Sapna’s wedding, but Akash has them abducted.

episodesList.title: Akash Plays a Cunning Trick
episodesList.summary: Jagriti calls fake priests, but Akash gets them abducted. Suraj brings real priests, who begin rituals for Akash, Jagriti and Suraj, Sapna's weddings. As the garland moment nears, Jagriti panics!

episodesList.title: A Shocking Incident During The Wedding
episodesList.summary: Jagriti discovers Kalikant is close to the evidence and halts the wedding to reach him, only to find a shocking truth. Before Sapna’s marriage ritual with Suraj is completed, a stunning twist erupts.

episodesList.title: Suraj Abducts Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Suraj abducts Jagriti to uncover the truth of their past. Kalikant tricks the police to seize evidence, while Akash allies with Sapna to separate Suraj and Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Sapna Remains Silent At Jagriti’s Insult
episodesList.summary: Jagriti rushes Suraj to hospital as his condition worsens, where Kalikant comes in disguise. The doctor advises Sapna to reveal the truth. Later, Suraj lashes out at Jagriti while Sapna stays silent.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Tries to Understand Suraj’s Mental State
episodesList.summary: Jagriti warns Kalikant of jail, while Lochan secretly films Suraj and Sapna together. Later, Jagriti searches for Suraj’s report, anxious to uncover the truth about his troubled mind state.

episodesList.title: Jagriti’s Decision to Tell Suraj The Truth
episodesList.summary: Jagriti manages to stop Kalikant from threatening Suraj’s doctor. The doctor urges her to reveal the truth, and when she tells Suraj, she find out that he has regained his memory.

episodesList.title: Suraj Misbehaves With Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Suraj calls Jagriti a liar and mistreats her. When Sapna defends her, he lashes out at Sapna. Later, Kalikant mocks Jagriti’s defeat and traps Suraj in a devious new plot.

episodesList.title: Sapna Once Again Betrays Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Jagriti asks Sapna to tell Suraj the truth, but Sapna tells Suraj that she is his wife. Hurt by Sapna’s betrayal, Jagriti challenges her, saying she will not be able to take Suraj away from her.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Makes a Firm Decision
episodesList.summary: Jagriti tells Sapna that she will help Suraj regain his memory and devises a plan with Bindi. Sapna burns the memories of Suraj and Jagriti. An incident occurs in Chita Basti, and Suraj arrives there.

episodesList.title: A Conspiracy Unfolds Against Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Kalikant foils Jagriti's plan made with the help of her colony residents to remind Suraj of his past. She goes to him to make a deal, but he refuses. Later, a conspiracy unfolds against Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Sapna is Shocked By Jagriti's Plot
episodesList.summary: Jagriti learns that Sapna has joined hands with Kalikant. In his sleep, Suraj mutters an important truth to her. Jagriti plots to keep Sapna away from Suraj, leaving Sapna shocked.

episodesList.title: Sapna Tries to Prove Jagriti a Murderer
episodesList.summary: Sapna learns about Jagriti’s plan to separate Suraj from her. She and Kalikant reveal the truth about Ghungroo’s death to Suraj. Ghungroo’s mother tells Suraj that Jagriti had Ghungroo killed.

episodesList.title: Suraj Points a Gun At Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Suraj points a gun at Jagriti to kill her, but Kalikant stops him. Feeling insulted by Kachori, Sapna tells Suraj to burn Kachori’s house. Later, Jagriti tries to remind Suraj of their relationship.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Abducts Suraj
episodesList.summary: Despite Jagriti’s pleas, Suraj sets Kachori’s house ablaze. Later, Jagriti abducts Suraj in a bid to restore his memory, while Akash tells Sapna that Jagriti has hidden Suraj somewhere.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Tells Suraj About Geeta
episodesList.summary: In the basement with Suraj, Jagriti tries to help him recall his past while hiding from Akash and Sapna. Akash knocks Ganga unconscious to steal a key. Later, Jagriti reveals the truth about Geeta.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Risks Her Life For Suraj
episodesList.summary: Akash rescues Suraj from Jagriti’s captivity. She straps a bomb to herself and sends him a video. Suraj crashes rushing to her, yet saves her and declares his memories have returned.

episodesList.title: Jagriti and Suraj have Kalikant Arrested
episodesList.summary: Suraj apologises to Jagriti and together they have Kalikant arrested. Akash informs Sapna that Suraj has regained his memory. Afterwards, Jagriti presents all the evidence against Kalikant.

episodesList.title: Suraj Betrays Jagriti
episodesList.summary: Jagriti fails to present evidence against Kalikant in court. Shocked, she learns Suraj is still with him and has stolen and burnt the proof. His betrayal leaves her devastated.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Fails to Get Kalikant Punished
episodesList.summary: With no evidence, Kalikant walks free and prepares for elections. Jagriti targets him in a drug case, but Kalikant and Suraj plot to poison her, leaving Himmatpur on edge.

episodesList.title: Suraj Fires a Gun At Kalikant
episodesList.summary: The poison worsens Jagriti’s condition, while Suraj demands the antidote from Kalikant and fires when denied. Later, Suraj seeks forgiveness from Kalikant, who injects him with an ulterior motive.

episodesList.title: Will Jagriti be Able to Save Suraj In Time?
episodesList.summary: Akash tries to force marriage on Jagriti, but she reproaches him. Suraj’s refusal to kill her enrages Kalikant, who torments him. Later, Jagriti rushes to save Suraj but faces Kalikant’s threat.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Returns to Save Suraj
episodesList.summary: Jagriti leaves Mokshgarh at Sapna’s behest, but Suraj’s cry for help brings her back. The Chittas fight off Kalikant’s goons to save them, while Akash finally realises his mistake.

episodesList.title: Suraj Apologises to The Chittas
episodesList.summary: Jagriti rescues Suraj and hospitalises him, and Sapna admits her mistake. Together, Suraj, Sapna, Akash and Jagriti free Ganga from Kalikant’s captivity. Finally, Suraj seeks the Chittas’ forgiveness!

episodesList.title: Suraj is Ready For a Tough Test
episodesList.summary: Akash reveals a past truth to Suraj, leaving him in turmoil. Kalikant abducts Jagriti, and Suraj’s search leads him to a temple, where a Baba challenges him to face a daunting trial.

episodesList.title: Suraj and Jagriti Get Kalikant Arrested
episodesList.summary: Suraj regains his memory after the trial and rushes to Kalikant’s den to save Jagriti. Together they succeed in their daring plan, as police storm in and finally arrest the dreaded Kalikant!

episodesList.title: Jagriti Decides to Reunite Sapna and Akash
episodesList.summary: Suraj apologises to Jagriti for his mistakes. The police lock Kalikant in custody and beat him. Later, Sapna decides to divorce Akash, but Jagriti tries to reunite them.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Shows His Brutality
episodesList.summary: The family members forget their grudges and unite. Kalikant escapes from police custody. Later, he ties up the family and the people of the colony and tries to burn them alive together.

episodesList.title: Kalikant Threatens to Kill Avni and Arjun
episodesList.summary: Jagriti confronts Kalikant and overpowers him, but he threatens to blow up Avni and Arjun, forcing her to falter, and incites the crowd to attack Suraj and Jagriti.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Ends Kalikant’s Life
episodesList.summary: Kalikant attacks Jagriti and Suraj, but Jagriti kills him in a fierce fight. Later, Kalindi is shaken to the core after reading Kalikant’s shocking will.

episodesList.title: Kalikant’s will Sparks Fresh Turmoil
episodesList.summary: All are shocked to learn from Kalikant's will that he left his property to Atish and Nikita. Gheesu reveals Kalikant's illicit affair to Jagriti, who sets out with Suraj to meet Atish and Nikita.

episodesList.title: The Will’s Revelation Drives Aatish Crazy
episodesList.summary: Jagriti and Suraj bring Aatish and Nikita to the mansion, revealing they inherit Kalikant’s wealth. Shocked, Aatish orders the Thakur family to leave, while Ganga makes a heartfelt plea.

episodesList.title: Aatish Lets The Family Stay In The Mansion
episodesList.summary: Jagriti reveals Kalikant’s cruelty to Aatish, convincing him to let the Thakur family stay in the mansion. Later, Suraj confides in Jagriti why he does not wish to have a child.

episodesList.title: Fate Challenges Suraj and Jagriti’s Dreams
episodesList.summary: Jagriti confides in Nikita that Suraj doesn’t want children. The family stages a pretence to sway him, but as time passes and pregnancy tests remain negative, Jagriti grows disheartened.

episodesList.title: Bad News Awaits Jagriti From Her Doctor
episodesList.summary: Sapna struggles with daughter Pari while Jagriti cares for her. Jagriti’s condition worsens and the doctor reveals she cannot bear a child. Meanwhile, Sapna begins searching for a new life partner.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Shattered By The Pain Of Childlessness
episodesList.summary: Jagriti breaks down over the sorrow of not becoming a mother, and Suraj tries to console her. Shocked by the truth, Ganga is left reeling, and soon a heated clash erupts between Ganga and Sapna.

episodesList.title: Aatish and Nikita’s Dangerous Conspiracy
episodesList.summary: Aatish traps Sapna in a scheme and whisks her to Delhi. Ganga urges Jagriti to quit her job and perform a ritual to conceive. Later, Nikita entrusts Jagriti with Pari’s care.

episodesList.title: Suraj and Jagriti Discover Aatish’s Reality
episodesList.summary: Sapna, unaware of Aatish’s ploy, is drawn to him and spends time together. Meanwhile, Nikita drugs the family to flee with Pari. Suraj and Jagriti uncover Aatish’s reality and a crucial revelation.

episodesList.title: Jagriti Discovers Aatish and Nikita’s Ploy
episodesList.summary: Jagriti and Suraj discover Aatish and Nikita’s plot. The child welfare department then seizes Pari from Sapna. Later, Jagriti fails to gather evidence against them.

episodesList.title: Suraj is Accused Of Drug Trafficking
episodesList.summary: Jagriti tries to gather proof against Aatish and Nikita, but fails. They reveal the reason behind their hatred towards the Thakur family, and soon Suraj faces drug trafficking charges!

episodesList.title: Jagriti Gets Aatish Arrested
episodesList.summary: The police arrest Suraj and take him away, but this turns out to be part of Jagriti’s plan. By threatening the man who helped Aatish, Jagriti traps Aatish and gets him arrested.

episodesList.title: Aatish and Nikita Seek Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: When a fire breaks out, Suraj and Jagriti risk their lives to save Nikita. Aatish and Nikita seek forgiveness, but Jagriti spares them with a condition. Soon after, Jagriti learns she is pregnant.

episodesList.title: The Thakur Family Reunites
episodesList.summary: The family celebrates Jagriti’s pregnancy. Meanwhile, Sapna forgives Akash, and they reunite. Later, SP Subodh entrusts Jagriti with a new mission, while Suraj inspires her to honour her police duty.

plotHtml:
The show explores themes of social injustice, discrimination, courage, and the pursuit of a better future, revolving around the life of Jagriti, a young girl from the marginalized "Chitta" community in the fictional town of Mokshgarh, Jharkhand. The Chitta community is unjustly branded as 'criminal' from birth by the oppressive and powerful landlord Kalikant Thakur. The community is denied basic rights, including education, and is forced into a life of crime and labor.
The story begins with seven-year-old Jagriti, who bravely questions the injustices faced by her people. She refuses to accept the societal branding and the tyrannical rule of Kalikant Thakur. Her relentless quest for dignity and rights for her community often puts her in conflict with the landlord and his authority.
After a traumatic childhood, Jagriti has been adopted into a wealthy family and has forgotten her past. She has now dedicated herself to becoming an IPS Officer, aspiring to fight for justice and make a difference in society.
In college, Jagriti clashes frequently with Suraj Thakur, the arrogant elder son of powerful landlord Kalikant Thakur. Despite their ongoing rivalry, there's an underlying tension between them. Jagriti, however, falls in love with Akash Thakur, Suraj’s younger brother, and they are set to marry. On the day of the wedding, Sapna, who has loved Akash since childhood, switches places with Jagriti. As a result, Sapna marries Akash, and Jagriti unknowingly marries Suraj.
Shortly after, Akash, enraged by the switch, attempts to force himself on Jagriti, but Suraj intervenes and saves her. This marks a turning point in Jagriti’s perception of Suraj. In the aftermath, as she begins to unravel buried memories, Jagriti gradually rediscovers her true identity and her roots in the Chitta community.
Determined to fight the injustice she was born into, she sets her sights on becoming an IPS officer. Suraj undergoes a dramatic transformation, turning against his corrupt father and becoming Jagriti’s strongest supporter. With his help, she clears the UPSC exam and returns to Mokshgarh as a symbol of justice and reform. Upon her return, Jagriti arrests Kalikant Thakur and presents compelling evidence against him in court. During his transfer to another facility, Kalikant is shot by Akash and falls into a coma, intensifying the conflict.
Over time, the deep bond formed through shared struggle and trust blossoms into love. Jagriti and Suraj fall for each other only after she becomes an IPS officer. When Jagriti is targeted in a bomb attack, Suraj saves her life, cementing their emotional connection. They soon remarry, this time by choice and mutual love.
After their remarriage, Jagriti and Suraj’s relationship faces turmoil when Sapna claims she is pregnant with Suraj’s child. Unknown to others, Akash is the real father and is blackmailing Sapna, threatening to kill the unborn child if she reveals the truth. Jagriti and Suraj eventually uncovers the deception, exposes Akash, and confirms the child’s true paternity. The revelation strengthens their bond and further isolates Akash.
Meanwhile, a major twist unfolds when Kalikant Thakur, previously in a coma, regains consciousness. To regain control over his empire without drawing suspicion, he kills his twin brother, Shashikant, and assumes his identity. Operating from the shadows, Kalikant resumes his manipulation and schemes, further endangering Jagriti’s mission and reigniting conflict in Mokshgarh.

title: Janakiyudeyum Abhiyudeyum Veedu
summary: Janakiyudeyum Abhiyudeyum Veedu (transl. Janaki and Abhi's Home) is an Indian Malayalam-language soap opera directed by Niju Soman. It is an official remake of the Hindi soap opera Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii. It stars Raneesha, Raksha Raj and Arathy Sojan in lead roles. The show aired from 17 June 2024 to 31 October 2025 on Asianet and OTT platform JioHotstar. The series was launched along with Santhwanam 2.
plot:
The story is about Alakapuri family, home of Suryanarayan and Prabhavati, they have four children: Abhiram, Ajay, Amal, and Amrita. As the eldest son, Abhiram holds a significant position in both the Alakapuri household and the Surya Prabha organization. His wife, Janaki, is the eldest daughter in law of the family, maintains unity, peace and happiness of the family. They have a four-year-old daughter, Ponnu.
The family faces challenges when Ajay and Amal get married, and their new wives enter the household.
reception: In the launch week, the show secured fourth position in TRP ratings. As of September 2024, the show got sixth position at 9 pm. Later it was shifted to 9.30 PM where it managed sixth position. From 16 December 2024, it was again shifted to 10.30 PM.

As part of premiere Yuva Krishna, Raksha Raj and Baby Sasha promoted the TV series on Bigg Boss Malayalam season 6. They entered Bigg Boss House on Day 94, met the contestants and shared the details about the series.
An event titled Tharolsavam, which was the launch event for Janakiyudeyum Abhiyudeyum Veedu and another TV series Santhwanam 2 and the relaunch of Star Singer Season 9, was held at Kannur. The event aired on Asianet on 16 June 2024 a day before the show's launch.

articleSections.title: Original series
articleSections.text:
The original version Hindi language series, Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii, was created by Ekta Kapoor under the banner of her production company Balaji Telefilms. The show aired on StarPlus from 16 October 2000 to 9 October 2008, which starred Sakshi Tanwar and Kiran Karmarkar.
16 years after the broadcast of Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii, Disney Star Network Marathi language channel Star Pravah planned to remake it in Marathi as Gharoghari Matichya Chuli, which started on 18 March 2024. One month later, the Tamil remake Veetuku Veedu Vaasapadi started 22 April 2024., followed by a Kannada remake, Janaki Samsara on Star Suvarna from 6 May 2024. The Telugu and Malayalam remake versions, Intinti Ramayanam and Janakiyudeyum Abhiyudeyum Veedu, respectively started in June the same year.

title: Jamnapaar
summary:
Jamnapaar is an Indian Hindi-language drama television series directed by Prashant Bhagia. The series features Ritvik Sahore, Srishti Ganguly and Raghu Ram in the lead role. The first season premiered on Amazon miniTV on 24 May 2024.
The second season was released on 10 October 2025.
reception: Abhishek Srivastava of Times of India gave it a rating of 3 out of 5 saying that, The Trans-Yamuna milieu is perfectly captured by the show's creators, which reflects in both the dialect and mannerisms. Sonal Pandya from Times Now gave it a rating 3 out of 5 saying that "Jamnapaar has a shaky intro as it tries to lean into humour a bit with the series narrator being the Metro. The show works much better as it focuses on Shanky and his desire to make something of himself."

episodesList.title: Kuyein Ka Mendhak
episodesList.summary: Shantanu Bansal aka Shanky is living an unremarkable life in Laxminagar, Jamnapaar. However, one day a chance visit to a fancy Gurgaon client puts things into perspective for him and Shanky comes back totally enamoured by the corproate dream across the Yamuna river and a false sense of acknowledegement.

episodesList.title: Hath Ko Aaya, Muh Na Laga
episodesList.summary: Shanky is determined to go back to Lunatek, the fancy Gurgaon firm, by hook or by crook. Meanwhile all Jamnapaar forces align against him, making him feel more claustrophobic about his Jamnapaar life.

episodesList.title: Darr Ke Aage Jeet Hai?
episodesList.summary: Shanky, after failing to secure the Gurgaon client, finds out there's still a chance to secure an articleship transfer in a Big 4 across Yamuna. His quest ends in public embarrassment as he swears to leave Jamnapaar for good.

episodesList.title: Papa Kehte Hain!
episodesList.summary: After securing AIR 5 in all of Delhi in CA Finals, Shanky's father announces him as the successor of KD Bansal classes. However, things go really south when Shanky tells his father he has already secured a job in south delhi and has no interest in running his coaching classes.

episodesList.title: Fish Out of Water
episodesList.summary: After a major showdown with his father, Shanky has left jamnapaar and is struggling to adapt in his South Delhi life. However, a lecture leak scandal involving his father makes him take a resolve that he will never return to Jamnapaar.

episodesList.title: Fake It Till You Make It
episodesList.summary: Despite becoming Shan from Shantanu and undergoing a 360 degree makeover, Shantanu is still not able to fit in South Delhi. However, one chance encounter with his gorgeous cafe owner client, Sara, gives him a unique mantra to win South Delhi over and that he does!

episodesList.title: Heart Vs Brain
episodesList.summary: Shantanu is thriving in South Delhi and enjoying his fancy new clients, cool friend circle and blossoming romance with Sara. However, Shantanu soon finds himself very torn as a very lucrative partnership offer presents itself but in exchange of his morals that also costs him an important family event.

episodesList.title: Father Figure
episodesList.summary: Shantanu's mother Pushpa Bansal meets with an accident which brings Shantanu back to Jamnapaar. Ego clashes between Shantanu and KD Bansal erupt again and Shantanu realises his father will never understand his feelings or potential and goes in the tutelage of his childhood idol, newfound mentor and star entrepreneur, Rajat Thapar.

episodesList.title: Jamnapaari Sab Pe Bhaari
episodesList.summary: Shantanu is arrested by the Economics Offence Division (EoD) over financial fraud charges in partnership with Rajat Thapar. When all his South Delhi friends and acquaintances fail to stand by him, Shantanu realises it is ultimately Jamnapaar, his own neighbourhood, which rallies behind him in support and brings him out of the custody.

episodesList.title: Gharwapsi
episodesList.summary: Shantanu comes back home to Jamnapaar as he awaits the CA council's decision in his case. In the meantime, he makes amends with everyone he had judged and hurt in Jamnapaar. He loses his CA license for a year but realises a much more valuable lesson i.e. it's not which part of the city you're born in, it matters what people are you born amongst.

episodesList.title: Paisa Ya Morals
episodesList.summary: Suspended CA Shantanu “Shanky” Bansal battles between ambition and integrity as scams, love, and family ideals collide. Just as he begins to find his moral compass, a tragic fire at Bansal Classes forces him to question the ethics he thought he stood for.

episodesList.title: Kehni Aur Karni
episodesList.summary: Amid audits and political heat after the Bansal Classes fire, Shanky clashes with his father over bribery and ethics, losing both faith and love. Pushed by desperation, he finally joins his friends’ scam ring—only to step into the perilous world of Shaukeen Bhaiyya.

episodesList.title: Chance Pe Dance
episodesList.summary: Trapped in Shaukeen Bhaiyya’s shady empire, Shanky dives into cons to survive as Bansal Classes crumble and family tensions erupt. In a daring move, he saves his home through deceit—marking the start of his moral downfall

episodesList.title: Apne Paraaye
episodesList.summary: As Jamnapaar turns on the Bansals, Shanky’s uneasy alliance with Shaukeen fuels suspicion and chaos. When a violent sabotage forces the family to flee their own home, Shanky faces the haunting cost of power and betrayal.

episodesList.title: Full Power
episodesList.summary: Exiled to Shailja's place and disillusioned, Shanky finds power and purpose in Shaukeen’s e-waste empire. But as Ramneek closes in and KD Bansal grows wary, Shanky’s newfound success begins to smell of danger.

episodesList.title: Morals Vs Progress
episodesList.summary: As Shanky hides Shaukeen’s empire behind a designer façade, the return of his ex, Sara, tangles business with buried emotions. But when KD uncovers family secrets and erupts, a storm tears through the Bansals—pitting father against son once and for all.

episodesList.title: CA - Calling
episodesList.summary: As Shanky rises as Shaukeen’s trusted lieutenant, his buried CA instincts resurface - blurring lines between pride and peril. But just as he finds purpose again, a family tragedy strikes Shanky.

episodesList.title: Pehchaan
episodesList.summary: KD returns from the brink of death with newfound humility and perspective on identity, mending his family and faith. As Shanky exposes a powerful conspiracy and fights for justice, the long-divided Bansals finally unite—just as a deeper storm looms ahead.

episodesList.title: Aakhri Attempt
episodesList.summary: As the Bansals rediscover unity and compassion, Shanky exposes the dark underbelly of Uncoaching’s online education empire. In a fiery showdown at an educational event, he turns the tide—toppling Saransh’s façade and reigniting Jamnapaar’s spirit.

episodesList.title: Galat Raste Ki Bus
episodesList.summary: Haunted by his past and craving redemption, Shanky’s world unravels just as hope returns to the Bansals. But Shanky’s search for truth explodes into a deadly face-off with Shaukeen himself leaving with him a big moral dilemma.

title: Jafaa
summary:
Jafaa (Urdu: جفا, lit. 'Tyranny') is a 2024 Pakistani drama television series written by Samira Fazal and directed by Danish Nawaz. Produced by Momina Duraid under the banner MD Productions, the series aired on 24 May 2024. It stars Mawra Hocane, Sehar Khan, Usman Mukhtar and Mohib Mirza. The series revolves around two cousins who face a range of emotions and mental struggle after their marriages.
The series received high ratings and significant digital viewership. It garnered mixed reviews from critics, with praise for Hocane's performance but criticism for its depiction of sensitive themes.
plot:
The story revolves around a college student, Andaleeb, and a gynecologist Dr. Zara. Andaleeb is deeply connected to her father. Andaleeb's secret relationship with her classmate Moiz blossoms, but they face obstacles due to classism, leading to their separation when her mother arranges a suitable match for her, despite her father's support for her and Moiz being together.
Meanwhile, the newlywed Dr. Zara struggles to understand her husband Hassan, only to discover his behaviour of gaslighting and emotional abuse. As she harbors secrets, her situation escalates to physical abuse. Zara decides to leave him, but later learns about his traumatic past. Despite her efforts, Hassan's behavior worsens, and Zara is hospitalized due to domestic violence.
Andaleeb's parents arrange her marriage to Dr. Numair, Zara's friend and an oncologist. Their relationship develops slowly, as Numair learns about Andaleeb's past affair with Moiz. The age difference of couple and the constant pressure to plan a baby by Numair's mother create tension. When Numair discovers he has azoospermia, it strains their relationship further.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Mawra Hocane as Dr. Zara Saleem (formerly Hassan): Gynecologist; Saleem and Tayyaba's daughter; Andaleeb's cousin; Hassan's ex wife * Sehar Khan as Andaleeb "Deebu" Numair (nee Jamal): Jamal and Sadia's daughter; Zara's cousin; Numair's wife; Anadil's mother * Usman Mukhtar as Dr. Numair Ansari : Oncologist; Maria's son; Nimra's brother; Andaleeb's husband; Anadil's father * Mohib Mirza as Hassan Ahsan : Nazia and Ahsan's son; Zara's ex husband

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: Principal photography commenced in Islamabad in November 2023. Hocane returned to the set in April 2024, after completing another project. She described her character as a gynecologist who navigates high-pressure situations in her marital life.

articleSections.title: Audience reception
articleSections.text: The series became one of the most-watched television series of Pakistan in 2024, and garnered high ratings, peaking at 7-8 in its finale episodes. The series garnered significant digital viewership and trended extensively on YouTube in India and Pakistan.

articleSections.title: Critical reception
articleSections.text: A critic from the DAWN Images positively reviewed the series, while noticing its multiple themes. A reviewer from The Express Tribune criticised the depiction of suicide without seeking counseling, sending a potentially harmful message to vulnerable viewers, however director Danish Nawaz argued that the attempted suicide shows the repercussions of forced marriage, emphasized that ending one's life isn't easy. Zainab Mossadiq of the DAWN Images praised the sensitive portrayal of social issues and strong relationships, but criticizes its handling of male fertility issues, absurd storyline, and abrupt ending. Sarah Brobi of the Aaj News praised the series for effectively portrays the plight of characters trapped in forced marriages, advocating for transparency and individual choice. However, the narrative is marred by unnecessary plot points, such as Numair's infertility, and a dragged-out conclusion that undermines the story's core message.

plotHtml:
The story revolves around a college student, Andaleeb, and a gynecologist Dr. Zara. Andaleeb is deeply connected to her father. Andaleeb's secret relationship with her classmate Moiz blossoms, but they face obstacles due to classism, leading to their separation when her mother arranges a suitable match for her, despite her father's support for her and Moiz being together.
Meanwhile, the newlywed Dr. Zara struggles to understand her husband Hassan, only to discover his behaviour of gaslighting and emotional abuse. As she harbors secrets, her situation escalates to physical abuse. Zara decides to leave him, but later learns about his traumatic past. Despite her efforts, Hassan's behavior worsens, and Zara is hospitalized due to domestic violence.
Andaleeb's parents arrange her marriage to Dr. Numair, Zara's friend and an oncologist. Their relationship develops slowly, as Numair learns about Andaleeb's past affair with Moiz. The age difference of couple and the constant pressure to plan a baby by Numair's mother create tension. When Numair discovers he has azoospermia, it strains their relationship further.

title: Jab Mila Tu
summary: Jab Mila Tu (transl. When I Met You) is an Indian Hindi-language drama television series directed by Lalit Mohan and written by Harneet Singh. Produced under A Two Nice Men Mediaworks Production, it stars Mohsin Khan, Eisha Singh, Pratik Sehajpal and Alisha Chopra. The series aired on JioCinema from 22 January 2024 to 26 February 2024.
reception: A critic writing for Times Now gave the series out of 5 stars. Arpita Mondal of Midgard Times awarded the series six-and-a-half out of ten stars. Aakash Kumar of Filmibeat said "Pratik Sehajpal Steals Hearts As Jigar In His New Show."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series was announced on JioCinema. Principal photography of the series wrapped in December 2023. The teaser of the series was released on 9 January 2024. Subsequently, the official trailer was released on 16 January 2024.

episodesList.title: What happened in Goa?
episodesList.summary: Star singer Maddy arrives in Goa for his next show where his biggest Fan Jigar follows him. Aneri, the baker and owner of "Jo's Cafe" gets a rude shock when intruders take possession of her house. How will she deal with them?

episodesList.title: Baja Diya Guitar
episodesList.summary: Aneri loses her cafe to her cheater boyfriend, Shaurya. Maddy struggles with old memories as he gets into a fight at a the beach shack. There is a bowl of pasta waiting in the kitchen. Will he get doubtful?

episodesList.title: You owe me 30D
episodesList.summary: Aneri is desperate for business as she gets a catering order, not knowing its form Maddy's team. Mint has her hands full as Maddy gets negative PR online. Jigar leaves his number on her bra and a video in her mail.

episodesList.title: The Secret Girlfriend
episodesList.summary: A media reporter manages to click a bare back pic of Aneri from one of the windows and it goes viral in no time as "Maddy's secret girlfriend". Media swarms the bungalow and Aneri finds it difficult to get out.

episodesList.title: The Party, the Mask, the Dance
episodesList.summary: A wild party at Maddy's bungalow brings Aneri and Maddy together for a dance. Chaos breaks out as Jigar encourages the band members in the party to 'load the gun.

episodesList.title: Cat in the House
episodesList.summary: Maddy finds the broken CCTV camera that Mint has installed for his safety. Maddy and Aneri share an awkward moment. Mint introduces Jigar to Maddy again and mentions that he could help Maddy in tracking the Secret Girlfriend's location.

episodesList.title: Jab Mila Chor
episodesList.summary: Sparks fly as Maddy finally gets hold of the Secret girlfriend in the bungalow. A glimpse of his fight with her goes viral. Mint runs to catch a glimpse of the imposter, but Prakaas has an interesting story to tell.

episodesList.title: The blackmailer Bit@#
episodesList.summary: Maddy feels that he has cracked a deal with Aneri and now she would stop posting his pictures on the secret girlfriend account. Shaurya gets Aneri arrested. Will she have her way out of this mess?

episodesList.title: The Butler in My Bungalow
episodesList.summary: Maddy insists Aneri becomes his butler to stay in the bungalow. Aneri, facing a loan reminder, accepts a brand collaboration offer from Mint's Secret Girlfriend Account, delighting Mint. The trap is set to reveal the Secret Girlfriend.

episodesList.title: A public apology!
episodesList.summary: Mint surprises Maddy unannounced. Panicking, he urges Aneri to leave, but she won't endure his rude behaviour. Maddy has 10 minutes to devise a plan for her discreet departure. Will he manage it without media attention?

episodesList.title: Silent Maddy.. Stripper Maddy..Killer Maddy
episodesList.summary: Maddy looses his voice due to the coffee prepared by Aneri for him due to which he cannot perform at Raj's party. Mint has a plan to sort this out and at the party, Not 1, but 2 Maddy arrives. Has Mint screwed up? How will Maddy react?

episodesList.title: Mai hoon Momo
episodesList.summary: Maddy, fed up with Aneri's games, and decides to end it. Maddy tasks Jigar to trick Aneri into revealing the Secret Girlfriend account. If Jigar succeeds Jigar earns a spot in Maddy's next album. Is he up for the challenge?

episodesList.title: Momo is home
episodesList.summary: Jigar accidentally crashes into Aneri's car and she gets him home. He straightaway jumps into the drama and pretends to remember the house from his childhood. Will Aneri believe that he is her Momo?

episodesList.title: Yeh tera ghar..ye mera ghar
episodesList.summary: Aneri and Jigar are getting closer and this triggers Maddy's jealousy. Amidst Aneri's search for her house's papers, Maddy gets flashes of his childhood. Will he remember Aneri?

episodesList.title: Jo's cafe on sale
episodesList.summary: Shaurya is trying to sell her cafe. Jigar promises to get it back. He wants Maddy to be a part of it too, but he refuses and asks Jigar to stick to the plan of getting the password to the SG account. Will Jigar be able to convince Maddy?

episodesList.title: What I don't like, I kill!
episodesList.summary: Agent Jigar and Aneri are on a mission to save the cafe, but it turns out that the buyer is a deadly drug mafia. Aneri's life is in danger. Will Maddy reach on time and help her get her cafe back?

title: Jodi Are U Ready
summary:
Jodi Are U Ready is an Indian Tamil-language reality television dance competition show and is the eleventh part of Jodi No.1. It premiered on 20 January 2024, and airs on Star Vijay every Saturday and Sunday. It is also available for streaming on Disney+ Hotstar. The first season premiered on 20 January 2024, and ended on 28 April 2024 with 29 episodes.
The second season premiered on 25 January 2025 and ended on 4 May 2025 with 29 episodes. The season was won by Abhinav and Rani Kumari, while Gowri Shankar and Ananya emerged as the runner up of the show. Gurunath and Arunima won third place.
The third season of this show is premiered 7 February 2026.

title: Jhanak
summary:
Jhanak is an Indian Hindi-language television drama series that aired on StarPlus from 20 November 2023 to 31 May 2026 and streams digitally on JioHotstar. Produced under Magic Moments Motion Pictures, the series originally starred Hiba Nawab, Krushal Ahuja and Chandni Sharma in the lead roles. The story of the first generation was inspired by the Star Jalsha's Bengali series, Jol Nupur.
Since June 2025, the show featured Riya Sharma in the titular role as Jhanak (the daughter of Jhanak, previously portrayed by Hiba Nawab), along with Arjit Taneja (replaced by Rajveer Singh) and Twinkle Arora. The second-generation storyline is a loose adaptation of Star Jalsha's Bengali series, Ishti Kutum.
The show also featured Megha Chakraborty as Ishani in a parallel storyline. Following the positive response to Ishani's storyline, it was developed into a standalone series titled Ishani, which premiered from 3 July 2025 to 27 October 2025.
plot:
After her mother's death, Jhanak is forced to marry her cousin Arshi's fiancé, Aniruddh, to escape her stalker, Tejas. Although Aniruddh and Arshi have been together for seven years, Jhanak enters their lives under distressing circumstances and begins to work as the Bose household's maid. While some family members treat her kindly, others insult and belittle her. Despite Arshi's presence, Jhanak and Aniruddh become close and become intimate when he is intoxicated during a trip to Kashmir.
Their secret marriage is exposed, causing major tension within the family. Though humiliated, Arshi decides to stay. Jhanak moves to Mumbai to pursue her dream of becoming a dancer and returns, claiming to be pregnant with Aniruddh's child. However, it is revealed to be a tumour. Aniruddh suffers a heart attack, and Jhanak is presumed dead after being targeted by Srishti and Tejas. She is rescued by Kulbhushan, Brijbhushan's lookalike, and soon learns that Brijbhushan is her biological father. Kulbhushan, with the help of Srishti and Urvashi, had stolen Brijbhushan's identity. Determined to expose them, Jhanak returns disguised as Nutan. During an anniversary celebration, their truth is revealed. Kulbhushan murders Brijbhushan, and Aniruddh, still in love with Jhanak, falsely claims to have cancer to marry her. Arshi reveals to everyone that she is pregnant with Aniruddh's child. It is revealed that she had spiked his drink and posed as Jhanak in order to have sex with him, hoping to bind him to her forever because of their baby. Upon discovering the truth, a heartbroken Jhanak breaks off ties with Aniruddh and leaves for Mumbai with Aditya Kapoor.
Kulbhushan's men kidnap Jhanak, but she manages to escape. Meanwhile, property disputes erupt in the Bose family, and Jhanak ends up in Gujarat disguised as Vihaan's late wife, Avni. She is shocked to discover that Aniruddh is Vihaan's close friend. At a family wedding, Arshi exposes Jhanak's true identity. A marriage is arranged between Jhanak and Vihaan, but she flees before the ceremony.
Jhanak is captured again by Kulbhushan's men but is saved by an elderly couple. She ends up in a red-light area and escapes to a police station, where Choton finds her and brings her back to the Bose house. During Arshi's baby shower, Srishti publicly apologises and claims to be Jhanak's mother. Arshi gives birth to a daughter and Jhanak becomes the caretaker of the child but continues to face humiliation and abuse from the family. Jhanak eventually learns that Arshi's daughter was swapped at birth. During the Holi festival, she exposes the truth and begins searching for the real child. Meanwhile, Laal divorces Bipasha after her father, Sarveshwar, reappears. Bipasha conspires with him to send Jhanak to Banaras.
Jhanak tracks down the man responsible for stealing Arshi's baby and attempts to expose him. Meanwhile, Mimi and Anirban plan their wedding, and a false case is filed against Jhanak. She is arrested, but Aniruddh and Mimi testify in her defence, revealing the constant mental abuse she endured in the Bose household. Inspector Sanjay Sarkar uncovers that several police officers helped Shubho, Tanuja, and Arshi frame Jhanak by suppressing evidence, and exposes this to the court. The judge dismisses the case due to lack of evidence and clears Jhanak of all charges. Shubho, Tanuja, and Arshi are left humiliated as the truth comes to light, and justice finally prevails for Jhanak.
Arshi meets Siddharth Chatterjee and quickly falls in love with him, while Aniruddh leaves the Bose house to live in a live-in relationship with Jhanak. When Aniruddh learns of Arshi's growing closeness to Siddharth, he insists that Arshi divorce him so that he can marry Jhanak and she can be with Siddharth. The divorce proceedings nearly reach completion, but Siddharth betrays Arshi and elopes with his girlfriend, leaving her devastated. Aniruddh and Jhanak return to the Bose house and begin their wedding preparations. However, on the wedding day, Arshi returns and refuses to grant the divorce. Heartbroken, Jhanak runs away and, on her journey, finds Arshi and Aniruddh's kidnapped daughter, Aditi, affectionately nicknamed "Moon". She rescues her, boards a bus, and meets Parashar, who saves them both from Kulbhushan's goons and takes them to Shimulbuni. Over time, Jhanak and Parashar grow close as he supports her and helps raise Moon as his own daughter.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: Jhanak is produced by Leena Gangopadhyay and Saibal Banerjee under Magic Moments Motion Pictures. It is inspired from Jol Nupur.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Hiba Nawab was cast in the titular role of Jhanak. Krushal Ahuja was cast as Aniruddha Bose opposite Hiba Nawab. Chandni Sharma was cast as Arshi, the parallel lead. Dolly Sohi was cast as Arshi's mother Srishti, while Kajal Pisal was cast as Aniruddh's mother Tanuja. Rishi Kaushik was cast as Tejas, Jhanak's obsessive lover.
In January 2024, Sohi quit the show and was replaced by Poorva Gokhale. In April 2024, Deepali Pansare was cast as Mrinalini, opposite Puneet Panjwani.
Zohaib Siddiqui and Erica Fernandes were approached to play the new leads post the generation leap, but Riya Sharma, Arjit Taneja and Twinkle Arora were finalized. Krushal Ahuja was replaced by Sumeet Sachdev as the older Anirudh, while Parvati Sehgal took over the role of the older Jhanak, replacing Nawab. Ashlesha Sawant replaced Chandni Sharma as older Arshi.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text:
The shooting of the series began in September 2023. It was primarily based in Kashmir and Kolkata, and some initial episodes were shot in both locations.
Nawab had learned to row a shikara within two days for the role of Jhanak.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: In June 2025, a promo for the twenty-year leap was released featuring Riya Sharma and Arjit Taneja as new leads, respectively playing Jhanak and Rishi. Taneja quit the show in September 2025, and was replaced by Rajveer Singh and the show's runtime extended to 45-minutes and shifted to 11.00 pm (IST).
