articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: Jassi Jaisi Koi Nahi is also known for its remarkable campaigning and marketing done by the channel to attract a huge audience before its launch. The main protagonist 'Jasmeet Walia' was hidden completely from the audience in promotions although the campaigning was focused on the character's uniqueness. This generated a lot of curiosity among its audience to know about the character. This was the first an Indian Television Channel took such a big risk to keep its series protagonist under wraps and still promoting it heavily. The risk paid off and the show opened with a bumper response on its premiere episode. The TV show was well received and it went on to run for three years.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Unforgettable Interview Session
episodesList.summary: Models and employees working in Gulmohar Fashion are shocked to see an ugly looking girl named Jasmeet Walia also known as Jassi in the fashion house. Nandu and Jassi share some light moments together and on the other side, Armaan reveals to Manchanda that he is searching for brilliant brains and not for beauty.  Armaan becomes the chairman of the company. Will Jassi get a decent job?

episodesList.title: Armaan Shocked to See Jassi
episodesList.summary: A heated argument takes place between Armaan and Mallika with regards to appointing Jasmeet as Armaan's secretary. Later, Jassi reveals her marketing strategy to increase the profits of Gulmohar Fashion House whereas Pari doesn't have any clue about Armaan's company's annual turn over. Will Jassi get a job in Gulmohar Fashion House? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Gulmohar Employees Make Fun Of Jassi
episodesList.summary: Jassi is happy when she comes to know about her new cabin. Jassi's cabin then goes to Pari and Jassi is shifted to the storeroom where Armaan assures her that she will soon get her cabin transformed. All the employees including Raj underestimate Jassi. Will Jassi succeed in impressing Armaan by showing her skills at work? Will Pari and Mallika create trouble for Jassi?

episodesList.title: Jassi Falls On The Ramp
episodesList.summary: All the employees of Gulmohar Fashion House are excited as it is Armaan's first Fashion show. The theme of the fashion show is Jaimala which is not available. Jassi is given the task to arrange the Jaimala. Will she succeed in arranging it? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Armaan Gives One Last Chance to Jassi
episodesList.summary: Jassi is not able to forget the incident that took place on the ramp with her. Mallika is furious on Armaan as he is dancing with other models Jassi's father indirectly motivates her as she is extremely upset. Armaan tries to persuade Mallika. Will Jassi gain her confidence back?

episodesList.title: Armaan Falls Into Trouble With a Model
episodesList.summary: Jassi tries to stop the model from going into Armaan's cabin as Malika has come to the office. Jassi goes to call Armaan saying it's an important meeting that he has to attend outside the office. But before Armaan comes to the reception to meet the fuming model, Pari reaches there and meets her. Will Pari tell Malika the truth?

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets Fired From Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Jassi is in trouble due to Mallika. She is scared that she might lose her job. Malika fires Jassi from her job. Armaan gets angry with Malika because of this and they both have a fight. What will be Jassi's faith? Will she be fired from Gulmohar?

episodesList.title: Jassi is Excited to Go Out With Raman
episodesList.summary: Jassi is very excited to go out with Raman and his friend's but she has to take permission from her father. Meanwhile, Armaan goes to Malika's house and is surprised. What is the surprise? Will Jassi get permission to go out?

episodesList.title: A Prank Played On Jassi
episodesList.summary: Jassi is very upset as Raman doesn't come to pick her up. The next day as Jassi enters her office she sees a picture of Armaan and herself labelled as The Perfect Couple stuck on her door. Who has played this prank? Will Armaan see this picture?

episodesList.title: Jassi Tries to Hide The Prank Photo
episodesList.summary: All the girls make fun of Jassi during lunchtime. Pari is upset with the way Armaan treats Jassi and complains to Malika. When Jassi is out for lunch, Pari sneaks into her office to find the report and cheat on her. Will Pari succeed in stealing the report?

episodesList.title: Jassi Lies to Her Father
episodesList.summary: Jassi comes home late and gets a firing from her father as he finds out that Jassi had lied to him about her work. Next day Jassi gets ready as it's an important day for her. When Jassi leaves for work her father and Nandu follow her to see where she works. Will Jassi's father come to know the truth?

episodesList.title: Aryan Also Presents a Report to The Board
episodesList.summary: Jassi is very upset as Pari stole her report and claimed it to be her own report. Finally, the girls in the office allow Jassi to sit with them for lunch. In the board meeting, an argument takes place between Armaan and Aryan. For the first time, two reports are presented in front of the board. Whose report will the board approve?

episodesList.title: Marriage Proposal For Jassi
episodesList.summary: Jassi's aunty comes with a marriage proposal for Jassi. Jassi's mom is happy to hear about the proposal and asks Nandu to help her to convince Jassi for marriage. Jassi confronts Pari on the report stealing issue. What will Jassi's reaction be on learning about the marriage proposal? Will Pari accept to her crime?

episodesList.title: Boy Coming Home to See Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan has a doubt on Pari stealing the reports and not working on it herself. Jassi's family is very excited about the proposal. Pari is worried as she has to make new plans and give it to Armaan in 2 days. Will Jassi know about the boy? Will Jassi agree for marriage?

episodesList.title: Armaan and Malika's Horoscopes Don't Match
episodesList.summary: Jassi's mother is very upset with Jassi's behaviour. Jassi tells her mother about her dreams and aspirations. Malika and Arman get their horoscopes matched. Jassi also starts working on making the new plan. Will Pari steal her plan this time as well?

episodesList.title: Jassi's Father Goes to Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Jassi and Nandu work on the financial plan throughout the night. Armaan is very angry as no one has come to the office on time. Meanwhile, Jassi sprains her leg on the way and Armaan shouts at Jassi which her father overhears on the phone and leaves for Jassi's office in anger.  What will happen when Jassi's father reaches Gulmohar?

episodesList.title: Armaan is Upset About The Reports
episodesList.summary: Angry Jassi's father reaches Gulmohar and asks for Armaan. The security guard refuses to let him in or call Armaan. Meanwhile, Armaan is angry and tells Pari about removing her and Jassi both from the job. Jassi gets scared about knowing that her father has come to the office and wants to meet Armaan. Will Jassi's father meet Armaan?

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets Her Job Back
episodesList.summary: Armaan is going through the financial report of Gulmohar when he realizes about the losses. He talks to Jassi about her plans for the company without realising that he has already fired her. Armaan offers the job back to Jassi. Will Pari be surprised knowing about Jassi's report?

episodesList.title: Armaan's Plan Gets Finalised
episodesList.summary: Jassi gets a shouting from Aryan at the reception area. Jassi tells Armaan that she saw Aryan in Armaan's office the night before. Why had Aryan come to Armaan's office? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Tarot Card Reading Reveals Her Love
episodesList.summary: According to the tarot cards there is someone special in Jassi's life. Jassi denies of liking or knowing someone who likes her. Armaan discusses the plan with Raj. Jassi's mind is hovering with thoughts of her liking Armaan. Does Jassi really have feelings for Armaan?

episodesList.title: Nandu Gets Married
episodesList.summary: Jassi is surprised to see the name initials of her lover. Later her friend tells her that the initials she is looking at is wrong and her lover's name initial is N. That's when Nandu calls Jassi and gives her the news of his wedding with Jassi. Will Jassi say yes for the marriage?

episodesList.title: Jassi and Maria Go For a Party
episodesList.summary: Jassi goes to a party with Maria without informing her family. Her family is tensed as Jassi has not yet reached home. Jassi's father calls at Gulmohar and asks for Jassi and her friend tells him that she has gone out with Maria. Will Jassi stay at the party or leave for home? What will be her parent's reaction when she reaches home?

episodesList.title: Jassi's Father Tells Jassi to Stop Working
episodesList.summary: Jassi's father opens the door for her. He is very furious because she went to a party without informing him. He tells Jassi that she won't be going to the office from tomorrow. Will Jassi listen to her father? Will she go to Gulmohar again?

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets Her First Salary
episodesList.summary: Jassi's friend hands over a confidential envelope to her and makes her sign the register stating that she had received the envelope. After opening the envelope Jassi sees her first salary cheque. She buys gifts for everyone as she gets her first salary but her father is upset? Will Jassi's father forgive Jassi?

episodesList.title: Armaan Goes For a Vacation
episodesList.summary: Jassi's father comes in the morning to wake her up for work. Armaan is late to office and Jassi talks to all the clients on his behalf. Raj's Secretary tells Jassi that Raj and Armaan both have gone on a vacation along with Pari and Mallika. Will Jassi also reach the holiday destination?

episodesList.title: Jassi Reaches The Vacation Spot
episodesList.summary: Armaan scolds Malika for not informing him about the bank loan. Armaan tells Jassi to come along with him for lunch with Mr Kapoor to which Malika objects. Jassi is very insecure about the way she is looking at to top it off, Pari and Malika make her feel worse. Will Jassi attend the lunch or not?

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets Promoted
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Jassi leave for the business lunch. Armaan promotes Jassi from his secretary to his assistant. Armaan drops Jassi back to her place. Jassi gives the good news to her family. What will be Malika's reaction after she finds out about Jassi's promotion?

episodesList.title: Malika Comes to Know About Jassi's Promotion
episodesList.summary: Malika is upset with Armaan for promoting Jassi. Armaan catches Pari listening to their conversation at the door. Pari also starts questioning Armaan on Jassi's promotion. Armaan shouts at Jassi for telling everyone about her promotion. Will Armaan forgive Jassi for her mistake?

episodesList.title: Jassi Told to Tamper With Reports
episodesList.summary: Jassi informs Armaan and Raj that they have not been able to achieve the targets to which Raj and Armaan tell her to tamper with the reports and not show this information. Will Jassi listen to Armaan and tamper with the reports?

episodesList.title: Rumour Of Armaan Taking Jassi For Dinner
episodesList.summary: Armaan's parent's question Malika about their relationships. Malika tells them that Armaan's behaviour towards her has changed. Jassi is running a high fever but she continues to worry about her work. Raj gets a call from Armaan and tells him about a rumour of Armaan going for dinner with Jassi. Is Armaan really going for dinner with Jassi? What will Malika do now?

episodesList.title: Armaan Comes to Jassi's House
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Raj are discussing as to how to pacify Jassi. Meanwhile, Nandu confronts Jassi and teaches her some business tactics. Armaan sends in a letter for Jassi through Pari but she gives it to Malika. How will Malika react? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Mallika and Jassi's Gifts Interchange
episodesList.summary: Jassi comes back to work which pleases Armaan. Jassi's mother and father fight over a shopping list when Armaan calls them to notify that Jassi will be coming back home for the Diwali celebration. Later, Armaan's family initiate Diwali prayers in the office and settle differences between Malika and Armaan.  Just when things are settling down between the two, new trouble arises. What is the trouble?

episodesList.title: Gulati Hacks Jassi's Computer
episodesList.summary: Gulati intends to hack Jassi's computer files to know what's cooking between Jassi and Armaan. Meanwhile, Jassi and Nandu alter the passwords and file names. Maddy asks Armaan to come to the office and on the other hand, Pari, as usual, confuses Jassi as she wishes to barge into her cabin. Will Jassi fall into Pari's trap?

episodesList.title: Jassi Blamed For Being Irresponsible
episodesList.summary: Jassi's computer gets spoilt. Armaan gets angry with her when Pari intrudes, telling them that the engineer is on his way. Jassi rushes to him and tries to get her computer set right. Meanwhile, Gulati surprises Aryan with the news of fooling Jassi in order to chalk out some secret data from her system.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Computer is Fixed
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the office accuses Jassi of being irresponsible. Jassi's colleagues get their heads together to find a solution to her problem. The board members are busy having lunch and meanwhile, Jassi and her colleagues get the computer fixed. She notifies Armaan about this and he quickly comes to the technical room.

episodesList.title: Armaan Wants Jassi to Take Charge
episodesList.summary: Jassi manages to take the printouts in time to save the meeting from being cancelled. Gulati scolds the engineer for being so negligent towards their plan. Meanwhile, Armaan tells Jassi to give the presentation in front of the board members. She is scared at first but boldly manages every condition in the board meeting.

episodesList.title: Armaan Nominates Jassi
episodesList.summary: Gulati is asked to leave Gulmohar. Armaan fumes in anger on seeing him in the office and asks him to leave. At Gulmohar, Armaan familiarizes everyone about Gulati's intentions and nominates Jassi for the Vice President's position. This stimulates Aryan and Malika and they show reluctance towards Armaan's decision. What will be Jassi's fate?

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets Ready For Cocktail Party
episodesList.summary: Maddy insults Jassi in front of everyone. Meanwhile, Armaan and Raj discuss buying cheap fabrics for economic benefits. Jassi objects in between and suggests some other options keeping in mind Gulmohar's reputation. Armaan tells Raj that Jassi will accompany them to the cocktail party which worries him.

episodesList.title: Armaan Signs a Deal
episodesList.summary: Armaan and Raj are shocked to see Jassi's avatar. Moments later, they reach the venue and are warmly welcomed by the host. A lady catches Armaan's attention and he drools over her beauty. Meanwhile, Pari reaches Aryan's office for a private meeting and on the other end  Armaan, Jassi, and Raj sign a deal with Shehnaaz and buy good quality fabrics from her company.

episodesList.title: Balwant Loses His Job
episodesList.summary: Balwant drives everyone crazy at home. Nandu offers to help but Balwant shunts him away. Meanwhile, Armaan makes plans with Mandira unaware that Mallika is already there at his apartment. Moments later, Balwant angrily informs his mother and wife about losing his job. Its a tough time for Jassi's family.

episodesList.title: Jassi : The New Signatory
episodesList.summary: Jassi makes a sweet dish in the morning for Guru Purab when she realizes she is late for work. She rushes to the office unaware about the tension going on in her house. In the office, Armaan informs Raj that Jassi will be the authorized signatory. Later, she accompanies Armaan to the bank where he introduces Jassi to the bank manager as a replacement signatory for Gulati.

episodesList.title: Shantanu Meets Jassi
episodesList.summary: Mallika scolds Armaan for going to the bank with Jassi. Armaan, in order to pacify her, organizes lunch and asks Pari to take care of the arrangements. Pari is shocked to see Shantanu and Jassi going for lunch together. Maddy and Mallika are busy choosing a model for their collection when Armaan suggests Mandira's name.

episodesList.title: Nandu Tells Jassi About Balwant
episodesList.summary: Jassi meets Shantanu in a restaurant and is shocked when he asks her to work for his company and manipulate Armaan's company.  Meanwhile, Armaan, Raj, and Jassi plan their budget unaware about Jassi's tensions. Nandu adds more tension in Jassi's casket by informing her about her father losing his job. How will Jassi handle all this?

episodesList.title: Pari and Aryan's Secret Meeting
episodesList.summary: Balwant calms Jassi informing her that he is planning some business ideas with Nandu. Aryan shows up at Pari's house which shocks her. He comes to know about Pari's economic conditions and makes her uncomfortable. She informs him about Shantanu and Jassi meeting. On the other hand, Jassi tells Nandu about Shantanu's deal.

episodesList.title: Armaan Signs a Deal With Lavanya
episodesList.summary: Pari and Maria fight over Raj. Meanwhile, Gulati shows up at Shantanu's office to draw some information from his mouth regarding Gulmohar. Jassi is lost in thoughts when Armaan interrupts her asking her to fix a meeting with the clients. He questions her again on discovering her behaviour. She notifies him about Shantanu lessening the budget by ten per cent. What will Armaan do now?

episodesList.title: Jassi is Lost In a Dream World
episodesList.summary: Armaan is grateful to Jassi for making the deal possible with Lavanya. Meanwhile, Shantanu calls her to inform about her first commission check and she freaks out. Later, her colleagues tease her with Armaan's name not realizing she is already in thoughts about how she will spend fifteen lakh rupees. She dreams about gifting her father a company, treating her friends in an expensive hotel and travelling the world with her mother. Will Jassi fulfil her dreams?

episodesList.title: Balwant Finds Out About Jassi's Deal
episodesList.summary: Gulati gossips about Jassi and Shantanu's deal with Aryan. They also record Shantanu's call where he mentions that they'll pay thirty lakhs to Jassi. Meanwhile, Jassi's father catches her talking to Shantanu about her commission money and assumes that Jassi is doing something wrong. How will Jassi's father react to this?

episodesList.title: Jassi Notifies Armaan About Shantanu's Offer
episodesList.summary: Aryan reaches Gulmohar to reveal the truth about Jassi. But before he can tell Armaan and the board about Jassi's doing, she notifies him beforehand about Shantanu's offer. During the meeting, Aryan tries his best to prove his point against Jassi but his plan backfires as Jassi has already proved her loyalty.

episodesList.title: New Company In Jassi's Name
episodesList.summary: Armaan shows his trust in Jassi and her honesty and increases her salary from eight thousand to straight twenty thousand.  Armaan also orders her to help him in opening a new company. Mallika, on the other hand, complains to Armaan's father about giving the whole office responsibility to Jassi. She influences Armaan's parents opposite Jassi. Jassi comes back home and shares the good news with her family.

episodesList.title: Vasundhara Supervises Gulmohar's Promotions
episodesList.summary: Jassi is shocked to hear Armaan's idea of opening a new company and that too in her name. Meanwhile, Mallika calls Vasundhara Rao for Gulmohar's upcoming fashion show promotion work. Vasundhara shows up at Gulmohar for inspection and warns Armaan about the press.

episodesList.title: Jassi Gets a New Cabin
episodesList.summary: Gulmohar is gearing up for the fashion show. Amidst such chaos, Armaan shifts Jassi to a new cabin. Maddy is uninformed about the low-quality fabrics that have been used. Are Jassi, Armaan and Raj taking the right decision of not informing Maddy?

episodesList.title: Armaan is Very Nervous
episodesList.summary: Armaan is worried as he is taking a big risk by using low-quality fabrics. Vasundhara introduces him to Alan, the international designer. Meanwhile, Jassi and Raj manipulate Maddy and distract him from checking his designs before the fashion show. Will Maddy find out?

episodesList.title: Maddy Gets Fired
episodesList.summary: Armaan asks Maddy to leave the company. Maddy demands an explanation for the low-quality fabrics. Mallika bashes Jassi and blames her for manipulating Armaan. Vasundhara asks Armaan to apologize to Maddy if he wants to save Gulmohar's reputation. Will Armaan apologize?

episodesList.title: Armaan Apologises to Maddy
episodesList.summary: Jassi goes to a resto-bar with her colleagues to celebrate the success of the fashion show. Coincidently, Armaan reaches the same place searching for Maddy. Meanwhile, Viru mixes alcohol in everyone's drinks. Jassi's father is worried as she is late. Will Jassi's father find out about the party?

episodesList.title: Armaan and Maddy Keep Conditions
episodesList.summary: Maddy accepts Armaan's apology, tossing over a bet and keeps his conditions in front of him. Armaan, on the other hand, also keeps his conditions before Maddy in case he wins the bet. He also pacifies Mallika and convinces her to come back to Gulmohar. Will Mallika come back?

episodesList.title: Jassi : The Temporary Chairman
episodesList.summary: Jassi apologizes to her father for drinking in the bar. Armaan and Mallika confess to Armaan's parents that they are planning to tie the knot post the Hong Kong trip. Armaan tells Jassi that in his absence she'll be the temporary Chairman. Will Jassi take up the opportunity?

episodesList.title: Armaan Leaves For Hong Kong
episodesList.summary: Armaan informs everyone about Jassi being temporary in charge of the whole office in his absence. This news does not go down too well with anyone except Raj. Jassi, on the other hand, is very nervous as she has got a huge responsibility on her shoulders. Will she manage it?

episodesList.title: Aryan Seems Curious
episodesList.summary: Bindiya and Maria get into an argument with Pari for coming late to the office. Pari asks Manchanda to deduct Bindiya's salary but Jassi crops in as their saviour and warns Pari to stick to her own business. She also completes the formalities required to register a new firm and takes Nandu's help in this.

episodesList.title: Sales Reports are Negative
episodesList.summary: Jassi goes to the bank to meet the manager and is shocked to see the sales reports. The sales reports are not up to the mark as what she and Armaan had planned. Meanwhile, Aryan shows up in Jassi's office and expresses his desire to see the sales reports.

episodesList.title: Tough Time For Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Jassi informs Armaan about the sales reports and asks him to come back as soon as possible. Pari calls Aryan and informs him about Armaan coming back to India. Meanwhile, Armaan and Raj come to the office and are tensed to see the sales reports. Will Jassi help save Gulmohar in time?

episodesList.title: Nandu Smells Something Fishy
episodesList.summary: Armaan decides to take a loan from Jassi's new company Kohinoor. He also realizes that Maddy has quit the job again and somehow manages to convince Maddy to come back to the office. Nandu, on the other hand, smells something fishy about Armaan's plans.

episodesList.title: Maria Loses Her Job
episodesList.summary: Maria in order to make Pari jealous tries to get close to Raj. Raj fumes in anger due to all this and asks Maria to leave the job. Maddy pacifies Pari and Jassi handles Maria. Meanwhile, Armaan and Jassi are finding solutions to their budget problems to maintain their goodwill in the market. Will they succeed in that?

episodesList.title: Raj Ditches Pari and Maria
episodesList.summary: Jassi tries her luck in convincing Armaan for not firing Maria. Armaan, on the other hand, makes Raj understand asking him to apologize to Pari to prevent her from going to Aryan for sympathy. Will Raj listen to Armaan?

episodesList.title: Viru Saves The Day
episodesList.summary: Manchanda takes Maria to a resto-bar when Viru comes in time to save Maria. Armaan invites a friend for dinner in his cabin and asks Jassi not to come out from her cabin. He leaves the office in the night and forgets about Jassi. The whole night Jassi stays in the office and her father fumes in anger waiting for her in the house.

episodesList.title: Gurinder Meets Jassi
episodesList.summary: Armaan feels guilty for making Jassi stay in the office for the whole night. Gurinder is busy working out when Jassi mistakes him to be a stranger barging in her house. He, on the other hand, gets a shock to see Jassi.

episodesList.title: Manchanda's Day Out
episodesList.summary: Jassi and her colleagues complain against Manchanda. Armaan directly talks to him and he acts innocent. Pari doesn't quit and informs Raj about Aryan coming to her rescue. Gurinder opts to stay at home and wait for Jassi but she does not want to go for the wedding function with him.

episodesList.title: Mallika is Back
episodesList.summary: Mallika is back from Hong Kong. Armaan orders Jassi not to reveal about the sales reports to Mallika. But Maddy tells this to Mallika and she fumes in anger. She questions Armaan and commands to meet him and Raj in the conference room.

episodesList.title: Mallika Takes Charge
episodesList.summary: Mallika wants Maddy to design a new collection. She scolds Armaan for being so careless towards his company and taking undue advantage of his position. How will Armaan tackle this?

episodesList.title: Bindiya is Out Of Control
episodesList.summary: Armaan is not able to tackle such a big loss. All the buyers are giving back the products to Gulmohar as there are no sales that are happening. Later, Leena comes to Gulmohar for a modelling assignment. Bindiya notices her and fumes in anger. Why does Bindiya get angry?

episodesList.title: Kohinoor to Save Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Mallika fights with Armaan as she feels he takes her for granted. Pari, on the other hand, is upset because of Raj. Armaan and Jassi make new sales plans. Bindiya is still upset as Leena got the job in Gulmohar. Will Armaan and Jassi succeed in making new plans for Gulmohar?

episodesList.title: Gulmohar Collection Failed
episodesList.summary: Nandu stops Jassi from supporting Armaan. Mallika is all set and looking forward to her marriage with Armaan but he upsets her every time. Bindiya and her girl gang are up to some mischief in the office to bring Reshma down. Maddy and Raj also enter into a heated argument pertaining to Maddy's new collection. What will the fate of Gulmohar be? Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Aryan's Uninformed Visit to Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Aryan shows up at Gulmohar without informing anyone. Jassi tries to inform Armaan about Aryan's presence but he ignores her call. When he sees Aryan in the conference hall, he fumes in anger and insults him in every possible way but Aryan is no less as he, on the other hand, blasts at Armaan asking him about the sales reports.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Friends Hatch a Plan
episodesList.summary: Mr Walia volunteers to help out Jassi and Nandu as an accountant and also help out at home. Meanwhile, Jassi's friend predicts her future is going to be bleak. How will Jassi tackle this situation? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Balwant Feels Armaan Went Against The Law
episodesList.summary: Nandu tells Jassi's father Balwant, that Armaan had taken a loan of 10 lakhs from Kohinoor. Balwant, on the other hand, feels that Armaan went against the law. How will Jassi react to this? Watch this episode to know.

episodesList.title: Raj Flies to Bangkok
episodesList.summary: Jassi suggests Armaan to consult with Mallika and Maddy before deciding on any supplier. Raj, on the other hand, flies to Bangkok to book the deal but Armaan lies to Mallika and Maddy that Raj is in Singapore to meet the supplier. Meanwhile, Maddy reminds Armaan to dress up like a girl to his party as per their bet. What will Armaan do?

episodesList.title: Suppliers From Bangkok
episodesList.summary: Jassi is looking for some good suppliers and comes across one such supplier who is ready to go by their demands but somehow Jassi feels that this supplier is spooky and is misleading them as he is exporting Chinese Silk from Bangkok. Is Jassi on the right track?

episodesList.title: Bank Rejects Armaan's Loan Proposal
episodesList.summary: Jassi discusses their supplier-deal with Nandu. Nandu asks Jassi to stop Armaan from finalizing the deal with the Bangkok suppliers. Jassi informs Armaan that the bank has rejected their loan proposal. Armaan gets hassled up and reaches the bank. Will he get the approval?

episodesList.title: Armaan Dresses As a Lady Bird
episodesList.summary: Maddy eagerly waits for his party and his awaited bet with Armaan. He brings a girly outfit for Armaan, asking him to wear that dress at his party as Armaan lost the bet. Armaan asks Jassi about cross-dressing which shocks her. At the party, Maddy leaves no chances to insult Armaan. How will Armaan deal with this?

episodesList.title: Armaan is Miss Hawa Hawai
episodesList.summary: Armaan goes to Maddy's party dressed as a girl. There, a photographer clicks his photos and he urges to leave. Maddy forces Armaan to dance with him in the party and tells him that his screen name is Miss Hawa Hawai. How will Arman react to the insult?

episodesList.title: Armaan, a Damsel In Distress
episodesList.summary: Jassi realizes that a ladylike figure running behind her taxi is none other than Armaan himself.  She rescues him and escorts him to Gulmohar. But trouble strikes back again and Jassi is left with no choice but to let Armaan tag along with her to her house. Will Armaan get caught at Jassi's house.

episodesList.title: Jassi Hides Armaan In Her House
episodesList.summary: Jassi hides Armaan in her living room. Balwant becomes suspicious that someone is in his house. Armaan hides under the table to save himself from Jassi's father. Will he get caught? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Armaan Gifts Jassi a Car
episodesList.summary: Armaan gifts a car to Jassi. Jassi jumps in excitement and steps on Armaan's foot. She also daydreams of her going on a long drive with Armaan. Viru brings the samples in Armaan's cabin, but Jassi is still lost in her dream world.

episodesList.title: Trishala Gets to Know The Truth
episodesList.summary: Pari tells Mallika that Jassi does not share Armaan's information with anyone. Mallika asks Trishala to find out about Armaan. Jassi requests Trishala to hide the lie from Mallika. How will Mallika react when she finds out that Armaan has lied again?

episodesList.title: Mallika Fires Jassi
episodesList.summary: Mallika fumes in anger and shouts at Jassi, as she thinks Jassi told Armaan about Pari being her spy. Pari, on the contrary, informs everyone that she never went to Jassi's cabin to spy. Mallika, in anger, asks Jassi to leave the company.

episodesList.title: Armaan Fires Pari and Hires Jassi Again
episodesList.summary: Armaan gets to know that Mallika has fired Jassi. He fires Pari instead of asking her to leave Gulmohar. Hearing this, Pari pretends to faint. Jassi, later, surprises everyone by showing her new car. Will Jassi accept the offer again?

episodesList.title: Police At Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Police catch the driver of the truck that has the fabric materials. Meanwhile, Viru is praying that Armaan doesn't find out about the damage he is done to his car. The girl gang at Gulmohar is mocking Pari for her pregnancy but she surprises everyone by coming to the office. Jassi is trying to get in touch with the concerned person for their consignment who informs her that the consignment has been confiscated by the police. Will Jassi catch hold of the consignment?

episodesList.title: Police Interrogate Jassi
episodesList.summary: Police interrogate Jassi for ordering fabric from smugglers. While the girl gang of Gulmohar thinks it's all for publicity.  Jassi handles the tricky situation with confidence. How will she get out of this? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Armaan Holds an Emergency Meeting At Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: When the news of fabric smuggling by a big fashion house comes out, Armaan and Raj hold an emergency meeting with Mallik and Maddy about their fabric requirement. Will Armaan save his company?

episodesList.title: Jassi is Grateful For Her Father
episodesList.summary: Jassi explains to Armaan that even though her father's expectations precedes her, she couldn't have achieved what she has without his help and love. Jassi feels really proud of her father for raising  her up.

episodesList.title: Jassi and Nandu Get In a Fight
episodesList.summary: Jassi and Nandu's friendship is put to test when Nandu accuses her of changing after she got a job at Gulmohar. Has Jassi really changed? Will she save her friendship? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Raj Wants to Leave Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: Raj decides to leave Gulmohar after a fight with his dear friend, Armaan. Jassi asks Armaan to talk Raj out of leaving, but, he refuses to listen to her. Will Raj take his decision back?

episodesList.title: Jassi Surprises Nandu
episodesList.summary: Jassi visits Nandu at his house while he is sleeping and surprises him. Both forgo their differences and become friends once again. Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Jassi's Love For Armaan Grows
episodesList.summary: Armaan gives Jassi a rose when he drops her off at her home. Elated by his actions, Jassi treasures the rose and falls into her dreamland. Has Jassi's feeling for Armaan become stronger?

episodesList.title: Jassi Lifts Armaan's Mood
episodesList.summary: Jassi makes Armaan laugh unintentionally when his mood had turned sour. She cherishes the fact that she could make him laugh and wonders if it's a turning point in their relationship. Does Armaan also have feelings for Jassi?

episodesList.title: Armaan Stuck In a Pickle With His Father
episodesList.summary: Armaan's father is disappointed with him when he learns their old collection had failed. Armaan is put in a pickle with his father because he wouldn't tell him the truth about their company. How will Armaan resolve the issues with his father?

episodesList.title: Valentines Day Celebrations At Gulmohar
episodesList.summary: While some of the workers at Gulmohar eagerly celebrate Valentine's day, few, like Raj and Mallika, are annoyed by all the decorations and excitement the day brought along with it. Will they create any trouble to will they celebrate along with the others? Watch this episode to find out only on Sony Liv App.

episodesList.title: Jassi Loses Her Diary
episodesList.summary: Jassi loses her dairy at Gulmohar and is afraid someone at the office would find it before her and read it. She is hesitant when the girl gang of Gulmohar offer their help to find it. Will she find her diary?

episodesList.title: Nandu's Girlfriend Meets His Mother
episodesList.summary: Nandu gets nervous when his girlfriend asks to meet his mother. Even though he tries hard to avoid the meeting, it occurs eventually. Will Nandu's mother approve his girlfriend? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Jassi is Excited About Tirshala's Predictions
episodesList.summary: Trishala reads tarot cards and predicts Jassi will receive two bad news but something good will happen after it. Jassi is excited about the good part but is nervous about the bad news. What will the good and the bad news be?

episodesList.title: Jassi is Left Heartbroken
